raw.description:
Description

The Strategic Account Manager will drive sales across the DACH region and own a quota within the assigned geography. This role combines direct business development with channel-led growth, building strong relationships with prospective customers and with MSP, MSSP, and VAR partners.

Cynet is a leading XDR provider on a mission to deliver an all-in-one cybersecurity solution for mid-market and small organizations, as well as managed service providers. The Strategic Account Manager will be a critical contributor to strategic growth, market development, and pipeline creation, while identifying emerging trends across the regionץ

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is €75,000 annually plus commissions. Actual compensation will depend on several factors, including location, level of seniority and skills.

What will you do

  • Partner with Sales Leadership to build and execute a territory strategy that includes hunting for direct business and supporting the Account Executive in the region.
  • Use leading sales and prospecting tools to increase Cynet's market penetration across DACH and other assigned territories if applicable.
  • Create direct demand for the Cynet platform through disciplined outbound prospecting and pipeline-generation activities.
  • Leverage channel relationships to identify, develop, and expand opportunities throughout the region.
  • Lead initial prospect and partner conversations to generate interest, qualify opportunities, and build pipeline.
  • Sell to IT and security leaders, as well as managing directors, CEOs, and owners of MSPs, MSSPs, and VAR partners.
  • Represent Cynet at industry events, partner engagements, and business meetings across the region.
  • Maintain accurate weekly forecasts and provide clear visibility into quarterly and full-year territory performance.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of successful sales experience with a proven history of performance.
  • Native or fluent German and English language skills.
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota and closing business.
  • Experience selling cybersecurity solutions to end-user customers through channel partners.
  • Experience and proven success in recruiting, onboarding, enabling, and growing channel partners within the region.
  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, listening, and strong presentation skills.
  • The ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and manage time in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience working in a startup or early-stage company.
  • An entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset with strong personal accountability.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to leverage cross-functional resources effectively.
  • A coachable mindset and openness to feedback.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a comparable sales qualification methodology.

About Us

Cynet is a leader in threat detection and response, designed to simplify security for organizations of all sizes. Our mission is to empower lean security teams and their partners with an AI-powered, unified platform that autonomously detects, protects, and responds to threats - backed by 24×7 security experts.

With a Partner First mindset, we focus on helping customers and partners stay protected, operate confidently, and achieve their goals. Our vision is to give every organization true cybersecurity peace of mind, providing fast, accurate protection without the noise or complexity.

Position Title: Online Adjunct Instructor for EDUC 829CR: Therapeutic Play Techniques for Child Life Specialists

Division: Graduate School of Education

Course: EDUC 829CR: Therapeutic Play Techniques for Child Life Specialists (3 credits)

Term: Spring 2027, Online

Dates: January 19, 2027 – May 4, 2027

  • 1/25, 2/8, 2/16 (Tuesday), 2/22, 3/8, 3/15 (optional), 4/5, 4/12 (optional), 5/3
  • This course is scheduled to run Mondays 7:00 – 9:00 pm, online. Day and time are subject to change

Course Description:

Students will explore the meanings and purposes of play and how play develops as a child develops. Various theories of play therapy will be introduced and the roles of child life specialist and play specialist will be delineated. Students will learn how child life specialists can create the optimal environment to encourage learning, development and healing through play in hospitals and other healthcare settings. The course also covers directive and nondirective therapeutic play techniques for use in playrooms, clinical settings, and at the bedside, both with the individual child and with groups. This course is for Child Life students only.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver course content and materials aligned with the program curriculum.
  • Grade and evaluate student performance in a timely manner, providing constructive feedback.
  • Maintain open communication with students, including scheduled office hours or availability for consultation.
  • Submit final grades and required course documentation (e.g., attendance records) by institutional deadlines.
  • Collaborate with program faculty on course coordination and attend relevant program meetings, if necessary.

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in child life required. Doctorate preferred.
  • Must be a Certified Child Life Specialist (CCLS).
  • 5 or more years of experience as a child life practitioner.
  • Experience teaching at the graduate level, preferred.
  • Experience teaching online, preferred.

Compensation:

  • $1,270

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Principal Quality Engineer carries out procedures to ensure that all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements. The Principal Quality Engineer provides strategic advice and guidance to functional team(s). Highly skilled with broad, advanced technical experience.

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.


The Principal, Quality Engineering is a senior individual contributor and hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing modern, AI-focused quality engineering practices across Humana’s software delivery ecosystem. This role defines, demonstrates, and scales what good looks like for enterprise quality engineering across the SDLC through technical expertise, reference patterns, automation frameworks, quality intelligence, and practical implementation guidance.


This role serves as a deeply technical expert in AI-enabled quality engineering, test automation, quality architecture, engineering excellence, and continuous quality practices. The Principal partners closely with the core EQE Platform team, Quality Engineering Segements, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise Engineering Enablement, Agile teams, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Data/AI teams to embed scalable, secure, measurable quality practices into delivery workflows, release processes, engineering platforms, and operational support models.


This is a hands-on principal role, not a people management role. The Principal will accelerate Humana’s enterprise quality engineering transformation by building reusable solutions, creating technical standards and exemplars, coaching teams directly, and ensuring responsible use of AI across quality engineering processes. This role is also responsible for defining and operationalizing what good looks like for EQE across the SDLC, including test strategies and approaches, release management, incident tracking, production validation, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Engineering Strategy, Standards, and Technical Leadership

  • Define, refine, and operationalize enterprise quality engineering standards, patterns, reference architectures, and technical guidance across software delivery teams.
  • Define and continuously evolve what good looks like for Enterprise Quality Engineering across the full SDLC, including planning, development, testing, release, deployment, production validation, support, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish practical, reusable best practices for embedding quality engineering into each SDLC phase, including requirements quality, test planning, test design, automation strategy, validation, release readiness, production verification, and supportability.
  • Create and maintain reusable frameworks, starter kits, accelerators, example implementations, and practical guidance for quality planning, test automation, regression strategy, API and UI testing, service virtualization, code quality, deployment validation, performance and resilience testing, release readiness, observability-driven quality, production validation, and AI-assisted quality engineering.
  • Define enterprise quality expectations, guardrails, and example patterns that help teams consistently apply EQE best practices within Agile, DevOps, and platform-based delivery models.
  • Create technical guidance for quality-related Definition of Done expectations and quality checkpoints across delivery workflows to improve consistency, traceability, and readiness.
  • Provide deep technical consultation to engineering teams on implementing modern quality engineering practices aligned with enterprise delivery models, DevOps controls, and platform standards.
  • Partner with engineering enablement and platform teams to ensure quality practices are reflected in enterprise tooling, templates, reusable workflows, and CI/CD pipeline patterns.

Hands-On AI-Focused Quality Engineering

  • Lead the practical application of AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities across the SDLC through hands-on experimentation, prototyping, implementation, and refinement.
  • Design and implement patterns for responsible use of AI in quality engineering, including test case generation, test data analysis, requirements analysis, defect clustering and triage, risk-based testing, code review support, automation acceleration, quality intelligence, and production issue analysis.
  • Evaluate and pilot generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and analytics solutions that improve test effectiveness, speed, coverage, defect prevention, and engineering productivity.
  • Develop guardrails, technical recommendations, and implementation patterns for safe and responsible use of AI-enabled engineering tools in partnership with Data/AI, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders.
  • Build proof of concepts, reference implementations, and engineering patterns that demonstrate measurable value from AI-enabled quality practices.
  • Help teams integrate AI-assisted workflows into daily engineering practices while preserving human oversight, traceability, quality, and compliance expectations.

Test Automation, Quality Architecture, and Engineering Excellence

  • Define what good looks like for test strategies and test approaches across product, platform, integration, API, UI, data, performance, resilience, security-aligned, and operational validation scenarios.
  • Establish enterprise guidance for selecting appropriate test levels, test types, coverage models, and automation approaches based on risk, architecture, criticality, and delivery context.
  • Create patterns for modern test strategy development that incorporate risk-based testing, non-functional validation, test data management, and environment strategy.
  • Standardize quality engineering approaches for unit, integration, system, acceptance, migration, infrastructure, data, and deployment validation testing to improve consistency and delivery confidence.
  • Define measurable expectations for automation maintainability, reliability, execution efficiency, evidence quality, and test coverage effectiveness.
  • Design scalable approaches for validating APIs, services, event-driven systems, data workflows, web applications, and platform integrations.
  • Establish automation patterns that support shift-left and shift-right quality practices, including pre-merge validation, deployment validation, synthetic testing, and production verification.
  • Promote engineering practices that strengthen quality outcomes, including clean code practices, atomic commits, meaningful pull requests, code quality controls, and automated quality gates.

Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Quality Maturity

  • Contribute deep technical expertise to enterprise Quality Engineering governance frameworks, standards adoption models, and maturity assessments.
  • Define what good looks like for EQE controls and evidence across SDLC governance requirements, including traceability, standards adherence, test management, quality metrics, release readiness, and production validation support.
  • Translate enterprise SDLC standards and governance expectations into actionable quality engineering practices that teams can implement consistently and with minimal friction.
  • Help define maturity criteria for SDLC quality adoption, release quality discipline, incident learning integration, and test strategy effectiveness across teams.
  • Define measurable quality criteria, engineering controls, and evidence expectations aligned with SDLC governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, and AI governance stakeholders to ensure quality engineering practices align with enterprise policies, control expectations, and responsible AI principles.
  • Identify quality, control, and process risks in software delivery workflows and recommend pragmatic improvements that reduce friction while strengthening compliance.

Quality Intelligence, Metrics, and Insight

  • Define and implement actionable quality metrics and telemetry that help teams improve engineering quality, delivery confidence, release readiness, and production outcomes.
  • Define measurable indicators for what good looks like across SDLC quality adoption, release quality, incident quality signals, defect escape trends, and test strategy effectiveness.
  • Establish dashboards and scorecards that help teams assess adherence to EQE best practices in areas such as test planning, release readiness, incident learning, automation effectiveness, and quality outcomes.
  • Partner with platform, DevOps, engineering, and data teams to create dashboards and scorecards for automation coverage, defect trends, test reliability, release quality, deployment validation, code quality, pipeline health, DORA-aligned indicators, and AI-enabled quality outcomes.
  • Use quality, release, and incident data to identify systemic issues, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across teams and platforms.
  • Translate engineering and quality signals into recommendations that improve reliability, maintainability, speed, and production performance.

Enablement, Coaching, and Enterprise Influence

  • Provide expert-level coaching and hands-on guidance to engineering and quality teams adopting modern and AI-enabled quality engineering practices.
  • Create technical playbooks, exemplars, implementation guides, workshops, and enablement content to improve enterprise quality capability.
  • Lead or contribute to Communities of Practice, architecture reviews, innovation forums, and technical learning sessions focused on quality engineering, SDLC excellence, release quality, and AI fluency.
  • Influence senior engineers, architects, and delivery teams across a matrixed environment through technical credibility, practical delivery experience, and clear demonstrations of value.
  • Help teams reduce developer overhead by simplifying quality workflows, improving developer experience, and increasing automation effectiveness.

Platform and Tooling Alignment

  • Guide quality engineering implementation across enterprise platforms and tools used for source control, CI/CD, code quality, release orchestration, feature management, and test automation.
  • Support adoption of pipeline-as-code, reusable workflows, and automation patterns aligned with enterprise platform standards.
  • Advise teams on quality-related usage of tools such as Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, and other approved engineering tools.
  • Ensure quality engineering practices align with enterprise tool strategy and help reduce unnecessary tool sprawl, platform debt, and delivery friction.
  • Partner with platform teams to support scalable onboarding, standardization, and developer self-service.

Audit and Control Support

  • Provide technical support for internal and external audits related to SDLC, quality engineering controls, automation, traceability, release evidence, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Help define repeatable evidence approaches for quality-related controls, including automated evidence collection where appropriate.
  • Partner with Audit, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and platform teams to improve audit readiness and sustainable control adoption.
  • Identify recurring evidence gaps, control weaknesses, quality risks, and AI-related considerations, then recommend practical remediation patterns.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in quality engineering, software engineering, SDET, test automation, DevOps, software delivery, or related technical disciplines.
  • Deep technical hands-on expertise in quality engineering practices, including test automation, quality architecture, regression strategy, API testing, code quality, deployment validation, performance testing, defect prevention, release validation, incident-informed quality improvement, and production quality verification.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and improving scalable automation frameworks, test tooling, quality accelerators, or reusable engineering solutions.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience applying AI-enabled capabilities in software engineering or quality engineering, such as test generation, defect analysis, requirements analysis, quality intelligence, or engineering productivity improvement.
  • Experience defining what good looks like for quality engineering practices across the SDLC, including test strategy, release management, incident tracking, and production quality feedback loops.
  • Experience integrating quality practices into Agile delivery models, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps workflows.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, clean code practices, source control hygiene, pull request quality, and automation-first delivery practices.
  • Experience defining or influencing technical standards, engineering best practices, or SDLC quality patterns across multiple teams.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, DevOps, and Data/AI teams.
  • Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and translate complex quality engineering concepts into pragmatic implementation guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience serving in a principal, architect, staff, or senior lead-level technical role in quality engineering or software engineering.
  • Experience with generative AI, machine learning, LLM-assisted engineering tools, or intelligent automation applied to testing and quality workflows.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, pipeline-as-code patterns, reusable CI/CD workflows, feature flags, and code quality tooling.
  • Experience improving quality through engineering metrics such as DORA, pipeline health, release quality, defect escape trends, incident patterns, test reliability, and AI productivity indicators.
  • Experience implementing or advising on SDLC governance, evidence collection, audit support, control mapping, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Experience creating reference architectures, proof of concepts, technical playbooks, Communities of Practice content, or engineering enablement materials.
  • Experience using platform and workflow standards to reduce developer overhead and improve delivery consistency at enterprise scale.


Use your skills to make an impact

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$170,800 - $234,800 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

raw.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a National Program Director, Community Health Centers to join our team.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and execute Labcorp's national strategy and value proposition for Community Health Centers, HCCNs, and Primary Care Associations.
  • Build and manage strategic partnerships with national HCCNs to advance contractual relationships and drive collaborative growth initiatives.
  • Serve on NACHC Strategic Alliance team, leading workflow for member Best Practices and Toolkit development.
  • Standardize and scale CHC services and programs across all operating Divisions.
  • Lead development and commercialization of products, programs, and solutions that improve UDS and VBC quality measures, operational performance, and patient outcomes.
  • Define Community Health Center pricing strategies and build consistency in how we approach uninsured populations and flat-rate programs.
  • Ensure CHC requirements are incorporated into specialty-testing and value-based care initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Diagnostic Assistant, Insight Analytics, and data teams to enhance customer offerings and drive utilization.
  • Partner with Divisional sales and leadership to support CHC growth and retention.
  • Drive internal alignment on CHC strategy and lead cross-functional teams in launching and scaling new programs and solutions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for customer presentations, leadership discussions, and sales strategy
  • Develop a centralized capability for CHC RFP responses and enable Primary Care Association engagement, and value-based care contracting.
  • Drive sales team communications, training, tools, and support resources.
  • Lead targeting campaigns and sales enablement programs.
  • Leverage laboratory data to support UDS quality measures, care gap initiatives, population health programs, and value-based care performance.
  • Lead Salesforce account hierarchy and data governance for CHCs, improve targeting and reporting.
  • Drive customer-facing communications in partnership with Marketing, including sales collateral, marketing campaigns, thought leadership, and CHC conference strategy and support.
  • Monitor CHC segment performance through revenue, accession volume, and customer analytics.
  • Present strategic updates, KPIs and market insights to senior leadership.
  • Participate in business reviews with Divisional and national commercial leadership.
  • Support commercial efforts to achieve annual CHC growth budget.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8+ years’ experience in healthcare, laboratory services, public health, product management.

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience working in lab services
  • Product/Program Director experience in healthcare
  • Laboratory, healthcare product sales or program management experience

raw.description:
Ready to make a difference?


ICF is seeking a Senior Grid Protection Engineer to support the development of protective relay settings for high-voltage substation projects ranging from 12 kV through 500 kV.


You will perform short-circuit and protection studies, develop relay settings and calculation packages, review protection and control designs, and provide technical support during implementation. You will work closely with engineers, designers, project managers, and utility clients to deliver reliable, accurate, and high-quality protection solutions.

We are a relentlessly client-focused team reimagining, redesigning, and re-engineering how electric utilities address industry challenges. We are looking for motivated and innovative professionals who want to strengthen grid reliability while continuing to grow their technical expertise.


Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements and a strong focus on work-life balance
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, professional development resources, 401(k) matching, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Investment in the community: Donation matching and volunteer opportunities
  • And many more benefits. Ask your recruiter for additional details.

What you will be doing:

  • Perform short-circuit model reviews and identify data or modeling issues that may affect protection studies.
  • Conduct short-circuit and protection coordination studies using software such as CAPE/Gridscale X Advanced Protection Assessment, ASPEN OneLiner, CYME, or similar power-system analysis tools.
  • Develop and review calculation packages used to determine protective relay settings and coordination requirements.
  • Configure settings files for microprocessor-based protective relays.
  • Review protection and control design packages to confirm that relay settings, logic, schematics, and design intent are accurately aligned.
  • Review relay logic and control schemes for proper implementation of protection philosophies.
  • Support the development of NERC PRC compliance documentation, including calculations, reports, and supporting technical records.
  • Coordinate with protection and control engineers, substation designers, project managers, and client representatives to resolve technical questions and support project delivery.
  • Provide remote technical support to relay test engineers and field personnel during the installation, testing, and commissioning of relay settings.
  • Perform quality-control checks on technical calculations, relay settings, and project documentation.
  • Maintain organized and accurate project files in accordance with client and company standards.
  • Continue developing knowledge of protective relaying, utility standards, industry practices, and emerging grid technologies.
  • Manage assigned work independently while meeting project schedules, quality expectations, and client requirements.
  • Perform technical and quality reviews of protection studies, relay settings, calculations, and documentation prepared by other engineers.
  • Support the development of newer and less-experienced engineers through technical guidance, training, mentorship, and assistance with project execution and engineering workflows.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in protective relaying, relay settings development, power-system protection, substation protection and control, or a closely related area.
  • Experience performing short-circuit studies, protection coordination studies, or relay-setting calculations.
  • Experience using at least one power-system analysis or protection software platform, such as CAPE/Gridscale X, ASPEN OneLiner, CYME, ETAP, or similar software.
  • Understanding of electric power systems, including substations, transmission or distribution systems, fault analysis, and protective relay applications.
  • Ability to read and interpret protection and control drawings, including one-line diagrams, AC/DC schematics, and relay logic diagrams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to engineering team members, clients, field personnel, and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, work independently in a remote environment, and meet project deadlines.

What we would like you to have (preferred qualifications):

  • Experience with developing settings for Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) protective relays.
  • Experience creating or reviewing relay logic, protection philosophies, coordination curves, and settings calculation reports.
  • Experience supporting protection systems for high-voltage substations ranging from 12 kV through 500 kV.
  • Knowledge of transmission and distribution protection applications, including line, transformer, bus, breaker-failure, capacitor-bank, or feeder protection.
  • Familiarity with applicable NERC PRC standards, utility protection practices, and relevant IEEE standards.
  • Experience supporting relay testing, commissioning, or field implementation activities.
  • Experience using programming, scripting, spreadsheet automation, or other tools to improve engineering calculations and workflows.
  • Engineer-in-Training certification or progress toward professional engineering licensure.
  • Previous experience working for an electric utility, engineering consulting firm, relay manufacturer, or power-delivery organization.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation, or other emerging digital tools to improve engineering workflows, increase efficiency, and enhance the quality and consistency of technical deliverables.

The Clinical Innovation Delivery Principal leads execution of priority Clinical Innovation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional and regional teams, monitoring performance, and driving accountability for implementation. Working independently in a highly matrixed environment, this role partners across Clinical, Pharmacy, Stars, Medicare Risk Adjustment, Operations, and Regional teams to advance initiative outcomes and resolve execution barriers.

Serving as a strategic integrator, the Principal translates enterprise priorities into coordinated delivery. Early responsibilities include establishing portfolio operating mechanisms, governance processes, delivery plans, leading performance metrics, and issue-resolution pathways; aligning stakeholders on priorities, ownership, dependencies, and tradeoffs; and advising senior leaders on decisions required to advance execution. As the function matures, the Principal will lead high-visibility enterprise initiatives from concept through implementation, adoption, and value realization.

The successful candidate mobilizes diverse partners, balances time, energy, and resources across a changing portfolio of competing priorities, and uses sound judgment, structured problem solving, executive presence, and influence without direct authority to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver measurable, sustainable results. WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

PRIMARY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • M&A and CAPEX Financial Leadership
    • Serve as the finance subject matter expert for FCS’s M&A efforts and CAPEX projects in partnership with business development, facilities and operations leadership.
    • Own the analytical framework for measuring and interpreting financial performance of acquisitions & CAPEX projects in progress and post go-live, tracking business case vs. actuals.
    • Participate in integration planning to monitor expenses relative to approved business cases & update models to provide timely visibility into changing expectations.
    • Develop and refine transparent, repeatable reporting and models that explain performance and support performance evaluation vs. business cases.
  • Forecasting, Budgeting, and Planning Support
    • Lead forecasting, budgeting, and planning activities related to the M&A pipeline, CAPEX projects, and enterprise capital budget allocation.
    • Build models that support annual planning cycles, in-year forecasts, and scenario analysis.
    • Partner with stakeholders to ensure assumptions are well-supported, documented, and aligned to business realities.
  • Executive Decision Support and Reporting
    • In collaboration with cross-functional teams, build business cases in support of M&A and CAPEX projects in support of FCS’s growth
    • Deliver concise, executive-ready reporting packages evaluating performance vs. business case expectations, explain results, and highlight risks and opportunities.
    • Build “so what” insights that help leadership understand what is changing, why it matters, and what actions may improve outcomes.
    • Tailor analyses for different leadership audiences.
  • Analytical and Strategic Support
    • Support the full range of analytical, reporting, and strategic needs in support of FCS’s growth.
    • Contribute to ad hoc analyses, business cases, profitability reviews, strategic planning efforts, and leadership requests.
    • Help prioritize opportunities to improve financial performance.
    • Ensure outputs are auditable and easy for stakeholders to interpret.
  • Continuous Improvement and Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner across finance, operations, and practice leadership to identify opportunities for process improvement and stronger performance management – in particular as it relates to post go-live &A and CAPEX project postmortems.
    • Recommend enhancements to underwriting, analytical and integration approaches to improve decision support and outcomes over time.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS or similar) in finance, analytics or related field preferred.
  • CFA a plus.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in M&A, corporate development, PE, FP&A, financial modeling, or analytics, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex transactions, integrations and CAPEX initiatives in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Experience collaborating with C-suite executives & across multiple functions to affect solutions.
  • Excellent financial modeling & problem-solving skills.
  • Executive presence and experience with presentations to various leadership levels.
  • Ability to provide strategic recommendations and influence stakeholders to make decisions.

CORE COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Experience evaluating and modeling M&A transactions and capital projects
  • Deep expertise in advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and AI/ML applications for forecasting. Mastery of Excel, Sigma/Power BI/Tableau, and financial systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle, Hyperion).
  • Financial systems experience with ability to reconcile information from multiple sources.
  • Motivated self-starter that is well organized, dependable, efficient and results-oriented.
  • Strong time management and organization skills with flexibility to work in a fast-paced and changing work environment.

VALUES:

  • Patient First – Keeping the patient at the center of everything we do
  • Accountability – Taking responsibility for our actions
  • Commitment & Care – Upholding FCS vision through every action
  • Team – Working together, one team, one mission

Expectations for all Employees

Every FCS employee is expected to regularly conduct themselves in a professional and respectful manner, to comply with all labor laws, workplace policy and workplace practices. Employees are expected to bring issues of any forms of workplace harassment, discrimination or other potential improprieties to the attention of their management or the human resources department.


#FCS-REV

SCREENINGS – Background and drug screens

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. In addition, FCS is a drug-free workplace, and all new hires will be subject to drug testing. Medical Marijuana cards are not recognized.


EEOC

Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute (FCS) is committed to helping individuals with disabilities to participate in the workforce and ensure equal opportunity to compete for jobs. If you require an accommodation to submit a resume for positions at FCS, please email FCS Recruitment () for further assistance. Please note this email address is intended to request an accommodation as part of the application process. Any other correspondence will not receive a response.


FCS is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

raw.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

raw.excerpt: TTM Technologies, Inc.  – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer About TTM TTM Technologies, Inc.
raw.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

Location:

North America. Preferences:

  • Chippewa Falls, WI
  • Eau Claire, WI
  • Syracuse, NY
  • Southern California (Santa Ana, San Diego)
  • Stafford/Stafford Springs, CT
  • Denver, CO
  • Remote – North America

Travel may be required to support talent initiatives across North America TTM sites.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Talent Management Partner Lead is a senior practitioner and people leader within TTM Technologies' Global Talent Management COE, anchored within the third arm of the TM COE dedicated to succession readiness, critical talent pool health, and organizational effectiveness.

This role works in close, day-to-day partnership with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) supporting critical and key talent — moving beyond advisory to direct execution. The Talent Management Partner Lead drives talent review cycles, succession planning, specific development programs, and targeted readiness and retention strategies from design through delivery, ensuring interventions are implemented, tracked, and producing measurable outcomes. Working alongside HRBPs, this role owns the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent within assigned client groups — translating talent data into clear, actionable insights and ensuring those insights result in real movement: successors' readiness, stronger talent pipelines, and enhanced retention of critical talent.

As a people leader, the Talent Management Partner Lead will build, develop, and manage a growing team of Talent Management Partners — setting the standard for quality talent work, coaching team members to operate with both strategic depth and executional rigor, and scaling the team's impact across the organization.

This individual operates with a high degree of autonomy while contributing to the broader goals of the Global Talent Management COE and the HR function.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


A. Strategic Talent Management

· Drive succession readiness across assigned North America client groups by building and maintaining robust successor pipelines for critical roles, ensuring depth of talent bench strength.

· Lead the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent pools — including high-potential (HiPo) employees — through structured talent reviews and calibration sessions facilitated in close partnership with HRBPs.

· Consult and partner with HRBPs on talent strategy and critical role planning within their assigned business units and sectors, serving as the dedicated talent management resource alongside the HRBP team.

· Build, monitor, and evolve succession readiness plans that align with business priorities for assigned client groups

· Assess organizational effectiveness to surface structural and capability gaps and recommend evidence-based interventions to the supporting HRBPs.

· Execute retention strategies including stay interviews, flight-risk identification, and targeted interventions for critical talent segments in partnership with HRBPs.

· Connect critical and high-potential talent to stretch assignments, mobility opportunities, and cross-functional experiences that accelerate readiness and development.

· Design and support targeted development programs in collaboration with Learning & Development and HRBPs to close identified capability gaps.

· Produce and maintain bench strength, pipeline readiness, and talent health reports; translate data into actionable insights for HR leadership and HRBP partners.

· Partner with HRBPs to ensure talent review action plan follow-through and drive accountability for critical talent outcomes within their client groups.


B. People Leadership & Team Development (M4 Managerial Responsibilities)

· Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, setting clear performance expectations and fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

· Translate the Talent strategy and vision into team priorities, operational plans, and measurable goals with clear ownership and accountability.

· Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and development conversations to grow team members' functional expertise and career progression.

· Hire, onboard, and integrate new team members as the function scales; establish team norms, workflows, and an effective operating cadence.

· Model inclusive leadership behaviors and champion talent practices within the team.

· Identify and remove barriers to team effectiveness; escalate critical risks and resource needs as appropriate.

· Serve as a senior thought partner to the head of global talent management, contributing to the overall strategic direction of TM COE.


C. Strategic Partnership & COE Collaboration

· Build trusted, advisory relationships with HRBP partners to integrate talent strategy into their client group planning and people decisions.

· Communicate talent health, succession risk, and pipeline readiness to HRBP partners and senior HR stakeholders through structured reporting and clear, data-driven narratives.

· Collaborate with Learning & Development, Total Rewards, and other COE partners to source and connect high-impact interventions and development solutions that close succession gaps and enhance retention of critical talent.

· Champion consistent use of talent management tools, frameworks, and processes, aligning to Global TM COE standards.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field.

· 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in talent management, organizational development, or a closely related specialty.

· Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating talent reviews, succession planning processes, and HiPo identification and development programs.

· Proven track record of consulting with and influencing senior HR partners (HRBPs) on talent strategy, critical role planning, and workforce capability.

· Experience managing or leading HR teams, including setting goals, developing talent, and driving accountability.

· Strong analytical skills with experience translating talent data and bench strength metrics into strategic recommendations.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present complex talent insights clearly to HR leadership and HRBP audiences.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, or MBA with an HR concentration.

· Professional certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or a recognized talent management or coaching credential (e.g., SHL, Korn Ferry, DDI).

· Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization — ideally in manufacturing, technology, or defense/aerospace industries.

· Familiarity with psychometric and assessment tools used in talent identification and succession calibration.

· Experience building or scaling a talent management function or team.

· Proficiency with HRIS and talent management platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) and data visualization tools.


COMPETENCIES / SKILLS


Competency/Proficiency Level & Description

Talent Strategy & Succession Planning

Expert – Designs and drives end-to-end succession and talent pool strategies; builds pipeline depth for critical roles.

Consulting & Partnership

Expert – Serves as a dedicated talent management advisor to HRBPs; influences talent decisions without direct authority over client groups.

Organizational Effectiveness

Advanced – Assesses org structure and capability gaps within HRBP-supported areas; surfaces and recommends interventions.

People Leadership & Coaching

Advanced – Develops, coaches, and holds direct reports accountable; models inclusive leadership.

HiPo Identification & Development

Advanced – Designs and supports targeted programs and experiences for high-potential talent in partnership with stakeholders

Retention Strategy & Risk Management

Advanced – Conducts stay interviews, identifies critical talent flight risk, and executes targeted retention interventions.

Data Analysis & Reporting

Advanced – Translates bench strength and pipeline metrics into clear, actionable insights for HR and HRBP partners.

Clear Communication

Expert – Communicates complex talent topics clearly and concisely.

Performance Excellence

Advanced – Sets high standards for self and team; monitors outcomes and drives continuous improvement.

Integrity & Confidentiality

Expert – Handles sensitive talent and organizational data with the highest level of discretion and trust.


WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

· Standard office or remote work environment; prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.

· Travel up to 20–25% within North America to support talent reviews, HRBP partner engagements, and team collaboration.

· Ability to work across time zones as needed to collaborate with distributed HR teams. #CORP

Work


Compensation and Benefits:

TTM offers a variety of health and well-being benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available 1st of the month following date of hire.

Compensation for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience. As required by local law, TTM provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in New York, California and Colorado. For California-based roles, compensation ranges are based upon specific physical locations.

Export Statement:
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.


The Role:

The Senior Accountant of Revenue Recognition plays a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant revenue accounting under ASC 606. This role is responsible for reviewing customer contracts, performing detailed revenue analyses, preparing journal entries and reconciliations, and supporting the monthly and quarterly close processes. The ideal candidate has strong technical accounting skills, experience with complex revenue arrangements, and the ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams in a fast‑paced global environment while maintaining a strong focus on compliance, internal controls, and audit readiness.

The Senior Accountant will:

Revenue Accounting & Contract Review

  • Analyse customer contracts and identify performance obligations, transaction price, variable consideration, and allocation methodologies in accordance with ASC 606.
  • Perform revenue treatment assessments for new deals, renewals, amendments, and complex multi‑element arrangements.
  • Prepare revenue recognition technical memoranda and documentation.
  • Develop, maintain, and communicate global revenue recognition policies and procedures.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on ASC 606 and provide accounting guidance on complex revenue transactions.

Month-End and Quarter-End Close

  • Prepare and review revenue-related journal entries and account reconciliations.
  • Validate revenue system outputs and revenue schedules for accuracy and completeness.
  • Investigate discrepancies and resolve variances between revenue sub-ledgers, billing, and the general ledger.
  • Support internal reporting of revenue results, trends, and fluctuations.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, increase automation, and improve operational efficiency.

Cross‑Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with Sales and Legal teams to review terms before contract execution and guide deal structuring decisions.
  • Collaborate with FP&A to ensure accurate forecasting of revenue and deferred balances.
  • Provide global revenue accounting guidance to regional accounting teams to ensure consistency across geographies.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Pricing teams to assess revenue implications of new offerings.

Internal Controls, SOX, and Audit Readiness

  • Perform and document key SOX controls related to revenue recognition.
  • Prepare audit documentation and respond to auditor inquiries external auditors during quarterly and annual audits.
  • Strengthen the company’s control environment by ensuring complete, accurate, and well‑supported revenue processes.
  • Develop standardized documentation, workflows, and governance practices to support sustainable compliance and audit readiness.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • 3-5+ years of experience in revenue recognition, technical accounting, audit, or corporate accounting
  • Strong knowledge of ASC 606 and related technical accounting requirements.
  • Experience with complex, global revenue arrangements.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and time management skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to multitask and lead teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Detail oriented, good judgment and logical decision-making ability with a hands-on approach

Preferred

  • CPA
  • Experience in SaaS, technology, or multi‑product global companies.
  • Prior experience with Microsoft Dynamics, Netsuite, Oracle, Cognos

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
The Solera group is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

We've set the standard in kids entertainment. Come help us raise it.

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love. Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

You in? Keep on reading.

A hands-on technical artist who owns the path from finished 2D art and animation to working assets in Unity. They build the tools, standards, and validation that make handoffs reliable, keep templates and IP reskins fast, and help the team adopt AI-assisted workflows where they genuinely help.

The role

As Technical Artist, you will own the tooling and standards behind this journey. You'll work directly with discipline leads and Engineering to cut manual work, catch integration errors early, and make sure assets look and behave in playable builds as intended.

What you'll own

  • Evaluate the art and animation pipeline and technical stack, identify visual or creative requirements that existing workflows cannot support, and propose practical solutions or alternatives that align with production constraints.

  • Build and maintain tools: Write practical scripts, exporters, importers, and validation checks that remove repetitive work.

  • Define asset standards: Set conventions for structure, naming, export settings, versioning, and "ready for implementation" criteria.

  • Own Unity asset setup: Define how visual assets and animations are integrated efficiently in Unity, including prefabs, reusable configurations, and animation integration.

  • Validate in builds: Check that assets look and behave correctly on device, and diagnose visual defects, integration issues, and mobile performance problems.

  • Keep the pipeline healthy: Find bottlenecks, trace recurring issues to their root cause, and fix them across Art, Animation, Design, and Engineering.

  • Enable reuse: Structure assets, rigs, animations, and setups so they carry across games, levels, and IP reskins with minimal rework.

  • Evolve the workflow: Evaluate new tools and pipeline changes, including our exploration of a move from Adobe Animate to Spine, and help teams adopt them.

  • Introduce AI-assisted workflows: Identify where AI tools can safely speed up production, pilot them with the team, set guardrails for quality and licensed-IP use, and document what works.

  • Document and support: Write clear documentation, train colleagues, and make tools usable by people with different levels of technical confidence.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience integrating 2D art and animation into Unity for shipped or production-ready games.

  • Experience with node-based shader editors (e.g., Amplify Shader Editor, Shader Graph), including creating custom shaders and effects tailored to the creative needs of each project.

  • Solid understanding of Unity’s different render pipelines, including their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use cases.

  • A solid grasp of 2D asset and animation pipelines, such as preparing layered art (e.g. PSD or Animate files) for export, sprite or skeletal animation, and atlas packing.

  • Scripting ability to automate real production problems. We care more about how you solve them than which language you use. C# for Unity editor tooling is most relevant, and Python or similar for external automation is welcome. If you're strong in one, you can learn the other.

  • Practical troubleshooting skills: reproducing issues, isolating causes, and fixing them at the source.

  • An understanding of mobile performance constraints such as app size and download, memory, draw calls, texture sizes, and animation cost.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as coding assistants, to build or speed up production tools, with sound judgment about when output needs human review.

  • The ability to work with artists, animators, designers, and engineers, and to explain technical decisions to non-technical colleagues.

  • Comfort writing documentation and teaching others.

Nice to have skills

  • Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Animate workflows.

  • Asset localization experience: Text baked into art, font and glyph coverage, per-locale asset variants, and how they're packaged are TA problems.

  • Version control workflows for art assets.

  • Experience building small AI-assisted tools or automations that non-technical colleagues use day to day.

  • Experience in games for children, or with licensed IP and brand-approval constraints.

  • Experience with templated or reskinnable game systems.

  • High experience with Spine or another skeletal 2D animation tool.

English is a must:We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication, especially in asynchronous and long-form formats, is key to collaborating successfully.

Life at Lingokids

📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

🏡 Remote-Friendly: Work from where you’re most productive, home or our offices in Madrid, anywhere within a 2-hour difference from Spain (GMT+1). The choice is yours!

📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee, integrating them directly into your payroll.

🩺 Health Insurance: Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

🎉 Company events: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

Passion matters more than perfection

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

raw.description:
Teach AI to understand a company's revenue data, so marketers stop waiting for engineers.

At N.Rich, agents write most of the code. Engineers lead the agents and own the judgement: what to build, what not to build, and whether the answer is correct.

About N.Rich

N.Rich is the buildable ABM platform for B2B revenue teams. We find the accounts showing buying intent, put ads in front of them through our own DSP, and show sales when to move. More than 250 go-to-market teams use N.Rich, including GE HealthCare, JetBrains and Wärtsilä. We were founded in Helsinki in 2015.

Our newest product, N.Rich AI, is now the centre of the company. Teams describe what they need in plain language, and N.Rich AI builds a live app on their own data and acts on it.

  • One set of numbers: a governed data layer joins CRM, website, LinkedIn and ad data, so every app gives the same answer.

  • Proof of impact: it shows which programmes and channels created pipeline, reconciled to the customer's own reports.

  • Action: accounts an app finds become ad audiences or Salesforce and HubSpot lists, and results flow back in.

Why now

  • N.Rich AI solves the problem others avoid. Competitors use AI for small things, like more ad variations. N.Rich AI shows what marketing did for revenue, on numbers finance trusts.

  • The next few quarters decide the category. A lead like ours does not last forever. What you ship in your first months goes straight to customers.

  • We are opening the product up. Anyone can now try N.Rich AI without a sales call. Builders who share apps on it can join our partner programme. Every shared app brings in the next user.

  • We ship fast. The N.Rich AI playground went from idea on 17 September to a beta in production a month later. On 10 September the team said AI apps couldn't move between our EU and US regions. One week later, one-click transfer was live, with design and review.

Problems you will work on

  1. A semantic layer on clients' CRM data. Build it on top of clients' Salesforce and HubSpot data, so AI understands their business and can answer real questions about it.

  2. Our own AI harness for revenue teams. Marketers and sales people do things on their own that needed engineers before.

  3. Who is behind a website visit. Identify the people behind website visits with our own algorithms, on top of the data we already have.

How we work

Everyone at N.Rich works through their own AI system, not just engineers. We pay for models and tools from more than one provider, so you can experiment freely and use what fits each task best. Our team works from 20+ countries. You join an R&D team of 17 people (8 developers, 3 data scientists, QA, DevOps and design) and report to Anton, our CTO. You work closely with product and revenue.

You will fit if you

  • Have shipped projects that run in production with real users and real problems, and owned them from the goal to production.

  • Work every day through your own AI setup: agents connected to your tools, a model from another provider reviewing their work, repeated work turned into skills. For Tech lead, agents also keep working in the background. You will show it to us live.

  • Make technical decisions that still hold a year later, including "let's not build this".

  • Spot problems early, in or outside your area, and bring a fix.

  • Care who the work is for, and talk to product and revenue to find out.

You probably already have: 5+ years as a software engineer, strong experience in one popular language (TypeScript, Java or Python), SQL and relational databases, APIs, distributed systems basics, Docker and CI/CD, fluent English.

A bonus, not a must: agents, MCP servers or skills others use; LLM-based products; data and analytics platforms; marketing or ad tech; Salesforce or HubSpot integrations; event-driven systems.

This is not for you if you

  • Can't make decisions on your own.

  • Need a fixed roadmap and stable priorities.

  • Aren't ready to change fast.

  • Don't want to talk to clients.

What we expect from each other

Four values guide how we work. We call them C.O.R.E., and we hire, give feedback and grow against them.

  • Context & System Thinking. Know why the work matters before you start. Understand who it's for and what else it touches.

  • Ownership. Own the outcome, not the task. Raise risks early and take responsibility for the result, not the handoff.

  • Radical Candor. Challenge ideas directly and assume good intent. We keep problems small by talking about them early.

  • Execution at Scale. Be the lead engineer of your own agentic team. Frame the problem so software can solve it, ship the smallest useful version, check the result, and improve the system so it handles the problem next time.

From the team

  • "Join us to be on the frontier of the AI change instead of watching it from the sidelines. At N.Rich we expect everyone to become an engineer, and R&D is at the center of it." (Anton, CTO)

  • "What's different here is that we leverage AI at every step of building N.Rich AI, and engineers are responsible for the outcome. You decide how to solve the problem and take a feature all the way to production, with people who challenge ideas openly and care about the result." (Oleksiy, Senior Software Engineer)

Pay and terms

Per month. This is a contractor role. We place you in the range based on what you show us when we get to know each other.

  • Senior: up to €7,500 per month

  • Tech lead: up to €10,000 per month

You can work from anywhere within about 2 hours of CET. We can't contract in every country, so we confirm your location in the first talk. We pay for the tools you need to do the work, including AI models from more than one provider, so you pick what works best.

How we get to know each other

No take-home tasks. Apply with your CV or your LinkedIn profile.

  1. Intro call. A short call with our HR Director to get to know each other.

  2. Values conversation. How you work, talked through against our C.O.R.E. values.

  3. Technical prescreen. 30 minutes with Anton, our CTO.

  4. Technical interview. 2 hours. A technical task from our domain, worked through live on the call.

  5. Final talk with Anton. Only if we need it after the earlier steps.

In the application we ask one question: describe your AI setup. What does it connect to, who reviews the agents' work and how, and what are your main learnings?
