Join a team that shares your calling

At MultiCare, you’re more than a job title — you’re part of a collaborative team of physicians and advanced practice providers committed to patient-centered care. Here, your voice matters. You’ll have the support, resources and flexibility to practice at the top of your license, collaborate with experienced colleagues and make a meaningful impact. Build a long-term career in a system that grows with you, in a community that supports your life beyond work.

FTE: 0.7, Shift: Day, Schedule: Variable

Position Summary

Provides outpatient psychiatric consultation services including, but not limited to diagnostic, medication management, and therapeutic intervention recommendations. Supports various clinical teams which could include integrated mental health therapists, collaborative care teams, primary care providers, allied support staff and others. Other role responsibilities include providing the care team with educational support on diagnosing/ managing behavioral health conditions and providing diagnostic clarifying one-time psychiatric evaluations.

Responsibilities

  • Provides psychiatric evaluations when required to clarify treatment recommendations.
  • Provide regularly scheduled caseload consultation to Integrated Mental Health Therapist.
  • Completes all required documentation within timeframes specified in the MultiCare Health System Ambulatory Electronic Health Record Completion policy.
  • Demonstrates a positive attitude and efforts toward meeting the needs of internal and external customers.
  • Uses English effectively to send and receive messages, oral and written, in a clear, positive, prompt, and appropriate manner.
  • Attend and participate in team meetings and other agency meetings as requested.
  • Provides back-up coverage for absent medical staff as needed.
  • Works with Integrated Mental Health Therapist to oversee the status and population health of their assigned patient caseload.
  • Requires adherence to practice standards, agency standards, contracts, and Washington Administrative Codes.
  • May supervise graduate medical students (nurse practitioner students, residents).
  • Expert knowledge of psychotropic medications.
  • Experience in community mental health.
  • Able to effectively partner with severely and persistently mentally ill patients.
  • Basic computer and keyboard skills.
  • Excellent assessment, evaluation, and clinical skills.
  • Requires the ability to sit for prolonged periods.
  • Requires the willingness and ability to work varied hours when necessary.
  • Demonstrate effective de-escalation skills.  

Requirements

  • Meets state of Washington licensure requirements by the time of employment.
  • Advanced Reg Nurse Practitioner with prescriptive authority license - Washington Department of Health. 
  • American Nurses Credentialing Center Board Certification as a Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (Across the Lifespan) Certification (PMHNP-BC™) or if one of the following active certifications (available for renewal only).
  • Adult Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Certification (PMHNP-BC).
  • Child/Adolescent Psychiatric-Mental Health Clinical Nurse Specialist Certification (PMHCNS-BC) preferred.
  • Current Health Care Provider level BLS certification such as American Heart Association or American Red Cross.
  • DEA, NPI & prescriptive authority.

Why MultiCare?

Rooted in the local community

Partnering with patients, families and neighbors across the Pacific Northwest for more than 140 years.

Growth and education

Leadership development, mentorship and continued professional growth opportunities across a collaborative, integrated health system.

Well-being and support

Flexible scheduling, generous time off and MultiCare’s Physician & APP Well-Being Program support your well-being and help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Living our values

Respect, integrity, kindness and collaboration guide how we care for patients, communities and each other.

Belonging for all

A culture where providers feel heard, respected and part of the team from day one, supported by Resource Groups and outreach programs.

Pacific Northwest lifestyle

Work and live where natural beauty, adventure and strong community connections are part of everyday life.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

PFF Governance Intake & Coordination

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will manage the Flow Council operating process that launches with S/4HANA and supports its ongoing operation after go-live. The role coordinates governance intake, prepares decision-ready materials, maintains decisions and action tracking, and helps ensure requests reach the appropriate accountable product or functional owners.

The role also manages the PFF repository across all products. It maintains a reliable, searchable source for approved product documentation, decisions, requirements, process materials, standards, and other knowledge assets. The role uses approved AI tools to organize, tag, summarize, and retrieve repository content while maintaining content accuracy, access controls, version history, and clear ownership.

This Level 5A role provides disciplined coordination and operational support. It manages the governance process and repository practices, while product priorities and business decisions remain with the Flow Council and designated product and functional leads.

Key Responsibilities

Flow Council launch and operations

  • Coordinate the Flow Council operating model for S/4 go-live, including the agreed purpose, membership, cadence, submission process, meeting materials, decision records, and follow-up practices.
  • Maintain the Council calendar, collect agenda items, confirm owners and required inputs, prepare pre-reads, and coordinate meeting logistics.
  • Document decisions, actions, owners, due dates, risks, and dependencies. Maintain an accurate decision and action log and follow up on overdue items with accountable owners.
  • Support continuity from implementation governance into the version of the Flow Council that will operate with S/4, keeping governance materials and reference records current.

Governance intake and coordination

  • Manage a clear intake process for PFF product and cross-functional requests. Check submissions for required information and route them to the appropriate product, functional, or governance owner.
  • Track requests through review and decision, maintaining status, owner, due date, dependencies, and disposition. Escalate incomplete, overdue, or blocked items through agreed channels.
  • Prepare concise summaries of requests, options, impacts, and open questions so accountable leads can make timely decisions.
  • Coordinate follow-up across product leads, Governance Intake, change and training partners, and other stakeholders without taking ownership of their decisions.

PFF repository and AI-supported knowledge management

  • Manage the PFF repository across all products, maintaining a clear structure, taxonomy, metadata, access permissions, version history, and content lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with product and document owners to collect, review, publish, update, and archive approved product documentation, requirements, design decisions, process materials, controls, training content, and governance records.
  • Use approved AI tools to support content classification, metadata tagging, summarization, search, retrieval, and links between related PFF product materials.
  • Validate AI-generated tags, summaries, and retrieval results against source documents. Preserve source links, document owners, dates, and version information so users can verify current content.
  • Apply established information-handling and access rules when managing repository content and AI-supported workflows.

Documentation, automation, and performance

  • Standardize templates and documentation practices for governance intake, Council materials, decision records, and PFF product content.
  • Identify opportunities to automate routine intake, action tracking, document management, and repository tasks, including appropriate AI-enabled workflows.
  • Track governance and repository measures such as intake volume, aging actions, decision turnaround, content completeness, and review currency. Share status and improvement needs with the PFF Business Performance Lead.
  • Develop and maintain user guidance for submitting requests, finding approved materials, and following repository and Council procedures.

Key Accountabilities and Decision Rights

The role is accountable for reliable Flow Council coordination, consistent governance intake, accurate action and decision records, and a usable PFF repository across products. It may manage established procedures, content metadata and versioning, and routine request routing within agreed standards. It does not approve product priorities or make business decisions on behalf of the Flow Council or product owners. It escalates priority conflicts, governance exceptions, access concerns, or unresolved ownership issues to the accountable lead.


Key Capabilities

  • Governance coordination: Organize decision forums, manage submissions and materials, and maintain clear decisions, actions, owners, and due dates.
  • Repository and documentation management: Maintain structured, version-controlled content and practical documentation standards across multiple products.
  • AI-enabled knowledge work: Use approved AI tools to improve classification, search, summaries, and retrieval while checking outputs against source materials.
  • Execution and follow-through: Track commitments, dependencies, and overdue actions and raise issues through agreed channels.
  • Stakeholder communication: Work effectively with product leads, functional owners, SMEs, and business teams across a matrixed organization.
  • Process improvement: Identify ways to simplify governance and repository practices through standardization and automation.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a go getter with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of relevant experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of relevant experience
OR
Associate’s degree and 8 years of relevant experience
OR
High school diploma / GED and 10 years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting S/4HANA, PFF, product teams, or cross-functional governance forums.
  • Experience with enterprise content platforms such as SharePoint or similar repositories.
  • Experience using approved AI tools for knowledge organization, search, summarization, or workflow support.
  • Experience with action tracking, intake workflows, Jira or similar tools, and process automation.

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Senior SQL Developer
Finance Data & Systems Migration
Full-time / Remote

About the role

We are looking for a Senior SQL Developer to be a part of PROVE Partner's parent company Allira’s team (remote). We are making SQL the single source of truth for all of our data. Every report, reconciliation and financial statement will run from SQL, while Salesforce and Pulse remain our working systems and feed SQL, until better systems are identified. You will be the hands-on technical owner of the SQL platform. You will also scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs, build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, and manage the project day to day, working closely with Finance, Operations and our Salesforce team.

What you'll do

  • Scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs: data mapping, sequencing, effort, risks and cutover approach
  • Design and build the SQL data model: staging, cleansed core tables and reporting marts
  • Build and schedule data loads from Salesforce, Pulse, the general ledger, loans and the loan ledger, and other sources
  • Rebuild our Salesforce reports in SQL, including accruals, repayments, settlements, clearing reports and weekly journal entries
  • Write tie-out logic that reconciles SQL to the general ledger on every load and every close
  • Turn manual exception reports into automated data-quality checks and alerts
  • Produce credit facility, lender and investor reporting by entity and funding vehicle
  • Build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, with clear system-of-record and reconciliation rules
  • Manage the project: plan, timeline, status reporting, risks and coordination with Finance, Operations and the Salesforce team
  • Work with our Salesforce team on data mapping and on changes that affect SQL
  • Tune performance, manage code in source control, and document everything you build
  • Partner with the Controller and accounting team during month-end close

What you bring

  • Completed at least one project of similar scope from start to finish, such as a Salesforce-to-SQL migration that included reporting and finance close
  • Hands-on two-way integration experience: writing data from SQL to Salesforce and other systems (Salesforce APIs, Bulk API or middleware)
  • Project management skills: scoping, planning, running timelines and status, managing risks and stakeholders
  • 5+ years writing production SQL (T-SQL / SQL Server preferred): stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and query tuning
  • Experience building ETL / ELT pipelines (SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Fivetran or similar)
  • Dimensional modeling: fact and dimension tables, history tracking
  • Hands-on experience extracting and modeling Salesforce data
  • Strong understanding of accounting data: journal entries, accruals, trial balance, subledger-to-GL reconciliation
  • Experience supporting a financial close or building finance reporting
  • Clear communicator who can work directly with accountants and operations staff

Nice to have

  • Specialty finance, lending or asset management experience (advances, receivables, payoffs, fee accruals)
  • Credit facility, borrowing-base or static pool reporting
  • Power BI or SSRS report development
  • Salesforce administration or development experience
  • Git, CI/CD for database deployments
  • Project management certification (PMP or similar)

Why join

You'll build the data platform from the ground up and own it, with direct visibility to Finance leadership and a clear impact on how the firm closes its books.

ABOUT FREEDOM HEALTH SYSTEMS, LLC

Freedom Health Systems, LLC (FHS) is a mission-driven healthcare advisory and management consulting firm that partners with behavioral health and human services organizations to improve access, equity, and operational excellence. We specialize in guiding providers through program development, accreditation, compliance, and clinical best practices—empowering them to deliver high-quality, person-centered care to their communities.

While we do not provide direct healthcare services, FHS plays a vital role behind the scenes by strengthening organizational infrastructure, supporting service expansion, and helping our partners lead with innovation and integrity. Our expertise spans a wide range of operational services, including revenue cycle management, prior authorization, virtual front office support, medical billing and coding, human resources, and compliance consulting.

At FHS, we are deeply committed to breaking down barriers in the behavioral health space, with a particular focus on serving marginalized and underserved populations. Our team fosters a collaborative, forward-thinking work environment where every employee contributes to advancing impactful, community-based care.

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572

HUMAN RESOURCES DEPARTMENT PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572 EXT 10

HUMAN RESOURCES DEPARTMENT EMAIL ADDRESS:

POSITION TITLE: Productivity Monitoring Specialist

ALTERNATE TITLE(S):Scheduling Compliance Coordinator, Provider Productivity Analyst, Scheduling Compliance Analyst, Productivity Compliance Coordinator

COMPANY: Freedom Health Systems, LLC (in support of all customer companies under contract)

DIVISION: Operations

DEPARTMENT: Scheduling

UNIT: N/A

BENEFITS PACKAGE: Ineligible.

WORK SCHEDULE: Tuesday – Friday, 7:00 AM EST – 6:00 PM EST

ACCOUNTABLE TO:Scheduling Department Manager (Chief Operations Officer in the absence of the Scheduling Department Manager)

ACCOUNTABLE FOR: Tracking and reporting provider productivity across all service types, ensuring timely, accurate service delivery in accordance with client category requirements, and communicating compliance issues to providers and management for timely resolution.

CLASSIFICATION: W8BEN Hourly

COMPENSATION RANGE: ₱283.63 per hour

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: None

SUMMARY OF POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Productivity Monitoring Specialist is responsible for monitoring service delivery across all provider types to ensure alignment with client category-based service frequency requirements. This position plays a critical role in auditing, reporting, and communicating provider productivity to leadership, helping maintain compliance with agency standards and payer requirements. The specialist supports operational performance through data analysis, structured reporting, and timely communication with providers.

SCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitor provider productivity to ensure service delivery meets required frequency based on each client’s category type
  • Identify and report providers who fail to render services, and escalate to management for corrective action
  • Maintain accurate records of productivity issues in the Productivity Report tracker
  • Generate and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly productivity reports, highlighting rendered vs. scheduled services
  • Export and clean raw productivity data; use pivot tables and VLOOKUP to analyze provider performance
  • Email providers with compliance updates and follow up on unresolved productivity concerns
  • Rank providers based on service delivery compliance and include rankings in reports
  • Audit productivity data for the prior week, update tracking sheets, and filter for providers who rendered services to non-assigned clients
  • Maintain and update caseload assignments and productivity summaries to ensure audit-readiness and data accuracy
  • Identify and follow up with providers who:
    • Have no recorded client encounters for the prior week
    • Failed to schedule clients in ICANotes
    • Rendered services to clients not assigned to them
  • Log and track provider responses to productivity outreach emails
  • Generate and distribute reports including but not limited to:
    • Daily Reports: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioners’ end-of-day productivity summaries
    • Weekly Reports: Provider productivity rankings and progress updates
    • Monthly Reports: Full-month productivity summaries by provider type
    • Prescriber & HH RN Daily Reports: Scheduled vs. rendered comparison
    • Counselor & ECM Weekly Reports: Including rankings and service gaps

raw.description:
The Role:


The Cybersecurity Security Compliance Manager leads day-to-day delivery of cybersecurity compliance programs and assessment workstreams for clients operating within the Defense Industrial Base (DIB), federal marketplace, and regulated commercial environments. This role bridges strategic direction from the Senior Manager (ML6) and hands-on execution by Senior Consultants and Consultants. The Manager is accountable for delivery quality, schedule adherence, team performance, and client satisfaction at the workstream or program level.

Engagements will span CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 certification readiness and assessment support, FedRAMP authorization packages (Moderate and High baselines), NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) implementations, and security assessment and authorization (A&A) programs across Products industry clients — with initial demand concentrated in Aerospace & Defense and other highly regulated sectors.

The Manager interfaces directly with client program managers, Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), CISOs, and IT leadership, translating complex compliance requirements into practical delivery plans and guiding clients through regulatory processes with clarity and measurable progress.

What You'll Do:


• Manage end-to-end delivery of CMMC, FedRAMP, and NIST RMF compliance workstreams — including assessment planning, evidence collection coordination, gap analysis, remediation tracking, and documentation review through completion

• Develop and maintain detailed delivery plans, milestone schedules, resource assignments, and RACI matrices aligned to client program timelines and C3PAO or agency assessment deadlines

• Lead client-facing workshops, technical working sessions, status briefings, and executive readouts — communicating progress, risks, and decisions clearly to program and senior leadership

• Guide clients through CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 scoping — including CUI identification, in-scope asset definition, assessment boundary documentation, and C3PAO engagement preparation

• Oversee development and quality review of core compliance artifacts — System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), authorization packages, and Control Implementation Summary (CIS) documents

• Coordinate directly with client ISSOs, Information System Security Managers (ISSMs), system owners, and technical SMEs to resolve compliance issues and maintain program momentum

• Support FedRAMP boundary definition, system characterization, and authorization package development — including Agency and JAB authorization path activities

• Identify, document, and manage program risks, issues, and dependencies — escalating material issues to the Senior Manager with recommended resolution approaches

• Review and approve deliverables produced by Senior Consultants, and Consultant for technical accuracy, quality, and alignment to engagement standards

• Mentor junior team members, providing technical coaching on CMMC practices, NIST SP 800-53 and SP 800-171 control frameworks, FedRAMP documentation requirements, and A&A methodology

• Contribute to proposal development, solution scoping, and staffing model design for new or expanding compliance engagements

• Develop reusable delivery accelerators, assessment templates, and methodology documentation that strengthen and scale the Security Compliance practice


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need:


  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including a minimum of 2 years in a role with direct project, workstream, or team leadership accountability in a client-facing or delivery context — experience must include planning, managing, and delivering complex work products, not solely technical or individual contributor activitie
  • Minimum of 5 years of direct, hands-on experience supporting cybersecurity compliance, assessment, or authorization programs involving one or more of the following: CMMC (Level 1 or Level 2), FedRAMP (Moderate or High baseline), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, or NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) — general NIST CSF awareness alone does not satisfy this requirement
  • Minimum of 5 years experience in a relevant Products industry environment (Aerospace & Defense, Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Industrial, or similarly regulated sector) with demonstrated understanding of industry-specific regulatory requirements, compliance drivers, and client operating environments
  • Minimum of 5 years demonstrated ability to develop and execute delivery plans, manage risks and issues, maintain delivery quality, and communicate status across complex, multi-stakeholder engagements
  • Minimum of 5 years working knowledge of CMMC scoping guidance, CMMC Practice requirements (Levels 1 and 2), and the Cyber AB ecosystem — including the roles of OSCs, C3PAOs, RPOs, Registered Practitioners (RPs), and Registered Practitioner Advanced (RPA) within the CMMC certification and advisory landscape
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years work experience; Associate's Degree + minimum 6 years work experience)

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Familiarity with federal cybersecurity policy — including DFARS 252.204-7012, FISMA, CUI handling requirements (32 CFR Part 2002), and OMB guidance applicable to contractor and agency compliance obligations
  • CMMC Registered Practitioner Advanced (RPA) — issued by the Cyber AB, reflecting advanced training and formal registration as a senior CMMC advisor and implementation specialist; or CMMC Certified Assessor (CCA) for candidates with an assessment-focused background
  • CMMC Registered Practitioner (RP) — entry-level Cyber AB practitioner credential, demonstrating formal CMMC advisory training; considered if RPA or CCA not yet obtained
  • CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CGRC, or equivalent senior professional certification
  • FedRAMP authorization support experience — including package component development (SSP, SAP, SAR, CIS, CRM) and direct experience with Agency or JAB authorization workflows
  • DoD and Defense Industrial Base (DIB) sector experience — including familiarity with CMMC implementation across prime contractors and supply chains, DFARS clause compliance, and CUI safeguarding obligations
  • Experience with GRC and compliance management platforms such as Archer, ServiceNow GRC, ZenGRC, Drata, Vanta, or equivalent evidence management and program tracking tools
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams) and project or task tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Planner, or similar)
  • AI security experience where it relates to compliance automation, AI-assisted evidence analysis, risk identification, or secure AI adoption in regulated program environments
  • Strong executive communication skills — able to present complex compliance topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at client senior leadership and C-suite levels
  • Prior consulting or professional services experience in a client-facing delivery role

Customer Service Representative

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a friendly, organized, and customer-focused Customer Service Representative to support customers throughout their post-purchase experience, from production and shipping to delivery and installation.

You’ll serve as the main point of contact for customer inquiries, providing timely updates, answering product and installation questions, coordinating with internal teams and shipping providers, and resolving order-related issues. The ideal candidate combines excellent communication skills with strong follow-through and a commitment to delivering a positive customer experience.

What You’ll Own

Customer Communication & Order Updates

  • Keep customers informed about production progress, shipment tracking, delivery schedules, and installation instructions.
  • Monitor shipments and notify customers on the expected delivery date.
  • Respond to customer inquiries promptly and professionally.
  • Follow up proactively to ensure customers know what to expect at every stage.

Product Support & Installation Assistance

  • Answer product and installation questions using available resources and approved guidance.
  • Help troubleshoot installation issues and coordinate with technical staff when additional support is needed.
  • Explain instructions clearly and help customers understand the next steps.

Customer Issue Resolution

  • Handle reports of damaged shipments by gathering photos, details, and relevant order information.
  • Coordinate claims, replacement parts, and other resolutions with the appropriate teams and providers.
  • Respond to frustrated customers calmly and professionally, focusing on practical solutions.
  • Track outstanding issues and follow through until they are resolved.

Order Coordination & Recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate customer records, order details, shipment information, and communication history.
  • Follow established procedures and ensure important details are documented.
  • Coordinate with sales representatives, manufacturers, shipping providers, and technical staff.
  • Keep all parties informed to help prevent delays and ensure a smooth customer experience.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, with a warm and patient approach.
  • Familiarity with construction, home remodeling, installation, or related terminology.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Ability to follow established procedures while recognizing when an issue needs escalation.
  • Comfort learning product details and explaining instructions to customers.
  • Familiarity with customer management systems, email, and spreadsheets.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to work consistently from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting customers in shades, windows, home improvement, or building products.
  • Experience with shipping, logistics, order tracking, or fulfillment coordination.
  • Experience handling damaged deliveries, replacement requests, or shipping claims.
  • Experience coordinating between customers, vendors, and technical teams.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You communicate clearly and make customers feel supported, even when problems arise.
  • You take ownership of customer requests and follow through without needing repeated reminders.
  • You stay organized while managing multiple inquiries, orders, and delivery timelines.
  • You remain calm and solution-oriented when dealing with delays, complaints, or unexpected issues.
  • You know when to resolve a problem independently and when to involve the appropriate team.
  • You are proactive about updates and understand the importance of keeping customers informed.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers receive timely, accurate updates throughout the production and delivery process.
  • Delivery expectations and installation instructions are communicated clearly.
  • Customer issues are documented, escalated when necessary, and followed through to resolution.
  • Internal teams and external partners stay aligned on outstanding orders and customer needs.
  • Customers experience a smooth, organized, and professional support experience.

  • Initial Screening

Make an Impact as a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager at Worldwide


As a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager, you'll play a critical role in advancing key information security initiatives that support business goals, regulatory commitments, and risk reduction objectives. Working within the Governance, Risk and Compliance team and reporting to the Senior Director of Governance, Risk and Compliance, you'll lead complex programs that drive meaningful security and operational outcomes across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you'll provide end-to-end leadership for a portfolio of information security and GRC programs, guiding strategy, governance, planning, execution, and long-term adoption. You'll partner closely with leaders across the Office of the CISO, Information Technology, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, and other business functions to ensure programs deliver measurable value and sustainable results.

Your ability to bring structure to complex initiatives, align diverse stakeholders, and provide clear executive-level insights will help strengthen security capabilities and support continued organizational success.


Where You'll Work


This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do


  • Lead multiple information security and GRC programs from strategy and planning through delivery, operational transition, and benefits realization.
  • Develop and maintain multi-year program roadmaps aligned to security priorities, regulatory requirements, audit commitments, and business objectives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, steering forums, escalation paths, and delivery standards that enable effective program execution.
  • Manage program scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and change activities across multiple workstreams.
  • Partner with project managers, workstream leaders, and vendors to ensure alignment, accountability, and successful delivery outcomes.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Information Security, IT, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, Procurement, Clinical Operations, and business teams.
  • Deliver concise, decision-focused reporting to executive leadership, including portfolio status, risks, forecasts, financials, and key milestones.
  • Oversee vendor performance, program financials, stakeholder engagement, adoption planning, and operational readiness activities.
  • Define and monitor program success metrics, risk indicators, and benefits realization while continuously improving governance and delivery practices.

What You'll Bring


  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business, Project or Program Management, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Five or more years of progressive project and program management experience, including ownership of multiple concurrent information security or cybersecurity programs.
  • Proven experience leading security programs end-to-end, including strategy, governance, planning, execution, financial oversight, executive reporting, operational transition, and benefits realization.
  • Experience delivering security initiatives such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, security operations, cloud security, data protection, third-party risk, compliance remediation, security tooling, or security transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of program and project management disciplines, including portfolio governance, budgeting, resource management, vendor management, risk management, and benefits tracking.
  • Working knowledge of information security frameworks, controls, risk management principles, and security operations, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, workstream leads, project managers, and vendors within a matrixed environment; experience in regulated industries such as clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or pharmaceuticals is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in English, along with excellent written, verbal, facilitation, negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills; PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or similar certifications are preferred.

Who we are

We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our team of agents helps Compliance and People leaders run proactive Compliance programs that drive real behavior change.

From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. Hotline and training data rolls up into fully customizable, board-ready risk reports. Our AI call taker synthesizes data to recommend improvements to company policies and training. Every signal lands in one place, so Compliance leaders can spot risk early and fix it before it becomes a problem. The agents do the legwork, and people make every judgment call.

More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to desktop workers. Learners give our training a 93% approval rating, 96% of customers renew, and our business is growing quickly with 50%+ YoY revenue growth.

Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.

How we work

We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Principal Recruiter who loves the craft of recruiting and wants to do it at the highest level.

You’ll own full-cycle hiring across every team at Ethena, from Sales and CS to Product and G&A, and at every level, from entry-level roles to executive leaders. You’ll be a true strategic partner to our hiring managers. You’ll get deep on what each team is building, partner with them on turning their needs into a smart recruiting plan, and bring them rockstar candidates. You’ll move fast, keep everyone in the loop, and never trade quality for speed. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with lots of autonomy, reporting to our Chief People Officer.

If you get excited about finding the perfect person for a team and running a great process from start to finish, we’d love to meet you.

What you’ll do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across every function and level, from first conversation to signed offer.

  • Partner with each hiring manager to build the plan for every role from A to Z, including the right level and candidate profile, the interview structure, what each interviewer should assess, and a realistic timeline.

  • Get deep on the business. Learn where each team is headed, what their top priorities are, and what great looks like in the role, so you can speak to it and sell it with confidence.

  • Source like an expert. Balance inbound applicants and active outreach, and decide for yourself how to split your effort on each role to get the best outcome quickly.

  • Screen with a high bar, so every candidate who reaches a hiring manager is an obvious yes for a conversation and it’s clear why you passed them along.

  • Help hiring managers sell the role well and ask the right questions, so we land great people and make smart, well-informed hiring decisions.

  • Bring market insight back to the team, from comp trends to talent availability, and adjust the strategy when the data says we should.

  • Keep momentum high. Give hiring managers regular, clear updates so they always know where their pipeline stands and feel confident it’s moving in the right direction.

  • Run a full-service process, including scheduling your own interviews, coordinating loops, and making sure every candidate has a great experience with Ethena.

What makes a great candidate

  • You’re a career recruiter who has owned full-cycle searches across a wide range of functions, including Sales, CS, Product, and G&A.

  • You’ve recruited at every level, from entry-level hires to executive leaders, and you’ve been a trusted partner to senior leaders on their most important hires.

  • You’ve done in-house recruiting at a high-growth, early stage tech startup, and you know how to keep quality high while the business moves fast.

  • You’re an expert sourcer who’s as comfortable building a pipeline from scratch as you are working through inbound applicants.

  • You’re genuinely curious about the business. You want to understand each team’s strategy and priorities because it makes you a better recruiter.

  • You adapt your communication style and way of working to each hiring manager, from the founder who wants a quick daily ping to the leader who wants a detailed weekly pipeline review.

  • You’re relentless about filling roles quickly without lowering the bar.

  • You’re proactive with updates, so hiring managers never have to chase you to know where things stand.

  • You’re highly autonomous and happy to roll up your sleeves, from writing outreach to scheduling interviews.

  • You’re AI-native. You already use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to recruit efficiently and amplify your impact, and you’d rather build a tool than add a manual step.

  • This role isn’t for you if you want to build and manage a team of recruiters, specialize in one function or level, or hand off the coordination and scheduling side of the process.

At Ethena, we're committed to fair and equitable compensation. We carefully evaluate each candidate's skills and qualifications to provide our best possible offer upfront. Our no-negotiation policy ensures that our first offer is always our best offer, promoting pay equity throughout our organization.

Physical Demands

This is sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing in a home office environment.

Location

Ethena is a remote-first organization and is currently hiring candidates based in the United States.

We’re big fans of AI and use it heavily in our day-to-day work. If you have questions or need accommodations, we’re happy to chat — just let us know.

How to Apply

Applications for this position will be accepted via our job board. Excited about the opportunity, but worried you don’t meet all the requirements? Apply anyway, and give us both the chance to find out. We welcome you to read more about our approach to job descriptions by our Chief People Officer, Melanie Naranjo. Curious to know what it’s like to interview with us? Read more here.

The Decision Advantage Business Area within Defense at Leidos is looking for a highly qualified Secret cleared Cyber Integration Deputy Team Lead.

This is an exciting opportunity to bring your experience to support all-domain large-scale weapon systems, Information Technology Systems, and Command and Control Systems to realize the Department of Defense Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2). In this role, you will support the Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS) Digital Infrastructure (DI) Processing Node (PN) team to design and implement solutions that can be delivered at speed, scale, and with the necessary security to deliver operational advantages to the joint warfighter. ABMS is a top modernization priority for the Department of the Air Force and will be the backbone of a network-centric approach to battle management in partnership with all the services across JADC2. This position will work closely with Program Managers, domain engineers, and Government counterparts across Government and Industry partners.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provides technical expertise and leadership on cyber implementation for development projects and acts as a backup to the Cyber Integration Team Lead.
  • Provides oversight to changes in hardware, software, or network configuration and implements best practices in securing the infrastructure.
  • Provides guidance to team members to ensure efforts align with the goals set forth by the Cyber Integration Team Lead.
  • Works on cybersecurity items and system bug resolution as required.
  • Implements highly technical solutions using various advanced technologies.
  • Assists in managing and monitoring Jira tasking and artifacts.
  • Coordinates with the Cyber Integration Team Lead to plan and assign work.

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8-12 years relevant experience and at least 3 years experience leading highly technical, diverse, and decentralized team. Additional years of experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Active and current Secret clearance with ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI.
  • Knowledge of security principles and practices for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), using tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed security practices and testing into the continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline.
  • Experience with Tenable Nessus, Nessus Manager, and Tenable.sc, or other vulnerability scanning and management.
  • Basic working knowledge of DISA STIGs, including the ability to apply, verify, and document compliance.
  • Experience conducting and documenting threat modeling exercises.
  • Experience with RHEL and/or Windows and/or Network Device hardening and vulnerability management. Basic fluency in each operating system.
  • Proven collaborator with excellent communication skills, able to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • DoD 8570 Level 2 certified
  • Familiarity with Agile Management to include use of JIRA.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Integration of cyber requirements with new technologies, such as Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC).
  • Experience in managing eMASS and Xacta RMF packages and associated artifacts from initiation through continuous monitoring.
  • Knowledge of Classified Cloud Environments and the Shared Responsibility Model.
  • Other relevant cybersecurity certifications like SSCP, CCSP, CEH, PenTest+, Cloud+, GIAC, GCED, GCIH or CySA+ are a plus.
  • Background in implementing, fielding, and authorizing CDS solutions.
  • TS/SCI clearance.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing direct reports and teams of experienced consultants that include managers and consultants.

  • Experience developing, designing. and executing qualitative and quantitative market research.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Advanced degree preferred (e.g., MBA, MPH, MS, PhD).

  • Excellent project managers, strong team players, take initiative, and think strategically and creatively.

  • Keen attention to detail.

  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, able to clearly communicate clinical and business implications of technically complex products and services.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Senior Frontend Technical Lead — React & Integrations

Location preference: Denver, CO (Open for Remote)

Position Summary

  • We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Web Developer – React / Node.js to take ownership of web application architecture, hands-on development, and technical delivery for a high-impact web team. This is a hands-on coding role requiring deep expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Express, along with the ability to guide developers, make sound architecture decisions, and deliver scalable, production-grade web applications.
  • In this role, you will lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of web applications integrated with restaurant technology ecosystems, while partnering closely with clients, product teams, IT leadership, marketing, and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of scalable web applications.
  • Own and drive the overall web application architecture, frontend strategy, and technical roadmap.
  • Actively code features and user stories, review code, resolve defects, and provide hands-on support throughout delivery.
  • Develop and maintain multiple pages and application experiences using React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and Express.
  • Design scalable React applications using modern frontend architecture principles, including headless architecture, atomic design, state management, API integration, error handling, and performance optimization.
  • Integrate web applications with restaurant technology ecosystems, including:
  • Online ordering platforms
  • POS systems
  • Payment providers
  • Loyalty and rewards platforms
  • Customer identity and authentication solutions
  • Location services
  • Push notifications
  • Promotions and offers
  • Analytics and customer engagement platforms
  • Apply end-to-end solution thinking to ensure frontend decisions support backend services, databases, reporting, accounting, and downstream business processes.
  • Lead third-party integrations involving POS platforms, payment systems, commerce platforms, and other business-critical external systems.
  • Identify technical gaps, challenge assumptions, guide developers, review designs and code, and make decisions based on the complete solution.
  • Assess delivery risks, manage technical dependencies, coordinate testing, and prepare applications for production releases.
  • Partner effectively with IT Directors, Product Management, Marketing, and development team members to plan roadmaps and deliver solutions.
  • Establish and promote coding standards, development best practices, architecture patterns, documentation practices, and technical guidelines.
  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code with a focus on consistency and long-term maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and optimize existing applications.
  • Ensure application performance, quality, responsiveness, availability, and customer experience.
  • Monitor application performance, crashes, availability, and customer experience metrics using tools such as DataDog, Splunk, App Insights, New Relic, or similar platforms.
  • Support CI/CD practices and contribute to efficient release processes.
  • Develop and maintain unit testing frameworks and quality practices.
  • Apply knowledge of application security and networking to build reliable, secure solutions.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and modern engineering practices to support continuous innovation.
  • Bring a consulting mindset, strong client communication, and effective presentation skills to technical discussions and delivery engagements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software or web development experience, including significant experience building production-grade web applications.
  • 5+ years of recent hands-on coding experience with React.js; coding assessment will be conducted.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years in a Lead Web Developer, Tech Lead, or similar technical leadership role.
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js and Express.
  • 3+ years of experience leading and mentoring Developers and Senior Developers.
  • 2+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining multi-page applications in React.js.
  • Full stack familiarity, including backend technologies such as Node.js and related services.
  • Strong experience with HTML5, CSS, and CSS preprocessors such as LESS and SASS.
  • Advanced knowledge of command line build utilities and task runners such as npm, webpack, grunt, and gulp.
  • Advanced knowledge of accessibility standards.
  • Real-time working experience with asynchronous requests, API integrations, partial page updates, SEO optimization, SSR, and page performance troubleshooting and optimization.
  • Expert-level understanding of version control systems, including Git.
  • Proven experience with CI/CD practices.
  • Track record developing unit testing frameworks.
  • Competency in application security and networking.
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud Functions.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and planning technical roadmaps.
  • Ability to assess risks, manage dependencies, coordinate testing, and support successful production releases.
  • Strong documentation discipline, commitment to consistency and reusability, and the ability to see the big picture.
  • Strong consulting, client communication, and presentation skills.
  • Practical judgment, attention to scope management, and a collaborative approach to solving delivery challenges.
  • Experience integrating restaurant POS platforms is a plus.
  • Experience in restaurant technology, retail, hospitality, or e-commerce is a plus.

The base salary for this position is $106,087 to $140,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

Global Supply Chain Manager

Remote

Secret clearance


Behind every “can’t fail” mission is a supplier who delivered. You’re the one who makes sure they do.


A radar program is racing toward a milestone. A critical RF component is running behind. A subcontract worth millions sits at the center of it all, with compliance clauses to honor, a supplier to negotiate with, and a program manager waiting on answers. Your team is already working the problem.

You step in, align the stakeholders, and turn a risk into a plan. The mission stays on schedule because the supply chain behind it held. That’s a day in the life of a Manager, Global Supply Chain at Leidos.


Your greatest work is ahead

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people, who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.


The Role

Leidos’ Defense Sector is seeking a Global Supply Chain Manager to join our team. Occasional travel may be required for in-person engagements with internal customers and suppliers across multiple Leidos sites. This high-impact role reports directly to the Director, Global Supply Chain, and serves as an integrated member of the Defense Contracts and Supply Chain organization.


You’ll manage a team of Subcontracts professionals, provide strategic leadership, and act as a key interface between Leidos management and senior Contracts and Global Supply Chain management. You’ll serve as the primary liaison between subcontractors and multiple programs, contractually managing agreements of various types, typically of high dollar value, risk, and complexity. This role is ideal for a strategic supply chain leader who thrives in complex, government-regulated environments and understands how supplier ecosystems support mission-critical defense objectives.


You’ll collaborate closely with Contracts, Program Management, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Manufacturing, Growth, and Business Development, among others, to ensure the successful execution of your assigned portfolio. In addition to leading the team, you may have the opportunity to directly manage subcontracts on select programs when needed or help with special projects and corporate initiatives. You’ll align subcontract outcomes with program, business area, and sector objectives, communicate effectively, manage your time efficiently, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines with minimal supervision, and bring acute attention to detail. The ideal candidate is adaptable, capable of working independently, and willing to go beyond to ensure the success of both their team and their individual contributions.


If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading.


Why it Matters

Leidos’ Defense Sector provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission command and control, and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. Explore more here.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • The position requires great business acumen and the demonstration of sound judgment with a high level of ethics.
  • Manage the team’s workload, make assignments and set clear expectations, hold staff accountable to commitments and goals, oversee the quality of work under your responsibility, conduct performance reviews, and develop and encourage your team to perform at a high level.
  • Apply thorough knowledge of federal subcontracting and experience providing creative solutions to business and program requirements, while ensuring compliance with all prime customer requirements and commitments.
  • Lead negotiations and execution of strategic long-term agreements with key suppliers to support supply continuity, affordability, innovation, and long-term procurement savings.
  • Collaborate with Contracts, Supply Chain, Business Development, Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, and other stakeholders to integrate supplier strategies early in capture, proposal, and program lifecycles.
  • Identify and mitigate complex issues or risks for the managed subcontract portfolio.
  • Translate supplier data into executive-ready insights, recommendations, and action plans that enable measurable savings, stronger supplier performance, improved compliance, and reduced Sector risk.

Basic Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 5+ years of prior relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of prior relevant experience. Generally has 2+ years of experience supervising or leading teams or projects. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Active and current Secret clearance (must be US Citizen).
  • Experience awarding and managing subcontracts in a government-approved purchasing system (CPSR), including an advanced knowledge of the requirements of the FAR/DFARS, other Federal agency requirements, and small business participation.
  • Successful background of using negotiating skills to maximize organizational return, minimize risk, and improve price and terms and conditions position.
  • Successful track record of managing a variety of subcontract types and interfacing with internal customers, other functional support staff, and suppliers.
  • Experience independently leading the subcontracts portion of proposal efforts.
  • Organizational skills to manage concurrent projects, and the business acumen to appropriately prioritize actions and deal effectively with subcontract management issues of varying degrees of complexity.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, including presenting status updates and issues to senior management, internal partners, and suppliers.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US DoW security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience supporting Department of Defense and Federal programs, programs of record, capture pursuits, and proposal development for large government acquisitions in the Defense/Aerospace industry.
  • Working knowledge of CPSR compliance, NIST SP 800-171, and cyber/supplier readiness requirements.
  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement methodologies.
  • CPSM, CPC, CFCM, ISM, APICS, PMI PMP, or other relevant professional certification.
  • Experience working with RF, electronic warfare, missile, radar, SATCOM, aviation, space, manufacturing, or advanced defense technology supply chains.
  • Experience building strong supplier relationships that can be leveraged to assist in future issue resolution.
  • Experience supervising or leading a team(s).
  • Working experience with ERP systems, ideally Deltek Costpoint and other procurement systems (e.g., Ivalua).

Global Supply Chain

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Job Title:

Senior Partner Marketing Manager

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.
Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

About the Role


The Senior Manager, Partner Marketing & Executive Engagement will lead marketing strategy and activation across a portfolio of strategic partners. This role will translate partner relationships into integrated marketing programs, executive engagement opportunities, stronger market positioning, and measurable business outcomes.

This individual will collaborate across marketing, partner sales, alliances, sectors, sales teams, and partner organizations to develop joint plans, manage partner investments, activate executive-level programs, and connect partner marketing activity to business priorities.

The partner portfolio may include organizations such as Microsoft, Adobe, AWS, Genesys, NiCE, Salesforce, Databricks, and other strategic ecosystem partners.

The ideal candidate understands complex partner ecosystems, has strong executive presence, and can move effectively between strategy and execution. This person will turn partner priorities into focused programs that generate engagement, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy and Planning

  • Serve as the primary marketing lead for an assigned portfolio of strategic partners.
  • Develop annual and quarterly joint marketing plans aligned with business priorities, industry strategies, and go-to-market motions.
  • Prioritize programs, resources, and investments based on strategic fit and expected business impact.
  • Establish regular planning, performance review, and optimization processes with internal and partner stakeholders.

Integrated Partner Marketing

  • Develop and execute integrated campaigns across content, digital, social, webinars, thought leadership, account-based marketing, executive engagement, and events.
  • Define clear objectives, audiences, budgets, success measures, and follow-up strategies for each program.
  • Coordinate activation across field marketing, digital, content, communications, creative, sales, alliances, and sector teams.
  • Create scalable marketing frameworks while tailoring programs to each partner’s priorities.

Executive Engagement and Partner Events

  • Own the executive engagement strategy for assigned partner relationships.
  • Develop high-touch experiences that connect Concentrix executives, partner executives, clients, and priority prospects.
  • Lead the strategy for executive roundtables, private dinners, briefings, forums, advisory programs, conferences, and other curated experiences.
  • Define the business objectives, audience strategy, partner involvement, executive participation, messaging, and content direction for each program.
  • Evaluate sponsorship and event opportunities based on audience quality, account alignment, executive participation, and expected business value.
  • Partner with field marketing and event teams on project management, logistics, production, and onsite execution.

Partner Investment and MDF

  • Manage partner marketing budgets, market development funds, co-investment, and partner-funded initiatives.
  • Develop joint marketing proposals tied to defined business objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Track funding requirements, approvals, utilization, program performance, and return on investment.
  • Recommend adjustments based on results, business priorities, and partner opportunities.

Sales, Alliance, and Sector Alignment

  • Work closely with partner sales, alliance leaders, sales teams, sectors, and solution teams to translate business priorities into actionable marketing programs.
  • Align programs to jointly identified accounts, opportunities, solutions, and growth motions.
  • Provide sellers and partner teams with the messaging, content, event information, and enablement required to support activation.
  • Establish processes for follow-up, lead handoff, opportunity tracking, and outcome reporting.
  • Maintain clear accountability across marketing, sales, alliances, and event operations.

Measurement and Optimization

  • Track performance across partner marketing and executive engagement programs.
  • Measure results such as executive engagement, meetings generated, target-account participation, opportunities influenced, pipeline impact, campaign engagement, event performance, and MDF utilization.
  • Provide clear reporting, insights, and recommendations to improve future programs and investment decisions.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in partner marketing, alliance marketing, ecosystem marketing, executive engagement, field marketing, or a related B2B marketing role.
  • Experience managing marketing strategy across multiple strategic partners or alliance relationships.
  • Proven success developing integrated marketing and executive engagement programs.
  • Experience managing MDF, co-marketing investments, sponsorships, or partner-funded initiatives.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect marketing activity to accounts, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex programs across a matrixed organization.
  • Strong executive communication, relationship management, and stakeholder leadership skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong program management, budget management, judgment, and attention to detail.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with strategic technology and ecosystem partners such as Microsoft, Adobe, AWS, Genesys, NiCE, Salesforce, Databricks, or similar organizations.
  • Prior experience in sales, business development, or a commercially focused role is highly valued, particularly for candidates who can translate sales priorities into effective partner marketing programs.
  • Experience in technology services, customer experience, consulting, AI, cloud, or digital transformation.
  • Experience developing executive programs and high-touch client experiences.
  • Experience supporting account-based marketing and industry-specific go-to-market initiatives.
  • Experience evaluating sponsorships, conferences, and strategic event investments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clear annual and quarterly plans across the partner portfolio.
  • Strong alignment across marketing, partner sales, alliances, sectors, and sales teams.
  • High-quality executive programs tied to defined audiences and business priorities.
  • Increased visibility and accountability across partner investments.
  • Effective MDF and partner-funding utilization.
  • Measurable engagement, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline associated with partner marketing activity.
  • A scalable operating model that supports current and future strategic partners.
  • Stronger positioning of Concentrix as a strategic business and transformation partner.

The annual base salary range for this role is $86,400 to $97,200 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays.

We are currently recruiting for an Associate Director, US Oncology Marketing, Launch Excellence & Capabilities for the US Oncology sac-TMT Portfolio Strategy & Capabilities Team.


This role leads cross-tumor launch excellence and organizational capabilities for sac-TMT, an asset with multiple anticipated indications. It drives integrated launch readiness, One our company Marketing (OMM) capability delivery, enterprise launch transformation, and helps shape the future Customer Agile Team (CAT) model. Working closely with the Associate Director for key accounts and portfolio strategy, it builds the shared processes and ways of working that align tumor teams around consistent practices and let tumor leaders focus on their launches.


As marketing roles across US Oncology continue to evolve, this position is flexible and may focus on different aspects of oncology commercialization over time, based on business needs and portfolio evolution.


Key Responsibilities:


Our company Marketing Capabilities and Launch Transformation:


  • Lead OMM capability planning, integration, and adoption across sac-TMT, translating enterprise capabilities into practical ways of working for tumor teams.
  • Manage the pan-tumor web and interactive visual aid (IVA) backlog with the Product Owner and content, creative, and agency partners, building timely, compliant shared assets once for reuse across tumor types.
  • Serve as the sac-TMT integration lead for enterprise launch transformation, managing milestones, dependencies, and handoffs to tumor teams, and tracking launch excellence measures such as milestone delivery, dependency resolution, and capability adoption.

Customer Agile Team Effectiveness and Cross-Functional Leadership:


  • Support future Customer Agile Team model planning as new tumor teams are established (team design, operating cadence, governance), and monitor team health to drive ways-of-working improvements across the sac-TMT organization.
  • Champion Agile marketing practices, coaching teams on planning, prioritization, and delivery discipline.
  • Build alignment across Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Legal, and other partners, and communicate launch status, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leaders.

Portfolio-Level Launch Excellence:


  • Maintain the asset-level view of launch readiness across sac-TMT tumor teams, including an integrated cross-tumor launch calendar and a shared dependency and risk view that surfaces conflicts, sequencing tradeoffs, and shared needs early and brings options to leadership.
  • Coordinate with tumor teams, Sales leadership, and the Field Execution Lead to keep sales meeting content, field training, and timing consistent across tumors and aligned with the overall sac-TMT launch plan, while tumor teams retain ownership of execution.
  • Coordinate tri-semester business reviews so customers and field teams hear one clear, integrated sac-TMT story across indications and channels.
  • Develop and continuously improve a repeatable sac-TMT launch playbook that standardizes common processes, identifies shared needs and build-once opportunities across tumors to reduce duplication and cost, and incorporates lessons learned from each launch.

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree.
  • Preferred: Advanced degree, such as an MBA, PharmD, PhD, MPH, or equivalent.

Required Experience and Skills:


  • Minimum five years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry, including marketing, launch planning, commercial operations, or related commercial roles.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating product launch readiness across cross-functional workstreams, with strong program management skills and a track record of managing complex timelines, dependencies, and risks.
  • Hands-on experience with OMM capabilities, Customer Agile Teams, or a directly comparable enterprise Agile marketing model.
  • Experience developing promotional materials and navigating Legal, Regulatory, and Medical review processes while managing multiple priorities and critical milestones.
  • Ability to lead without authority, drive alignment across matrix organizations, and communicate effectively with senior leaders, with excellent organizational and presentation skills.

Preferred Experience and Skills:


  • U.S. Oncology marketing experience, including alliance partnerships.
  • Oncology launch experience, including multi-indication or portfolio launches.
  • Experience with omnichannel delivery or digital workstreams such as web and interactive visual aids.
  • Sales or field-facing experience, including sales meeting planning or field training.
  • Experience with antibody-drug conjugates or other targeted oncology therapies.

Agile Marketing, Change Management, Cross-Functional Leadership, Data-Driven Decision-Making, Executive Presence, Field Sales Enablement, Healthcare Marketing, Launch Readiness, Omnichannel Marketing, Operational Excellence, Program Management, Risk Management, Strategic Prioritization.
