Job Title:

Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Bilingual

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver the latest technology infrastructure, transformative software solutions and industry-leading global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement and strategize IT, security, application development, innovation, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the technology team that is core to our vision of develop, build and run the future of Integrated Services.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll play a strategic role in shaping and scaling our DevSecOps ecosystem. You’ll lead the design and implementation of automated CI/CD pipelines, enforce enterprise-grade security and compliance standards, and drive reliability across the software delivery lifecycle.


In this role, you’ll partner closely with development, operations, and platform teams to define best practices, optimize deployment workflows, and ensure applications are resilient, observable, secure, and continuously improving. Your expertise will help accelerate innovation while maintaining high standards for quality, performance, and operational excellence.


Responsibilities

  • Work with key technology stakeholders to deliver SRE strategies and capabilities that drive and support the digital transformation agenda.
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud-native CI/CD workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.
  • Automate build, test, and deployment processes for microservices across Kubernetes clusters and multi-cloud environments.
  • Integrate security into every stage of the delivery pipeline, including automated vulnerability scans, secrets management, and policy enforcement using tools such as Snyk, HashiCorp Vault, and OPA.
  • Build fault-tolerant systems using cloud-native patterns such as self-healing, auto-scaling, and blue/green deployments.
  • Leverage Kubernetes, service meshes, and distributed tracing to maintain application performance, resilience, and uptime.
  • Deploy and manage observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and OpenTelemetry to monitor system health.
  • Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets; establish intelligent alerting; and lead incident response and postmortem practices.
  • Use Terraform and cloud vendor tools to provision, manage, and optimize cloud resources.
  • Maintain version-controlled infrastructure and enforce effective change management practices.
  • Ensure systems meet regulatory and organizational standards, including SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001.
  • Automate audit trails and implement continuous compliance checks to support governance requirements.
  • Partner with developers, QA, operations, and platform engineers to embed reliability and security throughout the SDLC.
  • Advocate for cloud-native best practices and drive adoption of scalable, secure, and resilient engineering patterns.
  • Guide junior engineers, conduct technical reviews, and foster a culture of ownership, automation, and continuous learning.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks, reduce toil through automation, and evolve infrastructure and processes to support rapid innovation and growth.
  • Complete all assigned, mandatory training within the timeframe provided.
  • Conduct and/or participate in regularly scheduled 1:1 meetings with your direct manager and/or direct reports.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, platform engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong experience defining and managing SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident management, blameless postmortems, and reliability improvement practices.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, or Bash.
  • AI-native mindset with experience using AI tooling to support engineering productivity, automation, reliability, or operational excellence.
  • Experience with chaos engineering tools or practices such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or LitmusChaos preferred.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi preferred.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and security tooling preferred.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows and CI/CD pipelines preferred.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to influence engineering teams and technology stakeholders.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for automation, resilience, security, and scalable systems.

Role Title: Statistician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is selecting Statistician to contribute expert knowledge to a customer project focused on advancing data-driven solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Clean, preprocess, and structure complex and messy datasets using advanced statistical software (such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata).
  2. Apply and document basic descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to uncover trends and patterns in real-world data.
  3. Develop clear and compelling data visualizations to illustrate key findings and support model development.
  4. Contribute expertise in dataset annotation, labeling, or enrichment to enhance the quality of AI model training datasets.
  5. Draft concise, well-organized written summaries of methods, analyses, and results for a non-technical audience.
  6. Collaborate asynchronously with project stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and improve deliverables through effective written and verbal communication.
  7. Continuously identify data quality issues, provide actionable recommendations, and document solutions for handling dirty or incomplete data.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field.
  2. Expertise in cleaning and preparing complex, messy (“dirty”) datasets with R, Python, SAS, or Stata.
  3. Proficiency in basic descriptive and inferential statistical techniques, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis.
  4. Strong programming skills in Python or R for statistical analysis, data manipulation, and visualization.
  5. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to non-technical and technical audiences with clarity and precision.
  6. Experience working with large, unstructured, or noisy datasets across a variety of domains.
  7. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on detailed documentation and collaboration in remote environments.

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Life Sciences Research Assistants to contribute to a customer's project focused on creating next-generation AI benchmarks. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. You'll design and author expert-level evaluation tasks, using authentic research artifacts and technical challenges that mirror advanced practice in the life sciences. Each assignment will test AI agents with realistic data sets, multi-step problem-solving, and rigorous evaluation rubrics that go beyond textbook science.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop complex, authentic research evaluation tasks in the life sciences domain (e.g., experimental design critique, protocol analysis, and primary data interpretation).

  5. Ensure all tasks reflect the nuance, ambiguity, and depth of real-world scientific work — not simplified or hypothetical scenarios.
  6. Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators for feedback and refinement of deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's or Master's in biology, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, or a closely related discipline.
  2. Minimum 2 years of hands-on research or laboratory experience with primary data analysis and scientific protocols.
  3. Demonstrated expertise in protocol-driven, multi-source scientific workflows.
  4. Mastery of scientific reasoning, source synthesis, and methodological evaluation.
  5. Strong written English skills, with experience drafting or reviewing scientific documentation.
  6. Familiarity with handling diverse data formats (CSVs, spreadsheets, PDFs, technical documents).
  7. Attention to detail and commitment to rubric fidelity, ensuring high-quality, objective task design.

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Medical Oncologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do

  1. Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).
  3. Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to cancer diagnoses, staging, treatment plans, and laboratory or imaging findings.
  4. Assess documentation of systemic cancer therapies, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and supportive care.

  6. Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Medical Oncology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient medical oncology experience following fellowship.
  3. Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing solid tumors, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.
  4. Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.
  5. Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.
  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.
  7. Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.
  2. Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process

Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

micro1 is a data lab that connects professionals with opportunities to apply their expertise to customer projects. raw.excerpt: Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all.
raw.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world—one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We're a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we're looking for passionate people to help us get there.
For more information, visit .

Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia

Arcadia's petabyte-scale data platform is at the heart of everything the company does; everyone from our external customers to our engineers, from our analysts to our sales team, depends on it. They don't just use it; they build on it. This data platform needs to enable a shared ownership model, so the platform team can scale and internal teams can move fast. This role sets how we build and run it.
The role reports directly to the VP of Engineering.

What Success Looks Like

The data platform provides building blocks, from catalog and pipelines to databases, queues, and storage, that come pre-wired with connectivity, logging, metrics, tracing, alerts, encryption, access controls, backups, and cost tags—all with sensible defaults.
Internal teams own and change their pipelines, environments, alerts, and SLOs. When something breaks, the owning team sees it first, traces it to the root cause, and addresses it themselves. They see their own quality numbers and cloud spend, and act on them. Data platform engineers spend their time building capabilities, not working tickets.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partner with internal teams to prioritize, implement, and roll out features they depend on—from enabling self-service ETL authoring to provisioning new data stores, from establishing data quality metrics to optimizing performance.
  • Evaluate new technologies and architectures, prototype them, and roll them out as new capabilities across the platform.
  • Write a meaningful share of the production code.
  • Work closely with our AWS infrastructure team on the platform's network, compute, and security.
  • Push quality attributes into the platform, especially as AI increases the volume of changes. We need the platform itself to be stable, resilient, performant, and cost-effective. Internal teams that build on it need to be able to configure their own SLIs/SLOs and focus on data quality.
  • Run the platform as an internal product: find what slows teams down, pick the few capabilities worth building, publish the roadmap, and measure adoption, delivery speed, stability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Drive migrations to completion: track usage, automate instead of handing out checklists, push through the final 20%, and sunset legacy systems.
  • Set technical direction, evolve the platform, and coach other engineers through design partnership and review.
  • Building data engineering tooling on top of our internal AI platform.

What You'll Bring

  • Deep experience in data engineering—from columnar stores to data lakes, from distributed processing to SQL optimization.
  • Expertise in software engineering—CI/CD, testing, architecture, source control, automation, observability, modularity and reuse, and fluency in Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Modern data stack experience (e.g. data contracts and data products, dbt, Spark, Dagster, Iceberg and Parquet, notebooks and BI, data catalogs and data quality).
  • Strong AWS experience since the platform is built on its network, storage, and compute primitives.
  • Experience building with AI.
  • Reliability you've owned: SLOs, observability, on-call, and incident response.
  • Current, hands-on production coding, the habit of figuring things out (research, spike, deliver), and relentless pragmatism about what's worth building.
  • A track record of driving change across the org.

Would Love for You to Have

  • Regulated-data experience (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2 or HITRUST environments).
  • A public voice through talks, writing, or open source.
  • Experience turning a data engineering team into a product-minded platform team complete with processes, stakeholder management, and a roadmap.
  • Experience building platform support that scales: support tiers, office hours, docs, shared ownership principles, escalation processes, and developer advocacy.
  • No healthcare background required.

What You'll Get

  • The opportunity to shape Arcadia's data platform and its direction for years to come.
  • Direct influence on how Arcadia's engineering org works on a daily basis through tooling, patterns, and standards.
  • Remote-first across the US, with in-person hubs growing in Boston, DC, and NYC.
  • A flexible culture with personality and heart, named a Built In 2026 Best Place to Work.
  • Work that shows up in patients' lives.

About Arcadia

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. raw.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

At NVIDIA, as a Principal Rack Scale Systems Infrastructure Engineer, you will build and guide the development of software systems. These systems support our upcoming rack-scale infrastructure products and services. This exceptional role sits where software meets hardware. You will work on control planes, state machines, orchestration systems, firmware, OS lifecycle, and networking fabrics. Your task is to compose infrastructure-as-a-service control plane software that converts complex rack-scale hardware into dependable, manageable, and programmable infrastructure for NVIDIA, partners, and leading cloud and enterprise clients globally.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Define the complete software architecture for rack-scale infrastructure products and services, covering control plane services, infrastructure management, firmware, operating systems, kernel drivers, networking fabrics, accelerator software, and user-mode manageability software.

  • Use Kubernetes and cloud-native primitives as an infrastructure fabric when appropriate. This includes controllers, operators, reconciliation loops, and open source components. These components can operate safely at rack and fleet scale. Build open source infrastructure software that can be embraced in different forms, including libraries, services, controllers, operators, and integration APIs for internal deployments and CSP environments.

  • Bridge hardware and software teams across firmware, BMC, BIOS, boot flows, OS images, drivers, networking, NVLink domains, InfiniBand, GPUs, DPUs, CPUs, and system management interfaces. Translate forward-looking infrastructure roadmaps into formal software requirements, architecture specifications, and execution plans that align teams across the organization.

  • Partner directly with hyperscalers, CSPs, enterprise customers, internal component leads, vendors, and business partners to align infrastructure capabilities with real-world deployment and integration needs. Establish reliability, security, validation, and left-shift strategies that reduce risk before hardware reaches production environments.

  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the engineering bar for large-scale networked systems, foundational software, and rack-scale control plane development.

  • Make high-quality technical decisions in ambiguous environments, balancing customer needs, schedule, hardware realities, software maintainability, open source adoption, and long-term infrastructure evolution.

What We Need To See:

  • BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven experience (15+ years) in systems architecture, system software, distributed systems, infrastructure control planes, or infrastructure engineering.

  • Solid architectural knowledge of coordination frameworks, state machines, declarative APIs, reconciliation loops, lifecycle orchestration, failure handling, upgrade and rollback workflows, and distributed systems tradeoffs.

  • Practical coding skills in Go, C++, or Rust, encompassing the capability to write, review, and direct production-quality infrastructure software. Experience with Rust is highly valued.

  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar orchestration systems, especially as a fabric for managing infrastructure, hardware resources, or large-scale infrastructure services. Experience with Linux-based infrastructure software, OS rollout and image management, kernel or driver interactions, firmware lifecycle, and hardware bring-up workflows.

  • Strong understanding of data center networking technologies and protocols, such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, and fabric-level manageability. Experience with complex accelerator-based systems, including GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs, custom silicon, or other high-performance computing systems.

  • Expertise in in-band and out-of-band management architectures, including BMCs, Redfish, IPMI, and related system management protocols. Ability to work with security experts to define practical tradeoffs across secure boot, attestation, access control, update safety, serviceability, and ease of operation.

  • Experience crafting software intended for open source release, including API stability, modularity, documentation, community usability, and clean separation between shared software and deployment-specific integrations.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly as an engineering multiplier for coding, test generation, debugging, build iteration, and documentation.

  • Established skill in specifying requirements, guiding architecture, and managing delivery across various engineering teams and organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear explanation of complex hardware/software tradeoffs to engineering leaders, customers, partners, and executives.

Ways To Stand Out from the crowd:

  • Built software supporting multiple adoption models — internal services, CSP-integrated offerings, reusable libraries, and customer-extensible APIs. Strong Rust skills in systems, infrastructure, or hardware-adjacent software.

  • Multiplied team impact through reference implementations, design reviews, shared libraries, architecture docs, dev workflows, and AI-assisted engineering. Hands-on with fleet-scale provisioning, updates, rollback, observability, health, and remediation.

  • Led across the full data center product lifecycle: inception, pre- and post-silicon, manufacturing, deployment, and operations. Familiar with open source ecosystems, contribution models, and balancing community collaboration with product needs.

  • Deep experience with rack- or cluster-scale systems spanning compute, networking, storage, accelerators, firmware, and infra management as one operational domain. Skilled at finding simple, durable abstractions in complex systems to align teams, customers, and long-term direction.

  • Evolve efficient data formats for AV evaluation: designing for performance, interoperability, and correctness across formats like Protobuf, Arrow, Parquet, and MCAP.

Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier.

We value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive. We are deliberate about the team and culture we are building. We seek engineers who are strong in their own work and care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

We are looking for a senior software developer to make Counterpart Health's existing customer-facing platform agentic. You will build applied AI systems that retrieve relevant information, call tools, and help healthcare users complete meaningful work. You will work with engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals, with ownership across data pipelines, backend services, model behavior, and the user experience.

As a Senior Software Developer, you will:

  • Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that multiply human efforts.
  • Build and maintain customer-facing agentic AI software, with ownership from data ingestion through to the user interface.
    • Develop retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, pipelines for ingestion, ETL, storage, indexing, retrieval, and context assembly.
    • Build agent workflows that call tools and use application services, with clear permissions, execution limits, and human review where needed.
    • Choose models, storage, retrieval, and orchestration patterns based on product needs and measured results.
  • Protect PHI and tenant boundaries across data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and outputs in a HIPAA-regulated environment.
  • Use customer feedback and failure analysis to improve answers and tool execution.
  • Measure and improve quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Master new tools and technologies to solve concrete user problems while keeping the system simple enough for the team to maintain and operate.
  • Help the team define development practices that support fast iteration and quality, including tests and documentation of key implementations.
  • Work with Product Managers and operational staff to choose useful workflows, define success, and deliver features to customers.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have personally owned a production agentic system used by external customers. You can explain your contribution across ingestion, ETL, storage, retrieval, the tool-calling loop, inference, and UI integration.
  • You have used evaluations to improve a live system. Can explain the test data, failure categories, release criteria, and limits of automated or LLM-as-judge scoring.
  • You bring senior software engineering experience and can write, test, debug, and operate the application code behind an AI feature. Python and TypeScript or JavaScript experience are useful, as is comparable experience in another production language.
  • You have experience with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services such as GCP or AWS.
  • You have handled practical LLM limitations, such as context-window limits, unsupported answers, retrieval failures, and incorrect tool calls.
  • Experience with healthcare or another regulated industry is a plus. Experience with tools such as LangGraph, Langfuse, pgvector, or OpenSearch is useful, but we care more about your engineering decisions and production results than a particular framework. Using AI coding assistants, building demos, or shipping internal tools alone does not meet the production AI experience required for this role.

You will love this job if:

  • You are curious about how systems work and use pragmatic engineering to solve complicated problems. You test whether an AI approach improves the workflow and use simpler software when it is the better choice.
  • You enjoy a collaborative environment where you help define priorities and own delivery. You bring clarity to ambiguity and change your view when new evidence calls for it.
  • You take responsibility for what reaches customers. You investigate broken behavior, fix the cause, and improve the tests and evaluations that should catch it.
  • You care about what good technology can do for people and want to work with healthcare professionals on tools they can trust.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

  • The Workflow: You’ll switch assignments frequently, focusing on businesses within a 3-5 mile radius of a specific congregation or community center.

Key Responsibilities

  • New Business Development: Identify and close new advertising partnerships to meet production goals.
  • Consultative Sales: Educate local business owners on the ROI of being featured in our community guides and directories.
  • Relationship Management: Act as the primary liaison between your clients and our operations staff to ensure an excellent experience.
  • Account Growth: Nurture and maintain large-scale accounts within your metro area.
  • Administrative Precision: Manage contracts and paperwork accurately and return assignment materials via USPS upon completion.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a structure that rewards high performers and provides security through a comprehensive benefits package via ADP TotalSource.

  • Benefits:
    • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Life Insurance
    • Paid Time Off (PTO)

Qualifications

  • Experience: 1-2 years of sales experience preferred (or equivalent education).
  • Mindset: A self-starter who can manage their own schedule without being micromanaged.
  • Skills: Proficient in Excel, scanning, email, and PDF management. Strong ability to calculate discounts and commissions accurately.
  • Communication: Persuasive verbal skills and clear, professional written communication.
  • Requirements: Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance.

Why Guide Book Publishing?

We serve the communication needs of over 800 micro-communities. If you are looking for a role that balances the freedom of remote work with the fast-paced nature of community-based sales, we want to talk to you.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

raw.description:
Description

We’re growing and looking to hire an experienced OT Cybersecurity professional with a strong background in consulting and Cybersecurity services to join our Advanced Service Team at Claroty, who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

About the Company:

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated OT Cybersecurity Architect to join our Advanced Services team. The ideal candidate will be a T-shaped professional with deep expertise in Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) security architecture, coupled with strong technical skills in network segmentation, IT/OT convergence, and technical documentation. This role is crucial for designing resilient security architectures for our customer base, strengthening operational cybersecurity posture through risk-based engineering, and ensuring architectural designs and technical documentation meet industry standards and compliance requirements (such as IEC 62443 and NIST).

Responsibilities

As an OT Cybersecurity Architect, your impact will be:

Responsible for orchestrating the delivery of security services to customers, ensuring the entire program aligns with established frameworks, and producing the necessary documentation and tooling for both internal teams and external clients.

  • Provide technical direction and act as a subject matter expert as it relates to Claroty´s product portfolio & cybersecurity.
  • Ensure our products are effectively deployed, integrated, assessed, and optimized in alignment with effective security metrics.
  • Interpret requirements across risk, secure architecture, incident management and governance.
  • Support cybersecurity investigations within OT environments using Claroty products.
  • Deliver workshops, training, and threat intelligence sharing sessions.
  • Provide advisory, presentations and reports to customers.
  • Create collateral around GRC such as policies, standards, procedures, playbooks, runbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Create reports of emerging threats to industrial networks for Customers.
  • Leverage AI and machine learning tools to automate passive ICS/OT asset inventory, baseline industrial network behavior, and prioritize remediation based on physical process risk.
  • Work closely with R&D teams or other internal departments to improve and enhance the products and services offered by Claroty.

Requirements

What do you need to succeed in this role?

  • Desired: 3+ years of work experience in Operational Technology Security as a consultant or service delivery expert
  • Experience with the application of threat modelling or other risk identification techniques
  • Understanding of IT and OT network communication protocols
  • Knowledge and understanding of various security control frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, NCSC CAF and/or other relevant frameworks)
  • Knowledge and experience of cybersecurity assessments in ICS/OT & IT security
  • Understanding of operational technologies such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) software, RTUs, HMI and Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
  • Basic experience with network forensics, threat intelligence & incident response (Wireshark, etc.)
  • Experience with Azure, Power BI, Python and SQL creation and scripting
  • Familiarity with Linux and Windows operating systems and administrative tools
  • Ability to successfully communicate & present to a range of technical and executive stakeholders
  • Excellent report-writing skills
  • Willingness to travel.

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premises with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customer’s Choice in the2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite inThe Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for multiple consecutive years.

The expected base salary range for this role is between $150,000 - $160,000, determined by objective criteria including skills, qualifications, and experience level. This range represents base salary only and does not include variable compensation components such as equity or bonuses. Details regarding the broader total rewards package will be shared prior to interviews. Claroty is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of ALL backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases.

raw.description:
About us

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.
We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?
Your new role We are looking for a qualified Accountant to join our Accounting, Tax & Corporate Reporting team. The Accountant will contribute to accurate and timely financial reporting across assigned entities, supporting the general ledger, reconciliations, month-end and year-end close, and statutory and tax compliance activity. The role requires a solid understanding of accounting principles and IFRS, good analytical skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a remote-first environment.

Please note - due to business need, we can only accept applications from candidates who reside in London, UK, where we have an established legal entity.
If you apply from outside of this area, your application will not be considered.
Please be aware that we may close this position early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly.

What you’ll be doing

  • Contribute to financial statements: prepare supporting schedules and annual financial statements for assigned entities, in accordance with accounting standards and reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain the general ledger: prepare and post journal entries and review ledger postings for accuracy, correct coding, and appropriate support.
  • Deliver month-end and year-end close tasks: complete assigned close activities, including accruals, prepayments, and account reconciliations, flagging issues to the Group Financial Controller for review or resolution.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations: produce reconciliations for assigned accounts each month, investigating and clearing reconciling items.
  • Support audits and compliance: provide information and workpapers for external and internal audits, and assist with tax and regulatory requirements (e.g. sales tax, VAT, transfer pricing).
  • Support internal controls: follow and document internal control procedures, and raise suggested improvements.
  • Work with revenue accounting: use the Revenue Accountant's output for revenue recognition and deferred revenue balances, referring revenue treatment questions to the Revenue Accountant (Digital Science's IFRS technical lead).
  • Liaise with local external accountants: support statutory and tax compliance filings for assigned entities by providing information and responding to queries, escalating relationship, contract, or fee matters to the VP, Accounting & Tax.
  • Support variance analysis: assist Finance Business Partners with actual vs. budget/forecast analysis by preparing data and commentary.
  • Contribute to process improvement: suggest and help implement improvements to accounting processes and NetSuite workflows, applying an AI-first mindset, and provide day-to-day support to Junior Accountants where applicable.
Performance Standards
  • Supporting schedules and draft financial statements delivered accurately and within reporting deadlines for assigned entities.
  • Month-end and year-end close tasks completed on schedule, with assigned reconciliations produced monthly to a high standard and issues flagged promptly.
  • Audit requests and tax compliance information provided accurately and on time.
  • Queries and escalations raised with the Group Financial Controller, or VP, Accounting & Tax in a timely way.
  • Process improvement ideas contributed, with demonstrable progress in technical skills and NetSuite proficiency over time.

What you’ll bring to the role

Essential
  • Qualified accountant with a UK chartered or recognised accountancy qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent).
  • 2+ years' post-qualification (or equivalent) experience in accounting, preferably in a tech or software company.
  • Working knowledge of IFRS.
  • Experience with accounting software; NetSuite preferred.
  • Good-to-advanced Excel skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with colleagues across departments.
Desirable
  • Experience with SaaS/subscription revenue models and the software industry.
  • Exposure to multi-entity or international reporting.
Culture & Behavioural Expectations
  • Attention to Detail: accurate, well-documented work.
  • Analytical Thinking: understands the numbers behind the entries and can explain movements clearly.
  • Problem Solving: identifies accounting issues early, proposes solutions, and applies an AI-first mindset to improve ways of working.
  • Adaptability: works effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Team Collaboration & Accountability: a dependable, proactive member of a remote team who takes responsibility for their work and knows when to ask for input.
Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification—let us be the judge! Studies show that many qualified candidates from under-represented groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team and strongly encourage you to submit your application.

Living our Values

We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective.
The talent we secure is fundamental to us achieving our vision and our growth plans. The values we live by are:
We are brave in the pursuit of better
We are collaborative and inclusive
We are always open-minded
We are from and for the community

At Digital Science, our vision is to see research flow seamlessly – trusted, collaborative, and accessible – fueling breakthroughs that push humanity forward. This ambitious mission is one we achieve together, by enabling open, collaborative, inclusive research.

We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. A rich mix of voices drives quality insights, fosters enhanced collaboration, and ultimately pushes knowledge forward more effectively.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building and nurturing a workplace where every individual feels valued and belongs. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Beyond recruitment, we strive to cultivate an environment where inclusivity is woven into the fabric of our culture, enabling everyone to be their best self and do their best work.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Java backend engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable cloud services and wants to broaden their experience across networking, Linux, C, and real-time communications.

Java will be the primary development language for this role, with engineers working on cloud backend services and distributed systems that support our global Voice Platform. You will also have opportunities to contribute to systems-level and network-facing components written in C, developing your knowledge of the lower levels of the voice technology stack.


You will own features end to end and help deliver highly available voice capabilities used by enterprise customers at global scale. Prior SIP/VoIP or contact-center experience is a plus, not a requirement. If you enjoy backend engineering, distributed systems, production ownership, and learning a specialized technical domain, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


The primary responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to):

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java-based backend services supporting real-time voice communications, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, performance, and operational excellence.
  • Build and evolve distributed cloud services running on AWS, applying strong software engineering principles to production systems operating at global scale.
  • Own features and services end to end, from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing production support.
  • Apply networking and Linux knowledge to develop, integrate, and troubleshoot services supporting real-time communications.
  • Contribute to network-facing and systems-level components written in C, working alongside experienced engineers and developing deeper systems programming knowledge.
  • Learn and apply SIP/VoIP and Genesys voice-platform concepts as part of day-to-day development.
  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues spanning application, networking, cloud, and systems layers.
  • Collaborate with Product, Architecture, DevOps, QA, Security, and Operations to turn requirements into reliable technical solutions.
  • Follow and contribute to engineering practices covering architecture, code quality, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, monitoring, and production operations.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and incident response, while sharing technical knowledge across the team.
  • Continuously improve the performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability of the services you own.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong professional experience with Java backend development.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting backend services or distributed systems.
  • Good networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, UDP, TLS, and sockets.
  • Solid Linux experience in development or production environments.
  • Experience building or supporting services in cloud environments, preferably AWS.
  • Experience debugging and troubleshooting complex or production systems.
  • Interest in developing or expanding skills in C and systems-level programming.
  • Willingness to learn SIP/VoIP and real-time communications concepts.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while aligning with the team's technical direction.

Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience with C, particularly network-facing or systems-level software.
  • Spring Boot and related Java frameworks.
  • Experience with Python, AWS Lambda, or web application development.
  • Broader AWS experience, including ECS/EKS, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB/RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, and CloudFormation/CDK/Terraform.
  • Experience building highly available, distributed, or real-time systems.
  • Experience with SIP, VoIP, or open-source telecom platforms such as OpenSIPS, Kamailio, Asterisk, or FreeSWITCH.
  • Genesys Cloud CX, contact-center, carrier, CCaaS, UCaaS, or CPaaS experience.


Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. ABOUT THE COMPANY

Savvital is a forward-thinking organization that provides diversified services to small and medium-sized businesses in the international market, enabling them to build their future while benefiting from our customized solutions. Our team of educated experts are motivated individuals excited to handle tasks that add real capacity to a client's workday.

Our mission is to provide affordable solutions to growing companies through strategic task delegation. We envision creating an ecosystem that resonates with the human touch every business needs.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is seeking a detail-oriented, client-facing Trust Accounting & Bookkeeping Specialist to manage day-to-day bookkeeping, trust compliance, U.S. tax support, and client communication workflows.

In this role, you will go beyond routine transaction processing—you will analyze financial data, proactively catch discrepancies, maintain accurate financial records, prepare three-way trust reconciliations, review month-end statements, and communicate directly with U.S. clients and internal teams to ensure all financial operations remain compliant, organized, and audit-ready.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Bookkeeping, Tax & Month-End Close

  • Perform daily bookkeeping, accurately categorize financial transactions, and proactively identify and resolve accounting anomalies or discrepancies.
  • Review, analyze, and verify month-end financial statements for accuracy, completeness, and proper account allocation.
  • Assist with U.S. tax preparation workflows for both business and individual returns.

Trust Accounting & Reconciliation

  • Prepare three-way reconciliation spreadsheets (comparing bank statements, book balances, and individual client trust ledgers).
  • Ensure strict compliance with trust accounting rules, regulations, and reporting standards.

Client Operations & Inbox Management

  • Act as a confident point of contact on calls and written communications with U.S. clients—explaining accounting issues clearly and asking the right diagnostic questions.
  • Monitor and manage the service inbox, promptly triaging inquiries, billing questions, and financial documentation requests.
  • Regularly check and update the client’s practice management software to ensure billing, trust balances, and matter records remain synchronized.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of hands-on accounting and bookkeeping experience, ideally within a legal accounting, CPA firm, or professional services environment.
  • QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification (required) and proficiency in legal practice management platforms (e.g., Clio, MyCase, LeanLaw, or PracticePanther).
  • U.S. tax preparation experience covering both business and individual returns.
  • Proven experience preparing three-way trust reconciliations and maintaining trust compliance.
  • Client-facing communication: Excellent spoken and written English; comfortable leading calls with U.S. clients, explaining accounting issues clearly, and asking the right questions.
  • Strong accounting fundamentals with the ability to work independently, interpret financial statements, and spot errors rather than just processing transactions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent accounting certification).
  • Strong Excel skills for reconciliation spreadsheets and month-end reporting.
  • Availability to work aligned with U.S. business hours (Evening/Night shift PKT).

IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who goes beyond data entry—someone who truly understands the numbers, spots when something doesn’t look right, and works confidently alongside both internal teams and U.S. clients. The ideal candidate is:

  • Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Possesses strong accounting fundamentals; committed to thorough reconciliation, catching discrepancies early, and ensuring every financial record and trust ledger is compliant and reliable.
  • Confident & Client-Facing: Articulate and poised on calls with U.S. clients, able to break down complex accounting issues and ask insightful questions.
  • Organized & Proactive: Capable of managing daily inbox workflows, practice management updates, and month-end deadlines independently with minimal supervision.
  • Compliance-Minded: Understands the strict regulatory standards surrounding client trust funds and U.S. tax compliance.
  • Collaborative & Professional: Respectful, friendly, empathetic, punctual, and confident in their abilities while maintaining a team-oriented approach.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base Salary: Market Competitive.
  • Allowances: Internet, Electricity, and Wellbeing.
  • Performance-based bonuses.

If you're passionate about transforming data into meaningful business insights and believe trusted information drives better decisions, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact. Join a collaborative team where you'll shape the quality, governance, and strategic use of data that helps advance the future of the propane industry.

Job Title: MANAGER, MARKET INTELLIGENCE AND DATA GOVERNANCE

OT Status: Exempt

Reports to: Data Scientist

Direct Reports: 0

Work Location: Richmond, VA (Hybrid or Remote)

Job Summary:

The Manager, Market Intelligence and Data Governance is responsible for analyzing and reconciling PERC’s market data, industry intelligence, and enterprise data governance capabilities to support strategic decision-making, program investment, and industry initiatives across the organization. This role serves as the single point of accountability for identifying, governing, and ensuring the accuracy and completeness of all data maintained by PERC. The Manager, Market Intelligence and Data Governance interprets internal and external data related to the U.S. propane market—including market participants, consumption trends, workforce dynamics, and industry structure—while ensuring data consistency, transparency, and defensibility. The position partners closely with cross functional team members to deliver trusted, decision-ready insights aligned with PERC’s statutory mission. Other duties as assigned.

Key Responsibilities:

Market Intelligence & Industry Analysis

  • Develop and maintain authoritative market intelligence on the U.S. propane industry, including:
    • Market structure and segmentation
    • Industry participants and value-chain roles
    • Revenue, propane volumes, employment, and geographic impact estimates
    • Emerging trends impacting demand, supply, safety, training, and technology adoption
  • Design and execute market sizing, benchmarking, and trend analyses to support:
    • Program prioritization and ROI analysis
    • Strategic planning and scenario analysis
    • Board, Council, and Advisory Committee materials
  • Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into clear, executive-ready insights and narratives for internal and external use.

Data Governance & Stewardship

  • Establish and manage PERC’s enterprise data governance framework, including:
    • Data definitions, standards, and documentation
    • Approved data sources and vendor hierarchy
    • Data ownership and stewardship roles
  • Ensure consistent, auditable use of data across departments, reports, and publications.
  • Resolve discrepancies across competing data sources and document assumptions, methodologies, and limitations.
  • Maintain a central data dictionary and glossary for market and industry metrics.

Data Sourcing & Vendor Management

  • Support relationships with external data providers (e.g., industry databases, government sources, research firms).
  • Continually evaluate new data sources and tools for relevance, credibility, cost-effectiveness, and licensing compliance.
  • Coordinate procurement, renewals, and usage governance in collaboration with finance and technology teams.

Reporting, Analytics & Tools

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and analytic models that support leadership, program teams, and finance.
  • Partner with finance and strategy leaders to align market data with budgeting, forecasting, and performance measurement.
  • Analyze odorized propane remitter assessments and provide support to remitter assessment audits. Identify anomalies in remittance data and recommend action for follow-up.
  • Support full-service analytics where appropriate while preserving data integrity and governance controls.

Cross-Functional & External Collaboration

  • Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, program managers, and external stakeholders on industry data and market trends. Work collaboratively with team members to track, document and support the completion of corporate, team and individual goals.
  • Proactively identify and report on changes in trends within the propane market, propane equipment and applications, emerging technologies and industry participants.
  • Support research efforts related to:
    • Workforce development
    • Segmented odorized propane retail sales by state
    • Energy transition and technology innovation
    • Safety, training, and education initiatives
  • Contribute data-driven insights to industry communications, grant or research proposals, and public-facing materials as appropriate.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Requirements:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, or another related field.
  • 4-10 years of experience in market intelligence, industry analysis, data governance, or analytics roles.
  • Demonstrated experience working with external market and industry datasets, including reconciliation of conflicting sources.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills with the ability to present complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of industry classification systems (NAICS/SIC) and statistical sources (Census, BLS, EIA, etc.).
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with BI or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, or similar).

Preferred

  • Experience in energy, fuels, utilities, transportation, agriculture, or industrial markets.
  • Experience in building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines into the cloud data platforms (i.e.: Snowflake)
  • Experience establishing or operating a data governance program in a lean resource environment.
  • Exposure to data privacy, licensing, and compliance considerations.

Competencies:

  • Exemplifies the cultural pillars of the organization: Leads with Respect, Owns the Outcome, Communicates with Purpose, Grows Together.
  • Analytical, organized, detail-oriented, and process-focused.
  • Strategic and structured problem solving
  • Data integrity and governance mindset
  • Executive-level communication and storytelling
  • Cross-functional influence without authority
  • Mission alignment and public-interest perspective

Working Conditions:

  • Office / Remote Work Environment (90%-100%)
  • Travel (up to 10%)
  • As an exempt position, this role may require occasional work beyond regular business hours, including occasional evenings and weekends as necessary to fulfill business needs and responsibilities.

Benefits: In addition to a competitive salary, PERC offers excellent benefits such as: vacation and sick pay, 401(k) retirement plan, healthcare (to include Vision and Dental), LTD, Life insurance, other Voluntary benefits, and a wonderful and supportive work environment.

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO ANSWER ALL APPLICATION QUESTIONS AND MEET THE STATED QUALIFICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

Salary: 115,000-125,000

Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. About the Role:

As Senior Telephony Engineer, you’ll own the technical direction and reliability of Phone.com’s voice platform, helping business customers stay connected. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture and technical leadership across our voice, cloud, and data center infrastructure.

Working with a small team of engineers and contractors, you’ll guide technical decisions, improve performance, and strengthen platform resilience through automation, documentation, and tested recovery plans.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the design and optimization of the Kamailio, OpenSIPS, and FreeSWITCH SIP platform, including call routing, registration, and media handling.
  • Own SIP trunking, carrier integrations, and least-cost and failover routing across carriers.
  • Set technical standards, review designs and code, and make architecture decisions for voice services.
  • Own reliability, monitoring, alerting, and capacity planning for data center servers and multi-region AWS environments.
  • Design and test failover and disaster recovery for session border controllers, proxies, media servers, and carrier links.
  • Monitor call quality and platform health, including MOS, jitter, packet loss, and answer-seizure ratio; lead corrective action, incident response, and blameless postmortems, and participate in the on-call rotation.
  • Plan telephony software upgrades, patching, and data center hardware lifecycle management.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible; improve observability with Prometheus, Grafana, logs, and packet captures, and apply automation and AI-assisted troubleshooting to reduce detection and resolution time.
  • Direct the day-to-day technical work of the VoIP engineer and code and DevOps contractors; maintain architecture documentation, runbooks, and change records to eliminate dependence on any one person.
  • Manage carrier and infrastructure vendors, including SLAs, escalations, and technical evaluations; partner with product, support, NOC, and security teams on releases, incidents, and PCI DSS, SOC 2, and HIPAA compliance.

Experience We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of voice, telecom, or infrastructure engineering experience is required, including production operations for carrier-grade or highly available services.
  • This role requires hands-on production experience with Kamailio or OpenSIPS and FreeSWITCH, deep knowledge of SIP, SDP, and RTP, and the ability to troubleshoot signaling and media issues using packet captures and logs.
  • Candidates need experience designing and operating multi-region AWS environments—including IAM, VPC networking, compute, containers, and Lambda—and running production Linux at scale with containerized workloads and Kubernetes or equivalent.
  • Experience with Ansible and CI/CD pipelines is required; Python or Bash scripting for automation and tooling is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of BGP, OSPF, and carrier interconnects is required.
  • Candidates need experience setting technical direction and reviewing engineers’ or contractors’ work, along with clear written and verbal communication during incidents and with vendors.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required.
  • Experience owning data center operations during a cloud migration, including hardware lifecycle and capacity planning, is preferred, as is a track record of reducing infrastructure costs through right-sizing, containers, or serverless services.
  • Experience building an observability platform or Network Operations Center using Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools is preferred. Experience applying LLM-assisted troubleshooting, AIOps, or retrieval-augmented generation to operations is also preferred.
  • Experience supporting PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA controls on communications platforms is preferred, as is experience with emergency calling (911 and E911) or other regulated telephony obligations.
  • AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Juniper, or Asterisk certifications are preferred.

What We Offer:

Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And,you'll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks.

    • HMO, PPO’s or a PPO with a HDHP (including HSA, which Ooma helps fund)

We do not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

All interviews are conducted via video. To be considered for a role, candidates must participate in all interviews with their camera enabled, subject to reasonable accommodation. Candidates who need an accommodation should contact their recruiter.

Job Title: Senior Clinical Project Manager- RWE FSP – Virology

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Title: Clinical Program Manager, Real World Evidence – Virology


About the role

IQVIA is hiring a Clinical Program Manager – Virology to join our dedicated Real World Evidence (RWE) FSP team, working fully embedded within a leading pharmaceutical company. In this role, the Clinical Program Manager will act as the Study Management Team chair and provide operational leadership for global real-world virology studies from planning through closeout.

We are looking for an experienced study leader who can independently manage primary data collection studies and brings a strong understanding of observational research across both primary and secondary data study designs.

Who you’ll work with

  • Therapeutic Area (TA) oversight, Study Management Team leads, epidemiologists, data analysts, and clinical partners to deliver study-specific goals and timelines
  • Vendors to manage deliverables, timelines, and workflows
  • Operational oversight and business leads to manage portfolio of studies

What you’ll bring

  • Experience independently leading multiple complex observational and real-world studies simultaneously, from planning through closeout across a broad portfolio
  • Ability to provide clear direction to global, cross-functional study teams
  • Proven ability to anticipate study risks and drive practical mitigation strategies
  • Ability to bring structure and clarity to complex or ambiguous situations
  • Sound judgement balancing quality, timelines, scope, and cost when making operational decisions
  • Strong communication skills across study teams, vendors, and senior leadership
  • Experience managing vendors across in-house, hybrid, and outsourced delivery models
  • Strong understanding of project financials, contractual commitments, forecasting, and change control
  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to operational excellence and strategic client partnership

What you’ll do

  • Chair the Study Management Team and serve as the primary operational contact for virology studies, establishing clear study governance, accountability, escalation pathways, operational leadership, oversight, and decision-making throughout study delivery
  • Identify and anticipate operational and quality risks, proactively escalate issues, and drive timely resolution with the Study Management Team
  • Conduct regular check-ins with Therapeutic Area (TA) oversight to align on study progress, priorities, risks, and emerging issues
  • Lead global, cross-functional observational studies and own delivery against scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations
  • Develop and maintain study management plans, timelines, risk assessments, and operational documentation
  • Ensure consistent use of study tools, training materials, and compliance with SOPs, policies, and procedures
  • Monitor study progress, financial performance, forecasting, and change control
  • Oversee vendor performance and deliverables across applicable sourcing models
  • Partner across functions to support milestone achievement, resolve issues, remove obstacles, and accelerate study delivery
  • Guide and mentor Study Management Team members on day-to-day study delivery
  • Generate study and program-level metrics and provide clear updates to senior leadership
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to process improvement and best practices

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences or related field
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in clinical study management, clinical operations, or clinical project management within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environment or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading primary data collection observational studies from startup through closeout
  • Strong knowledge of observational research and RWE study execution, including the operational differences between clinical trials and observational studies
  • Experience working across both primary and secondary data real-world study designs
  • Virology experience strongly preferred
  • Knowledge of ICH GCP and relevant local laws, regulations, and guidelines applicable to clinical and observational research
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle conflicting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively across geographies and cultures
  • Ability to demonstrate all IQVIA core competencies (Ownership, Innovation, Collaboration, Growth)

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.
