raw.description:
Description

We're looking for a hands-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems.

We're taking a different approach to Customer Success. Rather than primarily coaching customers on how to use Insycle, our team works directly in their environments to investigate problems, build solutions, and deliver results. Think of it as Customer Success with a Forward Deployed Engineer mindset.

With our secure Support Access, you'll be able to configure and test solutions directly in customers' Insycle environments. Customers retain control over approving and executing changes to their CRM data.

You'll own a portfolio of customers across onboarding, ongoing adoption, renewals, and expansion. You'll build relationships, understand customers' business challenges, and help them get lasting value from Insycle.

This role combines hands-on technical problem-solving with customer relationships and business understanding. You'll have the autonomy to investigate challenges, design practical solutions, and see your work make a difference.

Location: Remote. We're looking for candidates based in the United Kingdom who can collaborate effectively with our team and customers across different time zones.

What you’ll do

Solve customer data challenges

  • Understand customers' business goals and translate their requirements into practical data solutions.
  • Investigate CRM records, fields, workflows, and existing configurations to understand problems and identify root causes.
  • Configure Blueprints, templates, matching rules, transformations, associations, assignments, and other Insycle capabilities on customers' behalf.
  • Test solutions against real customer data, review previews, investigate edge cases, and refine configurations until they produce the expected results.
  • Choose simple, reliable solutions that customers can understand and maintain, and follow through to ensure the original problem is resolved.

Drive adoption and customer outcomes

  • Lead customer onboarding, configuring initial use cases and helping customers achieve results quickly.
  • Help customers move from one-time cleanup to continuous data integrity using Blueprints, Data Logic, and Observability.
  • Proactively review customer usage, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and recommend additional use cases.
  • Monitor adoption, address challenges early, and help customers get sustained value from Insycle.

Build relationships and grow accounts

  • Own customer relationships across onboarding, ongoing use, renewals, and expansion.
  • Become a trusted partner by understanding customers' priorities, offering practical recommendations, and following through.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Insycle usage across teams, CRM objects, and business processes.
  • Communicate business value through measurable results, including time saved, data quality improvements, and reduced operational risk.
  • Proactively manage customer relationships, identify adoption and retention risks, initiate outreach when intervention is needed, and help customers achieve the outcomes that support renewal and growth.

Improve how we work

  • Share knowledge, document reusable solutions, and collaborate with teammates to solve challenging problems.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and contribute ideas to improve the product, onboarding, and customer experience.
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to investigate problems, explore solutions, and improve workflows, while validating the results.
  • Take initiative to improve processes, learn from feedback, and help the team become more effective.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: You have 3+ years of experience in technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, RevOps, or a similar customer-facing B2B SaaS role.
  • Customer account ownership: You have experience directly managing ongoing customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts, taking responsibility for customer outcomes, adoption, and retention—not solely responding to technical support requests.
  • Technical problem-solving: You enjoy investigating complex problems, working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions.
  • CRM and data experience: You're comfortable with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms, including data management, business rules, workflows, and automation.
  • Ownership and initiative: You work independently, take responsibility for outcomes, and follow through without needing constant direction.
  • Customer communication: You can explain technical concepts clearly, understand business needs, and build strong customer relationships.
  • Judgment and attention to detail: You think through consequences, validate your work, and favor simple, reliable solutions.
  • Teamwork and growth: You enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, learning from feedback, and helping the team improve.

Experience with CRM data quality, deduplication, data transformation, record matching, or integrations is a plus. Software development experience is not required.

Why join Insycle

You'll work on real data challenges across a wide range of customers and industries, with the tools and autonomy to investigate problems and build solutions yourself. You'll see the results of your work directly and build strong relationships with the people you help.

We're a small team with an established product and ambitious plans. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve customers, improve our product, and help shape the next stage of Insycle's growth.

How we work

Our values shape how we work together, make decisions, and develop as a team:

  • Care deeply: Understand customers' needs and take initiative to help them succeed.
  • Everyone builds: Look for opportunities to improve how we work and contribute practical solutions.
  • Better together: Share knowledge, support teammates, and work toward shared success.
  • Quality counts: Think through the details, validate your work, and deliver reliable results.
  • Positive energy: Bring kindness, constructive communication, and a willingness to tackle challenges.
  • Own the outcome: Take responsibility, follow through, and deliver results.
  • Choose simplicity: Favor practical, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity.
  • Raise the bar: Seek feedback, keep learning, and help others improve.

Compensation and benefits

  • Annual base salary of £55,000–£65,000, depending on relevant experience and location.
  • Annual performance-based bonus with a target of 10% of base salary.
  • Equity through stock options.
  • Paid time off, sick leave, flexibility for unexpected needs, and paid holidays.

Company Overview

Insycle builds data integrity infrastructure for the agentic CRM. More than 700 customers trust our tools to resolve duplicates, standardize data, manage imports, and connect related records in platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce.

Those tools fix what’s wrong today. But clean data is a moment. Data integrity is a system.

Our platform helps businesses define what right looks like in Blueprints, continuously apply those standards through Data Logic, and use Observability to understand where data conforms, where it drifts, and whether it stays aligned over time.

As AI agents increasingly use CRM data to make decisions and write changes back, that foundation becomes essential. Businesses need reliable inputs and a system that detects when people, integrations, workflows, or agents move data away from their standards.

We’re a B2B SaaS company with an established customer base and a much larger ambition: to make data integrity foundational to how businesses operate with AI.

Job Title:

Senior AI/ML Engineer – SLM Optimization & Inference

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Position Summary


Senior AI/ML Engineer – SLM Optimization & Inference


We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI/ML Engineer to fine-tune, optimize, and deploy Small Language Models, with a focus on Alibaba Qwen models and production-ready inference performance. In this role, you will help improve model quality, latency, throughput, and GPU efficiency while contributing to real-time audio intelligence pipelines for high-performance, low-latency applications.


This is an opportunity for a senior-level AI/ML engineer who enjoys working close to the model, the infrastructure, and the performance benchmarks—building scalable ML systems that are ready for production.


Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune and optimize Small Language Models, particularly Alibaba Qwen models, for domain-specific use cases.
  • Improve model performance across key metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, latency, and inference throughput.
  • Optimize model serving using vLLM, SGLang, or similar high-performance inference engines.
  • Implement advanced inference optimization techniques, including GPU memory optimization, KV-cache management, quantization, and efficient batching.
  • Develop, enhance, and optimize real-time audio intelligence pipelines for low-latency processing.
  • Benchmark, profile, and tune models for production-scale deployment.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to evaluate model behavior, identify bottlenecks, and improve end-to-end ML system performance.
  • Build reliable, scalable ML workflows that support high-throughput, low-latency AI applications.
  • Apply senior-level technical judgment to balance model quality, infrastructure efficiency, and production performance requirements.

Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and LLM/SLM fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, and PEFT.
  • Practical experience using vLLM or SGLang for high-performance model inference.
  • Deep understanding of GPU utilization, CUDA fundamentals, KV caching, and memory optimization.
  • Experience evaluating and improving model precision, recall, latency, throughput, and inference performance.
  • Strong Python programming and ML engineering skills.
  • Proven ability to benchmark, debug, and optimize models for production environments.
  • Experience fine-tuning and deploying Alibaba Qwen models is preferred.
  • Experience with real-time audio AI, speech recognition, ASR, or audio classification is preferred.
  • Experience optimizing AI models for high-throughput, low-latency production environments is preferred.
  • Ability to work hands-on across both SLM model training/fine-tuning and GPU inference optimization.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to partner effectively across engineering and data teams.

Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

raw.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.
We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Job Highlights:

  • Role: Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales

  • Department: Sales/Marketing

  • Salary Band: $100,000 - $125,000

  • Location: Remote (U.S.)

  • Position Status: Actively hiring for this role

  • Application Deadline: We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no cutoff date. If this job sounds like you, go for it.

Today, we're looking for a Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales to join our team. Our new Growth Manager will be the first conversation many senior marketing leaders have with Silverback, and the person who helps turn those conversations into clients. You'll work on new business from first touch to signed contract: qualifying inbound leads, building the pitches and proposals that win the work, keeping prospects engaged until they're ready to buy, and supporting the marketing programs that bring the next ones in.

This isn't an account management role. Once a client signs, our account teams own the relationship and the day-to-day work, so you stay focused on winning the next one. It's also not a cold-calling job: you'll work inbound leads that come from our marketing, referrals and thought leadership. You don't need formal sales training. You'll learn our methodology and sales process on live deals alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then take on more of the pitching yourself over time. This role is ideal for a marketer who's comfortable in front of a CMO, picks up new frameworks fast, and wants to see their work show up as new revenue.

Here's what we expect from our Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales.

—What You'll Do—

  • Lead Qualification & Discovery: Be the first point of contact for every inbound lead. Research each company, judge how well it fits the clients we serve best, and run intro and discovery calls to find the opportunities worth pursuing.

  • Qualification Automation: Use HubSpot and AI tools like Claude to automate how leads are routed, researched, scored and followed up with, so we respond faster and more accurately as volume grows.

  • Sales Materials: Build the decks, audits, proposals and contracts that win new business. Partner with experts across our Paid Media, SEO, Measurement and Creative teams to tell a story that speaks to each buyer's goals.

  • Pitching & Opportunity Management: Start by supporting pitches alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then grow into leading them yourself: presenting our approach, managing deals from first call to signed contract, and bringing in the right Silverback experts along the way.

  • Pipeline Management: Own HubSpot as our record of every lead, contact and deal. Keep it current so our forecasts are reliable and every lead gets the right follow-up.

  • Prospect Nurture: Segment our HubSpot contacts by engagement, fit and readiness to buy, then build and run email programs that keep Silverback top of mind with prospects who aren't ready yet and past opportunities worth reopening.

  • Gifting & Customer Marketing: Run and grow our client and prospect gifting program around personal and professional milestones, and expand it into a broader customer marketing program that drives referrals, repeat business and growth with existing clients.

—What We're Looking For—

  • Years of Experience: 4-6 years in marketing, account management or growth roles, ideally at a digital marketing agency or professional services firm.

  • Executive Presence: You're comfortable leading a conversation with a VP, CMO or CEO. You listen well, ask sharp questions and hold the room.

  • Sales Acumen: You know how to uncover what a prospect needs, handle objections and move a decision forward. Experience as an account executive is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Marketing Fluency: You have a background in paid media, SEO or measurement, so our methodology clicks quickly and you can speak credibly about what drives results.

  • Writing: You write and edit cleanly and pick up a brand voice fast. You can take a rough draft and make it sound like a person wrote it.

  • Frameworks in Plain Language: You pick up a framework quickly and can explain it to a buyer in plain English.

  • CRM & Automation: You have hands-on HubSpot experience. You keep records clean, segment lists by engagement and fit, and build workflows. You're curious about using AI to take manual work out of the process.

  • Ownership: You don't need a perfect playbook. You can be handed a problem or goal, and you run with it.

—Why Silverback?—

    Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

  • Work with the A team: We are ruthless about putting the best possible team on the field.

  • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

  • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

  • Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

    Great work deserves great support. That’s why we offer a competitive total compensation package, with benefits built around how our people actually live and work.

  • Fully remote team

  • Unlimited PTO & Summer Fridays

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks for primary caregivers, 6 weeks for non-primary caregivers

  • Life and short term disability insurance, on us

  • 401(k) with employer match

  • Company-paid ClassPass membership

  • Monthly Team Events that bring our remote team together

—Work Environment—

  • We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the U.S., and our culture is built for it. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication so work moves forward and no one is left guessing.

  • We pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly “work hard, play hard” mentality.

  • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss.

    • Think this sounds like your kind of team? Apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. raw.description:
Job Title: STEM Expert

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contract (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

The work involves solving, reviewing, and validating challenging problems within your area of expertise. A representative task may require analyzing a scientific or mathematical problem, developing a rigorous solution, using Python to perform calculations or simulations, and evaluating whether an AI-generated answer is technically correct.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates but have experience using coding agents in their workflow.

Candidates are not expected to be experts across every STEM discipline. We are looking for deep expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  1. Chemistry

  2. Biology

  3. Mathematics

  4. Physics

  5. Earth Science / Geoscience / Environmental Science

  6. Robotics

Adjacent scientific or quantitative disciplines may also be considered where the candidate's expertise is directly relevant.

Required Skills

  • Biology

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve complex scientific, mathematical, or technical problems within your domain of expertise.

  2. Review AI-generated solutions for factual, mathematical, and scientific correctness.

  3. Identify incorrect assumptions, reasoning errors, missing constraints, and subtle technical mistakes.

    Required Qualifications

    1. Strong expertise in at least one relevant STEM or scientific domain.

    2. Practical proficiency with Python or other coding languages.

    3. Strong scientific, mathematical, or quantitative problem-solving ability.

    Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, SymPy, Jupyter, or domain-specific scientific libraries. No particular Python library is mandatory.

    Expertise may come from academic research, industry, teaching, engineering, independent technical work, or other demonstrated experience. A specific degree or number of years of experience is not strictly required if you can demonstrate strong expertise in your field.

raw.title: Senior Title Coordinator / Senior Underwriting Asst./ Junior Underwriter
raw.excerpt: Blue Owl (NYSE: OWL) is a leading asset manager that is redefining alternatives®.
raw.description:
Blue Owl (NYSE: OWL) is a leading asset manager that is redefining alternatives®.


With over $319 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026, we invest across three multi-strategy platforms: Credit, Real Assets and GP Strategic Capital. Anchored by a strong permanent capital base, we provide businesses with private capital solutions to drive long-term growth and offer institutional investors, individual investors, and insurance companies differentiated alternative investment opportunities that aim to deliver strong performance, risk-adjusted returns, and capital preservation.


Together with over 1,380 experienced professionals globally, Blue Owl brings the vision and discipline to create the exceptional. To learn more, visit

Title coordinators/underwriting assistants manage the administrative and operational steps of the real estate title process. Reviewing commitments, helping clear title defects and/or requirements and tracking workflow pipelines. This position will work closely with other members of the underwriting team and management to oversee and coordinate transactions involving assets in one or more states. Responsible for communication with buyers, sellers, lenders, underwriters and escrow teams to ensure smooth real estate closings.


Responsibilities

  • Perform required support functions for title underwriters and leadership
  • Maintain and amend orders, calendars, reports, commitments and proformas as requested
  • Review purchased commitments from external underwriters for accuracy and update clearance tracker accordingly
  • Order tax and title continuations for closing
  • Prepare proformas as instructed by underwriters
  • Work directly with underwriting, production and customers to ensure the accuracy and completeness of all files
  • Prepare and maintain tracking charts for commitments, proformas, policies, etc.
  • Review commitment requirements and exceptions to prepare and maintain status of matters and update tracking charts
  • Monitor and oversee satisfaction and completion of requirements and clearance matters
  • Prepare affidavits and other deal forms as requested or directed by senior team members
  • Open orders in software systems and ensure all required fields are completed
  • Create invoices for licensed state transactions and workshare invoices for national deals
  • Maintain pipelines of deals
  • Review escrow instructions and closing checklists
  • Coordinate earnest money deposits, escrowed funds, with escrow offices and transaction parties
  • Support post-closing activities including recording and final policy issuance
  • Upload documents to document repository and software system
  • Timely and friendly response to customer emails
  • Communicate and coordinate with outside parties such as underwriters, external underwriters, counsel, clients on transaction related matters
  • Assist with and oversee the collection, organization and assembly of closing documents and coordination of closings and closers as necessary
  • Willingness to memorialize work flows and train future colleagues

Requirements

  • National commercial transaction experience
  • 5+ years in title industry in title and/or escrow
  • Proficient in Softpro, Excel, Adobe and Word
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • High level of organizational skills
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to multi-task and be proactive
  • Open minded to process changes, continuous system updates and enhancements
  • Positive attitude and a team player

It is expected that the base annual salary range for this Chicago, Dallas or remote-based non-exempt position will be $115,000 to 140,000. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Blue Owl is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

raw.title: Remote Opportunity Product Tester
raw.excerpt: Presently we're recruiting Product Testers (from home) in several US cities to expand our private network of In-Home Usage Testers (IHUT) to fulfill upcoming contracts with national and international companies.
raw.description:
Presently we're recruiting Product Testers (from home) in several US
cities to expand our private network of In-Home Usage Testers (IHUT) to
fulfill upcoming contracts with national and international companies. We
guarantee 15-20 hours per week with an hourly pay of between $25/hr.
and $45/hr., depending on the In-Home Usage Test project. No experience

required.

Hope services is a products survey company that specializes in
product testing and product development work. We design and conduct
In-Home Usage Testing (IHUT) locally and nationally to provide actual
user feedback to consumers and market research firms to evaluate
products, packaging, related product instructions and more.

We leverage our network of private panels (In-Home Usage Testers) to
provide product testers to companies for evaluating the in-home
experience with a wide variety of products to ensure proper product

certification and greater market access.

Please note that although this job can be done from home 95% of the
time, very occasionally In-Home Product Testers may be asked to visit
the client's office, laboratory, store, warehouse or factory for
training or meetings (visits are local and scheduled at no more than 20
minutes drive from the In-Home Usage Tester address). These optional

visits are also paid by the hour.

During your application process, we will determine your consumer
profile and establish what products would be suitable for you to test
according to your demographics, lifestyle, consumer behavior, skills,
hobbies and ability. Research questionnaires are used to identify and
target certain types of consumers, to ensure the right participants are
engaged and to achieve the representative sample needed. Job candidates
for In-Home Usage Testing are also screened to meet the client’s needs
for the project to ensure that the product is one that they qualify to
test and that they have a balance of demographics and attitudes.

Participation in these product testing and consumer panels is always
free, secure and private. In-Home Usage Testing is a quick, easy and fun
way to make extra cash by telling big brands what you think about their
upcoming products and services in the American market.

Main Duties

Sign and return non-disclosure agreements before the product to be
tested is shipped. Individuals who complete the required documents will

have the products sent to their homes.

Once the product is received for In-Home Usage Test (IHUT), the
Product Tester must take care of the product being tested and use it

responsibly.

Read and strictly follow the In-Home Usage Test Daily Schedule
provided with each product testing project. In-Home Usage Test Daily
Schedules may include tasks to do such as: unpacking, reading
instructions, journal entries, online or mobile feedback, usage of
product for certain amount of time, writing reviews, taking pictures,

etc.

Properly document In-Home Usage Test as instructed in the In-Home
Usage Test Daily Schedule. Types of documentation commonly used for
In-Home Usage Tests are snapshots, audio recordings, videos and Product

Journals.

Attend Skype meetings or conference call meetings with Account
Managers, Brand Managers, Research Managers, Product Managers or small
business owners to offer ongoing product usage feedback. These short
virtual meetings may take place 2-3 times per week and are paid by the

hour also.

Some In-Home Usage Tests projects may require participants to use
MFour’s Mobile In-Home Use Test Technology (cutting edge smartphone
technology to capture Point-of-Emotion® insights to gain unparalleled

depth of responses).

Paid Product Testing is done from home 95% of the time, but very
occasionally paid Product Testers may be asked to visit the client's
office, laboratory, store, warehouse or factory for training or
meetings. These visits are paid by the hour also.

Write reviews as requested in the In-Home Usage Test Daily Schedule for each project.

Review requirements can vary, however, the standard requirement is a
written review, photos of the reviewer with the product and a video

review.

  • Great ability to follow precise instructions
    • Be open to write short reviews, record audio or short video (doesn't have to be perfect), no experience needed
    • Great attention to detail and curious spirit
    • Be able to work 15-20 hours per week and commit to a certain routine
    • Have access to a computer and a reliable internet connection
    • Have access to a digital camera or cellphone that takes pictures

• Be honest and reliable

• Good communication skills is an asset

  • No experience required
    • High School Diploma

• 18 years or older

A paid Product Tester position is perfect for those looking for an
entry level opportunity or for seasonal work, temporary work or
part-time work. The hours are completely flexible and no previous
experience is necessary. Our paid Product Testers come from all
backgrounds and industries ranging from customer service and sales to
administrative assistant. If you are a manager, receptionist, warehouse
or factory worker, driver, medical assistant, nurse, cleaner, college
student, messenger, maid, teacher, retail associate, salesperson,
secretary, server, janitor, cashier, contract worker or intern who is
looking for a flexible part time or seasonal job, you should try paid
Product Testing to supplement your income. Also if you have been
involved in accounting, clerical jobs, marketing, management, security
or data entry jobs you may qualify for a paid product tester position.

  • Very competitive salary

• Weekly pay

• Work around your schedule

  • Learn about an exciting industry
    • Telecommute (you can work from home, work or school)
    • Most of the time you can keep the product tested
    • An incredible team comprised of motivated and talented individuals

raw.excerpt: Role: HR Coordinator Location: United States or Canada (Remote/Hybrid) Client: Andromeda Software, Inc.
raw.description:
Role: HR Coordinator

Location: United States or Canada (Remote/Hybrid)

Client: Andromeda Software, Inc. (a Constellation Software Inc. operating group)

ABOUT ANDROMEDA:

Andromeda Software is an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU). Andromeda’s promise — “Permanent Home. Powered by People.” — captures how we operate: we acquire vertical market software companies with the intent to hold them permanently, and we invest deliberately in the leaders and teams who build them. The Andromeda portfolio includes 30+ companies, 22+ offices, and 2,500+ employees across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia, drawing on 100+ industry-leading tools and best practices shared across the network. CSI — one of the world’s largest acquirers of vertical market software, with 1,100+ businesses across nine operating groups — provides the scale and capital that lets Andromeda focus on long-term ownership rather than short-term exits. We think in decades, not quarters. Andromeda’s headquarters is in Markham, Ontario, Canada.

ROLE SUMMARY:

The HR Coordinator is the first call for HR administration at the Andromeda Home Office. Working as part of the Home Office HR team, the HR Coordinator keeps the people-operations basics running smoothly: accurate employee records in Workday, well-run onboarding and offboarding, clean hiring paperwork, and dependable coordination with our US and Canadian payroll partners.

Andromeda is deliberately decentralized. Business Unit HR Generalists own day-to-day HR within each business, while the Home Office HR team builds the policies, tools, and programs they operate within. The HR Coordinator supports that model by handling the administrative work behind it carefully and consistently, so that BU leaders and Home Office colleagues can rely on the HR function to be accurate, responsive, and discreet.

This is an excellent role for an early-career HR professional who wants broad exposure across HR operations, including HRIS, onboarding, recruitment support, payroll coordination, and HR communications, and who takes pride in owning their work end-to-end. Andromeda invests in its people for the long term, and this role offers a real path to grow within the HR function.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.HR Administration & HRIS (Workday):

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Andromeda Home Office team on HR administrative requests, responding promptly and following each request through to completion.
  • Perform general maintenance and administration of the Workday HRIS, including data entry, record updates, and routine transactions.
  • Ensure electronic employee files in the HRIS are complete, accurate, and well organized.
  • Maintain new hire and termination checklists so that every step is completed and documented.
  • Handle employee and candidate information with discretion, in line with Andromeda policy and applicable US and Canadian privacy requirements.

2.Onboarding & Offboarding:

  • Manage onboarding and orientation for new hires in designated business units, giving each new colleague a clear, welcoming start.
  • Coordinate IT requirements for new hires (equipment, accounts, and access) with the relevant IT contacts ahead of start dates.
  • Coordinate the background check process for candidates in the US and Canada, tracking each check to completion.
  • Complete USCIS Form I-9 accurately for US new hires as part of onboarding, ensuring it is completed within the federal deadline of three business days after the first day of employment.
  • Support the offboarding process by completing termination checklist items and keeping records current.
  • Assist with drafting and sending termination documentation as part of offboarding, under HR guidance and with appropriate review and approval.

3.Recruitment Support & Employment Documentation:

  • Support the HR team with general recruitment activities and coordination, as required.
  • Assist with creating job descriptions and job requisitions.
  • Generate offer letters and provide candidates with the necessary documentation.
  • Draft employment change letters and respond to related calls and inquiries when needed.

4.Payroll Partnership & Reporting:

  • Partner with the HR and Payroll teams in Canada and the US to ensure timesheets are completed and vacation records are reviewed.
  • Support other analytical and reconciliation procedures by checking data, flagging discrepancies early, and helping resolve them.
  • Process one-time payments and compensation-related changes in Workday for Payroll, ensuring accurate entries and timely submission in line with required approvals and payroll deadlines.

5.Communications, Stakeholders & Projects:

  • Assist in creating and editing HR content for communications, orientation materials, and presentations.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal clients and key stakeholders, and represent Andromeda well in every interaction.
  • Assist HR management with special projects and process improvements as needed.
  • Assist HRGs, HRBPs, HMs with administrative HR tasks or provide basic coverage as needed.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Intellectual Humility — Curiosity: Keeps developing their HR craft, asks good questions about the “why” behind processes, welcomes feedback as input, and is comfortable saying “I’m not sure, let me find out.”

Owner Mindset — Accountability: Owns their work end-to-end and sees commitments through. Notices what needs doing without being asked, treats confidential information and company resources with care, and finds a way forward when blocked.

Collaborative Problem Solving — Teamwork: Brings solutions, not just problems. Communicates clearly and often with HR, Payroll, IT, and BU colleagues, asks for help early, and looks for small ways to improve how the team works.

Drives Results & Operations —Metrics & Efficiency: Delivers consistently and on time, with accuracy in records, letters, and checklists. Focuses on what matters most, reduces rework, and becomes the person colleagues trust to get things done without follow-up.

Stakeholder Engagement— Influence & Connection:Builds good working relationships with Home Office and BU colleagues, tailors communication to the audience, checks what people actually need before assuming, and represents Andromeda well with candidates and new hires.

raw.description:
What if your Spanish language skills could help improve the AI.  

PROJECT DETAILS  

  • Job Title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - Spanish(Peru)

  • Project Overview: a scripted and conversational audio data collection project

  • Language: Spanish(Peru)

  • Location: Remote (Peru)

  • Compensation: 35USD per hour

   

WHAT YOU’LL DO  

  • Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. 

  • Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone — faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. 

  • Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. 

  • Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. 

  • Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code-switching into other languages or dialects. 
     

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 

Required 

  • Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. 

  • Native or native-equivalent fluency in the required language and dialect, with the ability to deliver natural, everyday-sounding speech both when reading a script and speaking spontaneously.

  • Access to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). 

  • Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic + audio interface for session recording if selected. Built-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. 

  • Owns closed-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). 

  • Comfortable both self-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions. 

Preferred (nice to have, not required) 

  • Professional voice-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. 

  • Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. 

  • An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. 

 

Please note: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. 

 

Your Data & Privacy 

Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance.

Job Description

Join Us as a Project Oversight Associate Director– Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our expert team, you’ll have the opportunity to ensure operational excellence that makes a real difference in organizational performance. As a Project Oversight Associate Director, you will oversee operational excellence to ensure high-quality deliverables and successful management of client projects and/or programs. You will maintain strategic relationships and serve as a senior leadership contact for clients. You will provide input to business development and drive the business strategy, focusing on innovation, operational efficiency, and expansion of the respiratory division's global footprint.


You will be accountable for strategic indication or client-specific management within a Therapeutic Unit. You will provide therapeutic expertise in project delivery execution, demonstrating the ability to react quickly and appropriately to escalations. You will provoke critical thinking in Project Teams related to delivery operations, financial negotiations, and risk mitigations/issue management for a project. You will drive the overall strategy development for proposals and pre-proposal opportunities.

What You’ll Do:

  • Accountable for strategic indication or client-specific portfolio management.
  • Serves as senior level or executive contact.
  • Reviews financial forecasting of Respiratory projects and programs.
  • Expertly navigates the need to dive in/dive out of situations while ensuring the Project Lead remains empowered.
  • Provokes critical thinking and drives innovation in Project Lead related to execution of delivery, financial negotiations and prioritization.
  • Provides insight into proposal strategy in prep for bid defense.
  • Initiates collaboration with Respiratory Head in development and implementation of business growth strategies.
  • Maintains awareness and engages as appropriate in the Con Mod process.
  • Communicates with People Manager(s) to support the development of the employee providing expertise and perspective related to client needs, indication and therapeutic knowledge.
  • May act as a Champion for organizational changes, offerings, developments and lead workstreams.

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 15+ years).
  • 7+ years of management responsibility
  • Advanced leadership skills

In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Capable of working independently and exercising independent judgment to assess sponsor regulatory needs and work with project team members to producing compliant deliverables
  • Advanced, broad understanding of global/regional/national country requirements/regulatory affairs procedures for clinical trial authorization, licensing, lifecycle management; expert knowledge of ICH and other global regulatory guidelines; in-depth understanding of a regulatory specialty areas, such as preclinical, clinical, CMC, publishing, etc.
  • Advanced understanding of medical terminology, statistical concepts, and guidelines
  • Outstanding analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills, including complex evaluations of intangible variables
  • Expert financial acumen with an in-depth of knowledge and practical application of budgeting, forecasting and resource management
  • Accomplished executive presence and consultation and presentation skills
  • Superior critical and strategic thinking skills that accounts for a broad impact
  • Excellent coaching and leadership skills
  • Exceptional customer service, relationship building and stakeholder management skills
  • Expert negotiation and marketing skills with ability to influence others and drive results
  • Superior judgment, decision making, escalation and risk management skills
  • Proven ability to drive corporate strategies to capture, engage and retain repeat customers

Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.
  • Able to work upright and stationary for typical working hours.
  • Ability to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.
  • Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.
  • May require travel. (Recruiter will provide more details.)
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Nous recherchons un Product Owner expérimenté pour piloter le développement d’un produit interne destiné à optimiser l’utilisation transverse d’une plateforme stratégique au sein de l’organisation. Titulaire d’un master et capable de travailler en français, néerlandais et anglais, vous coordonnez les équipes de développement et veillez à la livraison d’un produit aligné sur les besoins stratégiques et opérationnels.

Vos principales missions :

  • Définir la vision du produit avec les parties prenantes et formaliser ses objectifs stratégiques.
  • Gérer et prioriser le backlog en identifiant et en rédigeant les user stories correspondant aux besoins métier.
  • Coordonner l’équipe de développement afin de garantir la qualité des livrables et le respect des délais.
  • Préparer et animer les cérémonies Scrum, notamment le Sprint Planning, les Daily Scrums, les Sprint Reviews et les rétrospectives.
  • Faciliter l’intégration du produit dans les différents départements et soutenir son adoption ainsi que son utilisation efficace.
  • Définir des indicateurs clés de performance afin d’évaluer l’efficacité et l’impact du produit dans l’organisation.
  • Identifier les obstacles et travailler avec l’équipe technique à la mise en œuvre de solutions adaptées.

📝 Votre profil

Compétences techniques et expérience

  • Au moins 10 ans d’expérience récente et démontrée en tant que Product Owner ou Product Lead, idéalement sur des produits techniques ou des plateformes transverses.
  • Compréhension approfondie des architectures IT et expérience de plus de 10 ans dans des environnements utilisant le cloud AWS, le PaaS, la SOA, l’EDA, l’ESB, REST et l’intégration de systèmes complexes.
  • Excellente maîtrise des outils de gestion agile, notamment Jira et Confluence ou des solutions équivalentes.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la définition d’une vision produit, l’élaboration de roadmaps stratégiques et la gestion de backlogs complexes avec de multiples parties prenantes.
  • Expérience dans la gestion et la coordination d’écosystèmes d’API et de microservices, ainsi que des dépendances applicatives entre les équipes techniques et métier.
  • Bonne connaissance des architectures d’intégration, des stratégies API et des enjeux liés à la modernisation des plateformes digitales.
  • Expérience de projets de transformation cloud et de migration vers des infrastructures cloud modernes.
  • Maîtrise des méthodes Agile Scrum et connaissance des frameworks à l’échelle, tels que SAFe.
  • Expérience dans l’animation des cérémonies Agile et dans la collaboration avec des équipes de développement internes et externes.
  • Connaissances en analyse métier, modélisation des processus et formalisation des exigences, notamment BPMN, UML et requirements engineering.
  • Expérience dans des environnements réglementés et soumis à des exigences élevées en matière de sécurité, notamment dans la gestion des identités numériques, des accès et de l’authentification.
  • Expérience du pilotage de produits et services digitaux dans de grandes organisations réunissant de nombreuses parties prenantes, des équipes IT, des architectes et des responsables métier.
  • Certification Scrum Product Owner, telle que CSPO, et pratique solide des approches Agile orientées valeur.
  • Connaissance d’outils complémentaires de gestion de produit et de collaboration, comme Azure DevOps, Miro, Figma, Adobe XD et InVision.
  • Une expérience ou une certification en blockchain constitue un atout pour analyser des solutions et évaluer de nouveaux services numériques.
  • Expérience dans le secteur de la sécurité sociale.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership naturel et capacité à mobiliser des équipes techniques.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication pour fédérer les parties prenantes techniques et métier.
  • Orientation résultats et capacité à traduire une vision stratégique en produit concret et opérationnel.
  • Adaptabilité et aisance dans la gestion de situations complexes et évolutives.
  • Esprit analytique, sens de la priorisation et capacité à prendre des décisions fondées sur la valeur métier et l’impact utilisateur.
  • Capacité à faire le lien entre les métiers, l’architecture et les équipes d’ingénierie afin d’aligner les objectifs stratégiques et les contraintes techniques.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de facilitation, d’écoute active et de gestion des parties prenantes dans des contextes complexes et transverses.
  • Expérience dans l’accompagnement du changement et l’adoption de plateformes ou de services digitaux à l’échelle de l’organisation.

En complément du CV, la candidature doit répondre à la question suivante. Toute réponse absente ou insuffisante est éliminatoire : comment priorisez-vous les éléments du backlog produit et quels critères utilisez-vous pour déterminer les priorités ?

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This role is open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products.
  • Support French-speaking customers implementations.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2 - 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • English and French fluency.
  • Customer travel is expected. Up to 0-15%.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment.
  • French Fluency is a plus.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$78,412—$101,475 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About the role:

As an Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist, you’ll help ensure Samsara’s invoices and vendor payments are processed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies. You’ll report to the Accounts Payable Manager and support the procure-to-pay process.

You’ll partner with colleagues across the company and with vendors to resolve questions, keep payments moving, and improve AP processes as Samsara grows.

This role can be based in an office or fully remote within Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to make a real-world impact. Samsara helps the industries that power our world operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably. Your work will help support the teams and processes behind that mission.
  • You’re motivated to grow. You’re interested in building your AP expertise, taking ownership of your development, and learning as the business evolves.
  • You enjoy improving how work gets done. You look for practical ways to make processes clearer, more efficient, and ready to scale.
  • You value working as a team. You build respectful partnerships, communicate openly, and contribute to an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

In this role, you will:

  • Invoice and payment processing

    • Process a high volume of invoices accurately and on time.
    • Process invoices in multiple currencies for domestic and international vendors.
    • Partner with colleagues across the company to ensure invoices and payments are processed appropriately and in line with company policies and procedures.
    • Support weekly payment runs and help ensure vendors are paid on time.

    Vendor management

    • Respond to vendor inquiries through the company’s email management tool.
    • Maintain accurate accounts payable vendor records.

    Reporting, month-end close, and cross-functional initiatives

    • Reconcile account statements.
    • Support the monthly AP close, including the soft-close process, AP aging reviews, and accrual preparation.
    • Assist with the AP forecast.
    • Prepare analyses, schedules, and presentations to support audits and tax filings.

    Processes, systems, and controls

    • Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and systems, and recommend changes that support scale.
    • Document AP processes in accordance with policies and internal controls.
    • Perform and maintain AP SOX and operational controls, and follow applicable policies and internal controls.

raw.description:
Req ID:392719

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Data Migration Engineer (Informatica/DBT) to join our team remotely in the US.

Role Overview
o The Senior Data Migration Engineer serves as a hands-on technical contributor and delivery anchor, responsible for designing and implementing Python-based extract/load pipelines, dbt-based transformations, and Airflow-based orchestration for a large-scale migration from Informatica PowerCenter to a modern data stack.
o This role requires deep expertise in converting complex Informatica workflows into Python, dbt, and Airflow, and the ability to deliver production-quality, functionally equivalent output at enterprise scale.

Key Responsibilities:
• Assess complex Informatica workflows including sessions, mappings, and parameterizations and translate them into equivalent Python EL scripts and dbt transformation models.
• Develop and maintain Python EL pipelines to land high-volume data, including billion-row tables, into the target warehouse using SQLAlchemy, cx_Oracle, pyodbc, and bulk export tools such as Oracle Data Pump and SQL Server BCP.
• Design and develop dbt transformation models based on Informatica mapping logic, incorporating dbt best practices including model layering, macros, incremental strategies, and snapshot patterns.
• Develop dbt-native tests as well as custom Python unit tests to validate transformation correctness and data quality.
• Develop Airflow DAGs to orchestrate Python EL and dbt scripts end-to-end, producing output that is functionally equivalent to the source Informatica workflows.
• Contribute to GitLab CI/CD pipeline for dbt and Airflow code, including lint gates, automated testing, and deployment to shared NAS.
• Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers.
• Troubleshoot performance issues and data discrepancies during SIT and UAT, including row-count reconciliation between source Oracle/SQL Server systems and the target warehouse.
• Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and handover materials.

Required Skills & Experience:
• 5+ years of Informatica PowerCenter experience - mappings, sessions, workflows, and parameterization
• 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
• Any number of years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool
• 5+ years of Python experience, including production use of parallelism and batch data processing
• 5+ years of SQL experience - complex joins, window functions, aggregations across large datasets
• Experience with Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp) or SQL Server BCP / BULK INSERT for high-volume data movement

Preferred:
• Experience with SQLAlchemy, cx_Oracle, or pyodbc for Python-based database connectivity
• Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers in offshore delivery models

This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

Schedule: 12:30 AM – 9:00 AM

Position Summary

The Tier 2 Technician – Third Shift provides advanced technical support, maintenance, and monitoring for Company’s managed client environments during overnight hours. Responsibilities include responding to after-hours support requests, completing work best performed outside business hours, remediating failed updates and automated processes, monitoring backups and system health, and supporting scheduled maintenance and project work.

This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently. The technician keeps the team informed through clear documentation, escalation, and handoffs to the day shift.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 2 support for hardware, software, operating systems, applications, and basic network issues.
  • Respond to after-hours support requests and client tickets, including those under a dedicated support contract, prioritizing by urgency, business impact, and SLA requirements.
  • Perform software installations, OS and application updates, patching, server administration, and other scheduled maintenance. Monitor these processes and remediate failures when possible.
  • Monitor systems, alerts, and backups, and take corrective action or escalate as needed.
  • Complete assigned projects and tasks during overnight maintenance windows to minimize disruption to clients.
  • Escalate to Tier 3 or other team members when issues require additional expertise.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, system changes, and maintenance in the ticketing platform with enough detail for other staff to understand the work performed and any follow-up required.
  • Review outstanding issues from evening staff at the start of the shift, and provide a clear handoff to the day shift covering unresolved issues, completed maintenance, failed processes, and follow-up items.
  • Follow established security, change-management, escalation, and service-management procedures, and protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of client systems and data.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, managed services, or a related field.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field preferred.
  • Tier 2 support or equivalent hands-on troubleshooting experience preferred.
  • MSP or multi-client environment experience preferred.
  • Overnight, on-call, or 24/7 operations experience preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, and common business applications.
  • Experience troubleshooting software installations, Windows updates, patches, and failed automated processes.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Experience with remote support and remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and structured IT service processes.
  • Backup monitoring and troubleshooting experience preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Resolves technical issues independently with limited direct supervision.
  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally, especially in documentation and shift handoffs.
  • Stays organized, detail-oriented, and productive during overnight hours.
  • Maintains a strong customer service focus.

Preferred Certifications

  • CompTIA Security+ or Network+
  • Microsoft certifications

Work Environment

  • Primarily remote, computer-based work requiring reliable internet and an appropriate home workspace.
  • Extended periods of computer and monitor use.
  • Weekend and holiday work may be required as part of service coverage.
  • Occasional daytime events may be required, with advance notice.
Salary: $24-$32 per hour

Job Description

JOB TITLE

Senior Data Developer

LEVEL/BAND

MM22

Technology

DIRECT REPORT (JOB TITLE)

Data Development Manager

Overall Purpose of the Position

To drive and perform the activities to develop, maintain and support the Banks’ Enterprise Data Warehouse, Business Intelligence and Reporting Solutions, ensuring that the business has timely access to quality data in an efficient and effective manner and that our data stores are maintained inline with industry standards.

Operational Responsibilities

·To carry out all assigned tasks efficiently and effectively, in adherence with internal policies and procedures.

·To participate in the design and implementation of process improvements for the team.

·To participate in periodic system reviews to identify possible gaps and process inconsistencies and propose re-alignment strategies including the necessary training programmes.

Data Warehouse

·To participate in the architecture design and development of the Data Warehouse, including recoverability, resilience, data quality, data integrity and security in accordance with the Bank’s standards and industry best practices.

·To implement and maintain version control.

·To ensure proper segregation of duties within the team when it comes to implementing changes on test and production environments.

·To ensure, at all times, a current version of the documentation related to Data Warehouse architecture, data model and data dictionary is maintained.

·To monitor the state of data quality, including integrity, accuracy and consistency, within the Data Warehouse and establish goals for data quality improvements and take corrective action where necessary, including recommending updates at source with the data stewards.

·To perform the design and development activities of Data Warehouse integration with third party systems.

·To research and stay abreast of emerging Data Warehouse technologies and design methods.

Business Intelligence and Reporting

·To design and drive the development and implementation of BI solutions.

·To provide ad-hoc reports as per client/end user requirements.

·To assist our internal clients/end users in the definition of their business requirements.

·To assist/train end-users in the use of data query analysis and reporting tools.

·To promote the use of BI, BI Initiatives and Reporting tools.

Performance Management

·To establish and monitor process improvements and efficiencies to improve on the defined KPIs.

·To carry out performance benchmarking, tuning and optimisation to achieve the Bank’s desired performance results on/from the Data Warehouse.

Qualifications, Skills & Competencies

Mandatory

Skill

  • Excellent communication skills (including written and oral) - able to relate to various members of the organisation;
  • Ability to challenge the status quo and inspire others to identify opportunities and areasfor improvement;
  • Proven experience of working under pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Customer Driven with an ability to prioritise issues based on impact.
  • Excellent understanding of data administration and management functions (collection, analysis, distribution etc.)

Experience

  • Minimum of two years’ experience in Data Development/ Data Warehousing ;
  • Working knowledge of ETL and ETL techniques (technologies include Microsoft SSIS and SAP Data Services)
  • Experience in designing, developing and implementing Data Warehouse environments;
  • Hands on experience with SQL, PL/SQL and Transact SQL;
  • Knowledge of Data Reporting and KPIs.

Qualification

  • Possess a first degree level of education in IT or Engineering or equivalent specialised training in data warehousing and/or BI;.

Desirable

Skill

  • Requirements gathering;
  • Business and Process ANalysis;

Experience

  • Software Development;
  • Sprint planning.

Qualification

  • Banking/ Accounting Qualification.

Position level (1 being the highest level)

  1. Head of Department
  2. Managerial & Specialist Positions
  3. Middle Management & Specialist Positions
  4. Technical & Clerical Positions

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with the ability to guide and mentor team members while collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders. You will partner with data analysts, data scientists, technology teams, and business leaders to design, implement, and optimize advanced analytics solutions that support internal and external clients. With over a million managed lives and terabytes of healthcare data generated, your contributions will be critical to driving data-driven decision making and improving patient outcomes.

  • Contribute to the design and execution of Astrana Health’s enterprise analytics roadmap aligned with growth and value-based care objectives.
  • Lead the development of scalable analytics solutions and BI dashboards using tools such as Databricks and Power BI.

  • Promote best practices in analytics, data engineering, and BI development.
  • Lead and mentor a team of analytics professionals supporting HEDIS quality measurement and Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) analytics.

  • Partner with business stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Quality Improvement, Finance) to translate requirements into scalable analytic solutions and drive actionable insights.
  • Establish QA protocols and ensure data integrity for all reporting deliverables.
  • Drive improvements to Star Ratings performance and risk score accuracy through advanced analytics and process optimization.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and IT to enhance data infrastructure, implement new measures, and resolve source data quality issues.
  • Conduct performance reviews and set development goals, to build team strength.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.
You're a great fit for this role if you:
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy leading teams to solve complex data challenges.
  • Are passionate about mentoring and growing the next generation of data engineering talent.
  • Have a bias for action and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions with measurable impact.
  • Bring a collaborative, team-first mindset to everything you do.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

Contently is on a mission to change the way content marketing is traditionally done.
