Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Security and Compliance Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in maintaining and enhancing our security posture, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and collaborating across teams to mitigate risks. This position involves hands-on technical work, process optimization, and project management in a dynamic SaaS environment. The responsibilities listed below are non-exhaustive; you will have access to established onboarding procedures and will grow by assuming broader ownership over time. Key aspects include implementing security tools, reviewing processes, and driving cross-functional initiatives to meet security obligations.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct penetration tests using specialized tools to identify vulnerabilities and collaborate with Development or DevOps teams to plan and implement remediation strategies.
  • Coordinate with external Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) vendors for audits, serving as the liaison between the vendor and the engineering team.
  • Partner with the DevOps team to perform cloud security audits and develop remediation plans.
  • Respond to security questionnaires from customers or vendors and address security-related questions during virtual meetings.
  • Lead security-related projects, providing regular progress updates and reports.
  • Implement and configure tools to enhance security practices, including static code analysis and automated code audits.
  • Manage the security calendar and execute activities such as:
  1. Cloud Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises in collaboration with the DevOps team.
  2. Cryptographic audits (including encryption at rest and in transit) and key rotation processes with DevOps support.
  3. Audits of automated code quality checks within CI/CD pipelines.
  4. Reviews of standard operating procedures to ensure adherence and timely execution.
  • Oversee the compliance calendar for standards such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, and future certifications, including:
  1. Coordinating with responsible teams to ensure all required activities are completed on schedule.
  2. Responding to technical and process-related inquiries during audits alongside other team members.
  3. Monitoring and ensuring employee security training and retraining programs are up to date.
  4. Tracking and maintaining all security-related metrics.
  5. Handling any additional audit-related tasks.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of SaaS applications and associated security challenges.
  • Familiarity with one or more cloud platforms, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Knowledge of fundamental networking concepts, including OSI layers, TLS protocols, and cryptography.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, Node.js).
  • Awareness of common security risks, including OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, and recent CVE vulnerabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with internal and external stakeholders, as well as project reporting.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving security trends.

Preferred Skills and Knowledge

Experience with security compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar; relevant cybersecurity certifications are a plus.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent in a related field, such as Computer Engineering, Electronics, or Telecommunications.

At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.

raw.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Job Highlights

  • Role: Senior Motion & Graphic Designer

  • Department: Creative

  • Salary Band: $90,000 - $110,000

  • Location: Remote (U.S.)

  • Position Status: Actively hiring for this role

  • Application Deadline: We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no cutoff date. If this job sounds like you, go for it.

    • Today, we're looking for a Senior Motion & Graphic Designer to join our growing team.

    We're hiring a Senior Performance Creative to partner with our Creative Strategist and turn research, hooks, and loose briefs into polished static and short-form video ads for paid social. The role requires strong range across design and motion editing, including cutting raw shoot footage into finished assets. It also requires the brand fluency to stay on-brand at high volume, whether working from a one-pager or a full brand system, while pushing creative into fresh territory.

    Here’s what we expect from our Senior Motion & Graphic Designer.

—What You'll Do—

    • Translate strategy into visuals: partner closely with our Creative Strategist to take research, hooks, and loose creative briefs and turn them into concrete visual concepts, storyboards, and finished assets
    • Produce both statics and video: design and build static ad creative and edit/produce short-form video and motion content for paid social at a consistently high craft level
    • Interpret brand guidance at any altitude: work from anything ranging from a thin one-pager to a comprehensive brand system, and reliably produce creative that's unmistakably on-brand either way
    • Navigate regulated-industry review cycles: produce creative that anticipates compliance and legal scrutiny, minimizing revision rounds and rejection risk without watering down creative quality
    • Push brands into new creative territory: identify opportunities to evolve a brand's creative expression to unlock scale and new-market growth, while staying inside brand-safety guardrails
    • Select and edit raw footage/imagery: review raw photography and video footage from shoots and select, crop, cut, and edit the strongest material into finished assets — no on-set creative direction required
    • Own asset quality and turnaround: deliver polished, client-ready work with minimal internal revision cycles so assets aren't burning days internally before they even reach the client
    • Maintain visual consistency at scale: keep creative consistent and on-brand across a high volume of ad variations, formats, and platform

—What we are looking for—

    Core Experience
    • 5+ years in a hands-on creative production role — Art Director, Senior Designer, Creative Producer, or similar —with dedicated performance/paid social experience
    • A portfolio that shows range across both static design and video/motion editing, ideally for paid social specifically
    • Experience working within brand guidelines of varying depth and translating them into new creative applications
    • Experience in regulated or highly regulated industries (healthcare, finance, insurance, legal, or similar) is a strong plus, given our client base
    • Experience working in matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders and layered approval processes

    Craft & Technical Skills
    • Expert-level proficiency in Figma (or similar) for static design and layout
    • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or similar) for motion graphics and video editing
    • Comfortable editing raw video/photo footage into finished assets: selects, cuts, pacing, captions/graphics overlays
    • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator) as needed
    • Understands platform-specific creative specs and best practices across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and other paid social channels

    Creative & Strategic Judgment

    • A strong eye for what "good" looks like in modern performance advertising — thumb-stopping, polished, and effective, not just pretty
    • Understands performance/paid-social fundamentals (hooks, pacing, hierarchy, CTAs) well enough to make smart creative calls independently, without needing to run the strategy
    • Can take a loose brief or visual direction and fill in the gaps with sound creative judgment
    • High attention to detail — typos, brand misapplications, and spec errors don't make it to client review
    • Comfortable giving and receiving fast, iterative feedback in a deadline-driven environment

    Working Style
    • Thrives on speed without sacrificing polish — this role owns production timelines that need to move fast to offset long approval cycles
    • Collaborative by nature; sees the Creative Strategist as a partner, not a hand-off point
    • Self-sufficient in production; doesn't need heavy oversight to get from brief to finished asset

—What success looks like—

    • Assets consistently reach client/compliance review in 1–2 internal revision rounds or fewer
    • Creative reliably passes compliance and legal review with minimal rework
    • Output balances brand safety with creative freshness — clients see growth and new territory, not just "more of the same"
    • The Strategist and Senior Performance Creative function as a true two-person creative engine, each covering what the other doesn't

—What This Role Is Not—

    • Not a photo/video shoot creative director — you won't be expected to run or direct live shoots, just to select and edit from what's captured
    • Not a pure strategist — research, testing frameworks, and reporting live with the Creative Strategist, not this role

—Why Silverback?—

    Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

  • Work with the A team: We are ruthless about putting the best possible team on the field.

  • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

  • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

  • Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

    Great work deserves great support. That’s why we offer a competitive total compensation package, with benefits built around how our people actually live and work.

  • Fully remote team

  • Unlimited PTO & Summer Fridays

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks for primary caregivers, 6 weeks for non-primary caregivers

  • Life and short term disability insurance, on us

  • 401(k) with employer match

  • Company-paid ClassPass membership

  • Monthly Team Events that bring our remote team together

—Work Environment—

  • We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the U.S., and our culture is built for it. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication so work moves forward and no one is left guessing.

  • We pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly “work hard, play hard” mentality.

  • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss.

    • Think this sounds like your kind of team? Apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. raw.title: Principal Mini Program Architect OleOle | Platform Architecture & Engineering
raw.excerpt: We’re not looking for beginners if you don’t have the skill set please do not send your résumé As Principal Mini Program Architect, you will own the technical architecture and engineering direction of OleOle’s Mini Program platform.
raw.description:
We’re not looking for beginners if you don’t have the skill set please do not send your résumé

As Principal Mini Program Architect, you will own the technical architecture and engineering direction of OleOle’s Mini Program platform.

You will design the infrastructure, developer frameworks, APIs, security architecture, and runtime environment that allow third-party Mini Programs to be created, deployed, discovered, and operated securely at global scale.

This is a hands-on architecture and engineering position, not simply a management role.

You will work closely with OleOle’s frontend, backend, identity, payments, security, and infrastructure engineers to establish a unified technical architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect the Mini Program runtime, including sandboxed execution, resource management, application lifecycle, and secure integration with the OleOle host platform.
  • Design the Mini Program SDK, APIs, developer tooling, and application frameworks.
  • Establish developer workflows for application creation, testing, submission, review, publishing, deployment, versioning, and updates.
  • Design secure authentication, authorization, identity, and permissions between Mini Programs and the OleOle platform.
  • Integrate Mini Programs with OleOle’s existing identity and Wallet ID architecture, enabling a consistent user identity across applications.
  • Architect integration with OleOle’s payments infrastructure to support transactions, commerce, and financial services within Mini Programs.
  • Define standards for performance, reliability, scalability, isolation, and security.
  • Design application discovery, distribution, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish technical standards, documentation, and development practices for external developers.
  • Make practical architectural decisions that support rapid initial delivery without compromising the platform’s ability to scale.
  • Work directly with engineering teams to implement and validate the architecture.

The successful candidate will have substantial ownership of one of OleOle’s most important long-term technology initiatives.

Skills & Engineering Requirements

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience designing complex platforms or developer ecosystems.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern web application architectures.
  • Deep understanding of browser runtimes, WebViews, JavaScript execution environments, and application sandboxing.
  • Experience designing SDKs, APIs, developer platforms, and extensible application frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of microservices, distributed systems, backend infrastructure, and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with secure authentication and authorization, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token-based authentication, and permissions management.
  • Knowledge of API security, application isolation, content security policies, and third-party code execution risks.
  • Experience designing high-scale cloud-native systems, preferably using AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of application performance, caching, monitoring, observability, and reliability engineering.
  • Ability to translate platform architecture into production-quality engineering implementations.

Highly Valuable Experience

  • Direct experience with WeChat Mini Programs, Alipay Mini Programs, or similar embedded application ecosystems.
  • Experience building developer SDKs, plugin architectures, extensions, application marketplaces, or embedded app frameworks.
  • Familiarity with React, React Native, or comparable frontend frameworks.
  • Experience with mobile-to-web interoperability and cross-platform application delivery.
  • Knowledge of digital wallets, payment orchestration, transaction APIs, and financial platform integration.
  • Experience building developer portals, testing environments, application approval systems, and publishing pipelines.
  • Experience designing platforms that support large numbers of independent third-party developers.

What Matters Most

We are looking for an architect who understands how to build an application ecosystem, not simply an engineer who has developed individual applications.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise, practical engineering judgment, security awareness, and the ability to build foundational technology from the ground up.

Experience with existing Mini Program ecosystems is particularly valuable, but we will also consider outstanding platform architects who have built comparable developer ecosystems, SDKs, application runtimes, or extensible software platforms.

We value engineers who can make decisions, write code, solve difficult architectural problems, and deliver working systems.

Solutions not problems .

  • Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
  • Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
  • An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
  • Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

Deferred compensation

This opportunity is designed for entrepreneurial, startup-minded engineers who want to help build a significant global business. This is not free work. Compensation is agreed upon and deferred until funding is secured, at which point it transitions to a competitive, normalized salary plus equity and OleX token ownership. Our entire team, including the founder, operates under this arrangement. This position is intended for individuals who understand the risks of an early-stage startup, are comfortable with uncertain funding timelines, and are motivated by the opportunity to build something substantial while participating in its long-term ownership and success.

Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

What We’re Building

OleOle is building a global digital platform dedicated to football, bringing together social networking, messaging, live scores, content, commerce, and a new ecosystem of Mini Programs.

Our ambition is to create a platform serving 400 million football fans worldwide, with an ecosystem of 2 million professional football teams, brands, businesses, and developers creating Mini Programs that operate directly within OleOle.

Mini Programs are central to this vision.

Rather than requiring users to download separate applications, OleOle will enable businesses, football clubs, and independent developers to build lightweight, integrated applications that run within the OleOle ecosystem.

A football club could create a Mini Program for merchandise, memberships, ticketing, or exclusive fan experiences. A global brand could create interactive campaigns, product experiences, or customer services. Independent developers could build applications for commerce, entertainment, travel, utilities, and other services.

These Mini Programs will share a common foundation for identity, authentication, payments, permissions, discovery, and integration with the broader OleOle platform.

Our objective is not simply to introduce another application feature. We are building a developer ecosystem and application platform within OleOle, enabling millions of businesses and developers to create services that can reach a global audience without requiring users to leave the platform.

We are looking for an exceptional architect who can design the technical foundations of this ecosystem from the ground up.

OleOle — Where Fans Kick Off.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an AI Engineer to build, test, and support AI workflows and agents on an enterprise AI workflow management platform supporting the Department of the Air Force. You will work directly with the AI Platform Architect to turn platform designs and government use cases into tested, production-ready solutions in Azure IL-5 cloud environments, integrated with ServiceNow. You will build within the frameworks, patterns, and tools the Architect establishes, including Microsoft AI Foundry and third-party agentic platforms, and help translate customer mission needs into working prototypes and deployed workflows.

Responsibilities:

Workflow & Agent Development

  • Build AI workflows and agents using the platform's frameworks, tools, and reference architectures
  • Develop RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector search, and retrieval tuning
  • Build prompt chains, tool calls, and agent logic for document generation, summarization, and task automation
  • Integrate AI workflows with Azure OpenAI services, ServiceNow APIs (Flow Designer, REST, scripted integrations), and internal data sources
  • Build reusable components, templates, and connectors that both technical and non-technical users can leverage
  • Implement workflow orchestration and business process automation

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and execute test plans for AI workflows, including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing
  • Build evaluation datasets and automated evaluation harnesses to measure the accuracy, relevance, groundedness, and reliability of LLM outputs
  • Define and track success metrics and evaluation criteria for AI-driven workflows
  • Identify, document, and triage defects, hallucinations, and performance issues, and drive root-cause analysis and remediation
  • Perform regression testing when models, prompts, or platform components change
  • Architect Support & Collaboration
  • Partner with the AI Platform Architect to implement designs, evaluate tools, and give feedback on platform capabilities and limitations
  • Prototype solutions and proofs-of-concept for government use cases, and present results to customers and stakeholders
  • Work with ServiceNow developers and Azure cloud engineers to troubleshoot integration issues across Azure, ServiceNow, and government networks
  • Contribute to design reviews, engineering standards, and technical documentation
  • Support technical screening of AI/ML talent when requested

Operations & Monitoring

  • Support monitoring, logging, and alerting for AI workflows and agents
  • Manage prompt and model versioning, and support CI/CD deployments of AI services
  • Monitor output quality, model drift, and data quality in production workflows, and report findings
  • Track model and compute usage costs and recommend optimizations

Government & Compliance

  • Build and operate within DISA STIGs, IL-5 requirements, and Department of the Air Force security policies
  • Implement CUI handling and data classification controls in AI workflows
  • Provide engineering evidence and documentation to cybersecurity teams for ATO and continuous monitoring.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • US Citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a secret clearance.
  • 15+ Years of relevant experience (Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field may be substituted for 5 years of relevant experience).
  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including RAG, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows
  • Proficiency in Python, plus experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks
  • Experience with Azure cloud services (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, DevOps, API Management)
  • Experience with containers (Docker) and REST API development and integration
  • Working knowledge of vector databases and embedding strategies
  • Experience with test automation and QA for software or AI systems
  • Experience with ServiceNow integration or scripting (Flow Designer, REST APIs, or development)
  • Ability to translate requirements into working solutions and communicate technical results to non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools and business process automation.

  • Desired:
    • Active Secret clearance (Top Secret eligibility preferred)
    • Experience in government cloud environments (Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, or similar)
    • Experience with Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
    • Familiarity with DoD compliance frameworks (IL-4/IL-5, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, STIGs)
    • Experience with MLOps tools and practices (MLflow, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring)
    • Experience with PostgreSQL and data modeling for AI workloads
    • Experience with ATO processes and security accreditation
    • Experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer or ServiceNow development certification
    • Sec+ certification
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

raw.description:
The Vendor Management Specialist coordinates and maintains Neumo’s vendor registration, vendor packets, business licenses, corporate information, and procurement documentation. The role sits within Finance / Procurement Operations, reports to the SVP, Legal and Contracts, and supports the infrastructure required for Neumo to do business with government and public-sector customers at scale.

    This position supports Sales, Customer Success, Proposal Operations, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and other internal teams by responding to high-volume requests for vendor packets, supplier registrations, procurement portal submissions, business licenses, revenue and tax information, insurance documentation, and related materials.

    The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable working across multiple systems, portals, and stakeholder groups. This is an administrative and operational support role (not strategic sourcing or vendor negotiation) requiring accuracy, confidentiality, follow-through, and sound escalation judgment.

    Key Responsibilities

    Government Customer Vendor Packet Support

  • Coordinate, accurately and timely complete, submit, and track government customer vendor packets, supplier onboarding forms, procurement portal registrations, and related documentation requests.
  • Respond to standard customer requests for W-9s, ACH/payment information, certificates of insurance, entity information, tax forms, business licenses, corporate details, and other procurement materials.
  • Maintain records of completed vendor packets, portal credentials, recurring customer requirements, submitted documentation, and pending follow-up items.
  • Review incoming requests to identify missing information, unusual terms, non-standard certifications, security questionnaires, revenue disclosures, or other items requiring escalation.

    • Corporate Information, Registrations, and Procurement Portal Maintenance

    • Maintain accurate corporate information across SAM.gov, state and local procurement portals, cooperative purchasing platforms, channel partner systems, and other vendor management platforms.
    • Coordinate updates to company profiles, entity details, addresses, tax and banking information, points of contact, certifications, business classifications, and other required corporate data.
    • Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Tax, Security, Insurance, Procurement, and executive stakeholders to confirm accuracy before submitting updates, certifications, filings, or corporate profile changes.
    • Maintain documentation of submitted filings, profile updates, approvals, and supporting materials; escalate items involving legal certifications, government representations, ownership or financial disclosures, compliance attestations, or non-standard procurement terms.

    Business License and Registration Administration

    • Support the administration, renewal, and tracking of business licenses, local registrations, and related public-sector operating requirements.
    • Maintain a centralized tracker of license obligations, filing deadlines, renewal dates, jurisdictional requirements, fees, and supporting documentation.
    • Coordinate with Finance, Tax, Legal, and external advisors to gather required information for filings, renewals, and customer documentation requests.
    • Support research and intake for new business license requirements triggered by customer contracts, RFPs, new jurisdictions, channel partner requirements, or operational expansion.

    Revenue, Finance, Proposal, and Procurement Support

    • Support approved requests for revenue-related or company information required for vendor registration, customer onboarding, procurement documentation, channel partner submissions, or public-sector reporting.
    • Coordinate internally to obtain accurate revenue, tax, payment, insurance, banking, and entity information from the appropriate source of truth; maintain records of what was provided, to whom, when, and for what purpose.
    • Support Proposal Specialists by gathering standard vendor documentation, business licenses, certificates, registrations, and other materials for RFPs, bids, renewals, and procurement submissions.
    • Maintain a library of commonly requested vendor documents, procurement registrations, and standard company materials for reuse in proposals, portals, partner platforms, and customer onboarding.
    • Provide administrative support for internal procurement, including vendor onboarding, supplier file organization, intake tracking, record maintenance, and routing requests based on risk, spend, data access, or certification requirements.

    Process, Systems, and Escalation Management

    • Maintain trackers, shared repositories, ticket queues, intake forms, and workflow tools used to manage vendor packet, business license, registration, and procurement documentation requests.
    • Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, and job aids for recurring vendor management, procurement portal updates, and customer documentation processes.
    • Identify bottlenecks, duplicate requests, outdated materials, missing documentation, expired registrations, and opportunities for templates, automation, or self-service.

    Required Qualifications

    • 2+ years of experience in vendor management, procurement operations, finance operations, customer operations, contract administration, sales operations, proposal support, business licensing, government contracting support, or a related administrative function.
    • Experience with high-volume documentation, form completion, vendor/customer onboarding, procurement, or portal-based submission processes.
    • Strong administrative, organizational, follow-up, quality-control, written communication, and verbal communication skills.
    • High attention to detail and ability to accurately complete complex forms, portals, and documentation packages while managing multiple deadlines and stakeholders.
    • Ability to handle sensitive financial, tax, banking, insurance, customer, and company information with discretion.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, Teams), Google Workspace, or similar tools, and ability to learn procurement portals, CRM, CLM, ERP, and ticketing systems.
    • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Legal Studies, Public Administration, or a related field preferred but not required.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience working with state, local, or public-sector customers, including government procurement portals, vendor registration platforms, SAM.gov, GSA, cooperative purchasing platforms, or public-sector documentation processes.
    • Experience supporting SaaS, technology, payments, managed services, professional services, or GovTech organizations.
    • Familiarity with standard vendor packet materials (W-9s, ACH forms, certificates of insurance, business licenses, tax forms, banking documentation, and compliance questionnaires).
    • Experience with Salesforce, Ironclad, Intacct/Sage Intacct, SharePoint, or similar systems.

    Success Measures

    Success will be measured by timely completion of vendor packets and registrations; reduced delays in onboarding, renewals, invoicing, and payment setup; accurate business license and procurement portal tracking; improved documentation organization; strong internal stakeholder satisfaction; consistent escalation of non-standard requests; and improved audit readiness across vendor and supplier records.

    Compensation

    The expected base salary range for this role is $65,000 to $82,000 annually, with a target hiring range of $68,000 to $76,000, depending on experience, location, skills, systems familiarity, public-sector procurement experience, and internal equity. Candidates located in or near Centreville, Virginia / Northern Virginia are preferred, though the role may be performed remotely within the United States.

    Working Environment

    This is a remote or hybrid role depending on company needs. The position requires frequent use of computer systems, customer portals, workflow tools, and virtual meetings. Occasional work outside standard business hours may be required to support urgent onboarding, procurement, or payment-related deadlines.

    Neumo Summary:

    With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States.

    Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more.

    Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment.

    Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.

Senior Clinical Research Associate

Valencia, California – REMOTE FOR THE RIGHT CANDIDATE | WEST COAST BASED PREFERRED

Join Advanced Bionics as a Senior Clinical Research Associate and take a lead role in the operational execution of global medical device clinical studies from study start-up through close-out. You will manage complex investigative sites, drive study quality and performance, identify and mitigate operational risks, and serve as an experienced clinical operations resource to study teams while helping advance innovative hearing healthcare technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Independently lead the operational execution of assigned global clinical studies from site start-up through close-out in accordance with study protocols, ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, and applicable international regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits (SQV, SIV, IMV, and COV) for complex or high-priority studies.

  • Lead site activation, investigator training, study device accountability, close-out planning, and other activities required to achieve study milestones.

  • Serve as the primary operational lead for assigned investigative sites, monitoring enrollment, site performance, protocol compliance, and data quality while proactively identifying and mitigating risks.

  • Independently resolve complex monitoring findings, protocol deviations, data queries, and site-performance issues while escalating significant risks with recommended solutions.

  • Maintain inspection-ready TMF/eTMF and investigator site documentation, support audits and regulatory inspections, and promote consistent application of clinical quality standards.

  • Partner with Clinical Trial Management, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, and external vendors while mentoring CRAs and supporting clinical operations process improvements.

More about you

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or another related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of clinical research experience, including at least 2 years of independent site monitoring.

  • Experience managing multiple clinical sites and working with CTMS, EDC, and eTMF systems.

  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, clinical monitoring, site management, and data quality.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex studies, multiple priorities, operational risks, and site-performance challenges.

  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

  • Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to study sites, conferences, and other study-related activities.

Preferred qualifications include: a Master's degree or equivalent; ACRP-CRA, ACRP-CP, or SOCRA CCRP certification; experience in Class III medical device clinical trials, global multicenter studies, FDA IDE/PMA or EU MDR clinical studies; experience mentoring junior CRAs or leading monitoring activities; and knowledge of Risk-Based Monitoring/RbQM.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Let’s be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They’re seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the ‘doing more with less’ memos. If you’re currently at a startup that’s struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that ‘growth’ story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we’re expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we’re looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You’ve successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What’s in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC’s hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
We are currently looking for a EHRM Ops Support Analyst for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role provides operational support for Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) HL7 integration points, helping ensure secure and reliable data exchange between VA clinical systems and partner organizations. The analyst monitors HL7 message dashboards, supports production troubleshooting, assists with interface testing, and coordinates with engineering and architecture teams to resolve integration issues.

This position works closely with technical teams and the Technical Project Manager (TPM) to support Interface System Testing (IST), release planning, and EHRM site go-lives. Occasional off-hours availability is required to support scheduled releases, site go-lives, and related production activities.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Regularly monitor HL7 message dashboards to identify integration issues, message failures, and potential disruptions in data exchange.
  • Support production and integration troubleshooting calls specific to EHRM, assisting with real-time issue identification and resolution.
  • Attend and support Interface System Testing (IST) sessions across EHRM interfaces ahead of scheduled site go-lives.
  • Assist with log-level investigations of EHRM data flows, partnering with engineering teams to identify root causes of HL7 integration issues.
  • Support EHRM release planning and site go-lives by coordinating with the Technical Project Manager (TPM) to track readiness activities and outstanding items.
  • Provide hands-on operational support during EHRM site go-lives and releases, including occasional off-hours availability around these events.
  • Maintain accurate release documentation, test records, and release and incident logs while coordinating findings and status updates with development and architecture teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education, or an equivalent degree.
  • 3–5 years of experience in operational support, monitoring, or production support, preferably within a healthcare data or integration environment.
  • Working knowledge of HL7 messaging standards, including the ability to monitor message flows and recognize integration issues.
  • Experience using monitoring tools or dashboards in a production environment to identify and track operational issues.
  • Ability to support live troubleshooting calls, communicate technical findings, and remain effective under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technical and project teams.
  • Ability to support occasional off-hours activities around scheduled EHRM site go-lives and releases.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) or Oracle Health platforms.
  • Exposure to Mirth Connect, MuleSoft, or comparable healthcare integration middleware.
  • Familiarity with Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) standards and healthcare data exchange.
  • Experience working with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal healthcare agencies.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

A senior data architecture leader with deep experience in enterprise data platforms, insurance data ecosystems, and policy administration platforms. You bring a product mindset, strong architecture discipline, and hands-on delivery credibility to shape ALIP data solutions that are intuitive to consume, easy to extend, and aligned to the evolving needs of life insurance and annuity clients.

You will act as the product and architecture authority for ALIP data solutions, including ALIP, ALIP Staging, Q&I, Digital Connect, reporting, analytics, integration solutions, and future AI-enabled capabilities.

The Work:

  • Define and own the long-term data architecture vision across ALIP, ALIP Staging, Q&I, Digital Connect, reporting, analytics, and integration solutions.

  • Establish enterprise data architecture standards, principles, governance models, and architecture review practices for major ALIP data initiatives.

  • Own the strategic roadmap for ALIP and ALIP Staging as core ALIP product capabilities, improving usability, consistency, completeness, and business value of the data structures.

  • Define enhancements that simplify downstream data consumption for reporting, integrations, analytics, regulatory reporting, data warehouses, and enterprise data platforms.

  • Serve as the primary ALIP data architecture advisor for client implementations and strategic pursuits.

  • Help clients understand and leverage ALIP data assets, including ALIP Staging, within their enterprise data strategy.

  • Guide clients and implementation teams in mapping ALIP data structures to downstream applications, enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, CRM platforms, regulatory reporting systems, finance systems, and analytics platforms.

  • Create reusable mapping frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and implementation patterns that improve repeatability across clients.

  • Identify recurring client data challenges and translate them into product roadmap improvements.

  • Lead the evolution of ALIP data architecture toward modern, event-driven, CDC-based, streaming, and real-time consumption models.

  • Partner with product, engineering, delivery, and client teams to improve scalability, maintainability, performance, and ease of adoption.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary depending on business need and client requirements.

raw.description:
Pay: $135,000.00 - $165,000.00 per year

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • Lead impactful federal construction projects that support essential infrastructure and public facilities across the country.
  • Enjoy remote work flexibility while taking ownership of complex, large-scale construction projects.
  • Work with an experienced team that values leadership, collaboration, and delivering exceptional results.
  • Take on a high-impact role with direct influence over project performance, schedules, budgets, and successful delivery.
  • Apply your federal construction expertise to challenging projects with meaningful long-term impact.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation and opportunities to grow your leadership experience.

Location:

Chicago, IL | Remote with Occasional Travel

We offer remote work flexibility for highly experienced federal construction professionals. Candidates in the Chicago area are preferred, but exceptionally qualified applicants from other locations will also be considered. Occasional travel to a federal construction project site in Alabama is required.

Note:

Candidates should have 7+ years of federal construction project management experience, including demonstrated success leading large-scale federal construction projects. Strong federal project leadership experience and the ability to travel occasionally are essential. Remote eligibility will depend on relevant experience and qualifications.

About Us

Confidential Employer.

We are a dedicated general contractor specializing in federal construction projects nationwide. Our team delivers complex construction solutions with a strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and exceptional results.

We believe successful projects begin with experienced professionals who take ownership, solve challenges, and lead with integrity. We're looking for a talented Senior Project Manager to help us deliver meaningful construction projects.

Job Description

  • Lead and oversee large-scale federal construction projects from planning through successful completion.
  • Manage project schedules, budgets, resources, and overall construction performance.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors, project teams, engineers, and government representatives.
  • Ensure construction activities comply with federal contract requirements, specifications, and quality standards.
  • Monitor project progress, proactively resolve challenges, and keep projects on schedule and within budget.
  • Oversee subcontractor performance, change orders, project documentation, and reporting.
  • Build strong relationships with project stakeholders while maintaining clear communication.
  • Support project closeout, financial performance, and continuous improvement throughout the construction lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of federal construction project management experience.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale federal construction projects.
  • Strong knowledge of federal construction contracts, scheduling, budgeting, and subcontractor management.
  • Experience coordinating with federal agencies and project stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex construction projects.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to the project site in Tuskegee, AL.
  • VA healthcare construction or Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) project experience preferred.
  • Chicago-area residence preferred but not required.

Why You Will Love Working Here

We believe great construction leaders deserve the opportunity to make an impact while enjoying flexibility and professional growth.

You'll have the chance to lead meaningful federal projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, and bring your expertise to a team that values accountability, innovation, and results.

If you're an experienced Federal Construction Project Manager looking for an opportunity to lead challenging projects with remote flexibility, we'd love to hear from you!

JPC - 3140

Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Vision insurance

raw.title: Salesforce B2B Commerce Technical Architect
raw.excerpt: Come and be part of a living ecosystem where the future of business is created and lived every day.
raw.description:
Come and be part of a living ecosystem where the future of business is created and lived every day. Be part of this transformation!

At LUZA Group, passion, perseverance and the will to push beyond limits define our path to success. We are a Portuguese multinational present in several markets, with solutions in engineering, IT, design, consulting, Industry 4.0, training and recruitment.

This is a time of growth and opportunity. The future belongs to visionary minds. Join us!

Role Responsibilities and Tasks

  • Define the overall Salesforce B2B Commerce (LWR) architecture, including storefront design, Experience Cloud configuration, data models, and the security model.
  • Translate complex B2B commerce requirements into scalable technical designs, focusing on features like account hierarchies, price books, contract pricing, approval workflows, and custom product catalogs.
  • Design and oversee the integration architecture utilizing MuleSoft to connect Salesforce with ERP (e.g., SAP), PIM, OMS, Identity Providers, payment gateways, and logistics systems.
  • Conduct rigorous technical design reviews, establish secure coding standards, and govern performance optimization across environments.
  • Ensure seamless data flow and process alignment between Salesforce B2B Commerce, Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud.
  • Establish development standards, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps governance models for Salesforce B2B Commerce projects.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to internal developers, system integrators, and offshore/onshore teams.
  • Support cutover, go-live, and post-launch stabilization, including performance tuning, CDN caching optimization, and issue resolution.
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and enterprise architects to ensure the commerce strategy aligns with the broader enterprise technology roadmap.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 10 years of professional experience.
  • Deep domain expertise in B2B commerce models, with the ability to translate complex business processes (quoting, contract pricing, bulk ordering, custom catalogs) into scalable system designs.
  • Proven experience transforming and migrating legacy eCommerce platforms to Salesforce B2B Commerce.
  • Strong knowledge of the end-to-end order lifecycle, from storefront browsing to fulfillment and invoicing.
  • Experience working in global, multi-brand, multi-country commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with Master Data Management (MDM) concepts to ensure data integrity across CRM, PIM, and B2B Commerce.
  • Awareness of cross-cloud data harmonization techniques, including Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP) or multi-org strategies for global enterprises.
  • Advantage: Familiarity with complex manufacturing/automotive business models (dealer networks, tiered pricing, spare parts, long product lifecycles).
  • Senior expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce on Core, specifically using LWR (Lightning Web Runtime) and Experience Builder.
  • Deep understanding of the core Salesforce architecture, including Sales/Service Cloud data models (Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Orders).
  • Strong experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Flow, and Salesforce REST/GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of modern web standards, responsive design principles, and web accessibility guidelines (WCAG) for custom LWC development.
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity, event-driven architectures, and middleware (hands-on experience designing for MuleSoft is highly preferred).
  • Expertise in authentication (OAuth, SSO), sharing rules, permissions, and storefront performance optimization (Salesforce CDN, caching strategies).
  • Experience with Salesforce CI/CD tools, version control, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Expertise in complex data migration strategies, including mapping legacy product catalogs, account structures, and historical order data into Salesforce core data models.
  • Strong architecture documentation skills (solution diagrams, integration blueprints, data flow diagrams).
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder-management abilities.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of bridging the gap between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to make pragmatic, solution-oriented architectural decisions under constraints.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively in international and cross-functional agile teams.
  • Fluency in English (mandatory).
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (mandatory)
  • Salesforce Certified B2B Solution Architect (mandatory)Salesforce Certified Application Architect (strongly preferred)

Additional Requirements

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II (strongly preferred)
  • B2B Commerce for Administrators Accredited Professional (strongly preferred)
  • B2B Commerce for Developers Accredited Professional (strongly preferred)
  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) (highly desirable)
  • SAP, MuleSoft, or broader Enterprise Integration Architecture certifications are a strong advantage.

raw.description:
Role Title: Video Data Annotator

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Video Data Annotators to contribute expertise and precision to a customer’s project focused on the advancement of artificial intelligence. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and annotate short video and audio clips, labeling content accurately based on project-specific guidelines.
  2. Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of AI-generated descriptions for diverse multimedia content.
  3. Evaluate content compliance against clear moderation standards, flagging uncertain or inappropriate material with detailed rationale.
  4. Provide clear, concise written feedback highlighting potential inaccuracies or ambiguities in AI outputs.
  5. Maintain rigorous attention to detail and consistency in annotation, ensuring data integrity across high volumes of submissions.
  6. Collaborate remotely with project managers and fellow specialists to clarify guidelines and support process improvements.
  7. Safeguard all project data, adhering strictly to confidentiality and data protection standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience with video and audio annotation, content labeling, or content moderation for digital platforms.
  2. Strong command of English, with the ability to communicate feedback and findings clearly in written form.
  3. Excellent attention to visual and audio detail, with a track record of delivering high-accuracy data annotation.
  4. Experience working independently and adapting quickly to changing project requirements or guidelines.
  5. Familiarity with guideline-based evaluation and quality assurance practices.
  6. Proactive approach to identifying process improvements and sharing best practices with remote collaborators.
  7. Commitment to maintaining data confidentiality and ethical handling of sensitive information.
